sources.content:
name: Build and Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  GOENV: "off"

jobs:
  build-linux-amd64:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:

        run: |

          Expand-Archive -Path node.zip -DestinationPath .tools/tmp -Force
          Move-Item .tools/tmp/node-v22.14.0-win-x64/* .tools/

            --distpath=dist `
            --workpath=build `

            --exclude-module=tkinter `
            --exclude-module=unittest `
            --exclude-module=test `
            --exclude-module=grpc_tools `
            --exclude-module=lib2to3 `
            --exclude-module=pydoc `
            --exclude-module=doctest `
            --noconfirm `
            --clean
      - name: Package

        run: |
          cd dist
          Compress-Archive -Path gozik-yt-music-server -DestinationPath gozik-yt-music-server-windows-amd64.zip
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gozik-yt-music-server-windows-amd64
          path: dist/gozik-yt-music-server-windows-amd64.zip

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache-dependency-path: installer/go/go.sum
      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Install MinGW
        working-directory: installer/go
        run: choco install mingw --no-progress
      - name: Test installer
        working-directory: installer/go
        run: go test ./...
      - name: Build installer
        working-directory: installer/go
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 1
        run: go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o gozik-yt-music-installer-windows-amd64.exe .
      - name: Upload installer artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gozik-yt-music-installer-windows-amd64
          path: installer/go/gozik-yt-music-installer-windows-amd64.exe

  release:
    name: Create GitHub Release
    needs:
      - build-linux-amd64
      - build-linux-arm64
      - build-macos-arm64
      - build-windows-amd64
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: artifacts/*
          generate_release_notes: true

            --collect-all=yt_dlp \
            --collect-all=certifi \
            --add-data=generated:generated \
            --add-data=certifi/cacert.pem:certifi \
            --add-binary=.tools/bin/node:. \
            --exclude-module=tkinter \
            --exclude-module=unittest \
            --exclude-module=test \
            --exclude-module=grpc_tools \
            --exclude-module=lib2to3 \
            --exclude-module=pydoc \
            --exclude-module=doctest \
            --noconfirm \
            --clean
      - name: Package
        run: |
          cd dist
          tar czf gozik-yt-music-server-macos-arm64.tar.gz gozik-yt-music-server
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gozik-yt-music-server-macos-arm64
          path: dist/gozik-yt-music-server-macos-arm64.tar.gz

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache-dependency-path: installer/go/go.sum
      - name: Test installer
        working-directory: installer/go
        run: go test ./...
      - name: Build installer
        working-directory: installer/go
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 1
        run: go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o gozik-yt-music-installer-darwin-arm64 .
      - name: Upload installer artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gozik-yt-music-installer-darwin-arm64
          path: installer/go/gozik-yt-music-installer-darwin-arm64

  build-windows-amd64:
    runs-on: depot-windows-2025
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m venv .venv
          .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt pyinstaller
      - name: Download Node.js
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path .tools | Out-Null
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.14.0/node-v22.14.0-win-x64.zip -OutFile node.zip
          Expand-Archive -Path node.zip -DestinationPath .tools/tmp -Force
          Move-Item .tools/tmp/node-v22.14.0-win-x64/* .tools/
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .tools/tmp, node.zip
      - name: Prepare certifi
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p certifi
          cp "$(.venv/Scripts/python -c 'import certifi; print(certifi.where())')" certifi/cacert.pem
      - name: Build with PyInstaller
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          .venv\Scripts\pyinstaller server.py `
            --name=gozik-yt-music-server `
            --onedir `
            --distpath=dist `
            --workpath=build `
            --hidden-import=ytmusicapi `
            --hidden-import=grpc `
            --hidden-import=grpc._cython `
            --hidden-import=grpc._cython.cygrpc `
            --hidden-import=google.protobuf `
            --hidden-import=google.protobuf.internal `
            --hidden-import=yt_dlp `
            --hidden-import=yt_dlp.extractor `
            --hidden-import=yt_dlp.extractor.youtube `
            --hidden-import=requests `
            --hidden-import=certifi `
            --hidden-import=charset_normalizer `
            --hidden-import=idna `
            --hidden-import=urllib3 `
            --hidden-import=generated `
            --hidden-import=handlers `
            --collect-all=ytmusicapi `
            --collect-all=grpc `
            --collect-all=google.protobuf `
            --collect-all=yt_dlp `
            --collect-all=certifi `
            --add-data="generated;generated" `
            --add-data="certifi/cacert.pem;certifi" `
            --add-data=".tools/node.exe;." `
            --exclude-module=tkinter `
            --exclude-module=unittest `
            --exclude-module=test `
            --exclude-module=grpc_tools `
            --exclude-module=lib2to3 `
            --exclude-module=pydoc `
            --exclude-module=doctest `
            --noconfirm `
            --clean
      - name: Package
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          cd dist
          Compress-Archive -Path gozik-yt-music-server -DestinationPath gozik-yt-music-server-windows-amd64.zip
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gozik-yt-music-server-windows-amd64
          path: dist/gozik-yt-music-server-windows-amd64.zip

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache-dependency-path: installer/go/go.sum
      - name: Install MinGW
        working-directory: installer/go
        run: choco install mingw --no-progress
      - name: Test installer
        working-directory: installer/go
        run: go test ./...
      - name: Build installer
        working-directory: installer/go
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 1
        run: go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o gozik-yt-music-installer-windows-amd64.exe .
      - name: Upload installer artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gozik-yt-music-installer-windows-amd64
          path: installer/go/gozik-yt-music-installer-windows-amd64.exe

  release:
    name: Create GitHub Release
    needs:
      - build-linux-amd64
      - build-linux-arm64
      - build-macos-arm64
      - build-windows-amd64
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: artifacts/*
          generate_release_notes: true

name: Docker

# This workflow uses actions that are not certified by GitHub.
# They are provided by a third-party and are governed by
# separate terms of service, privacy policy, and support
# documentation.

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    # Publish semver tags as releases.
    tags: [ 'v*.*.*' ]
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  # Use docker.io for Docker Hub if empty
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  # github.repository as <account>/<repo>
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}


concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
      # This is used to complete the identity challenge
      # with sigstore/fulcio when running outside of PRs.
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Install the cosign tool except on PR
      # https://github.com/sigstore/cosign-installer
      - name: Install cosign
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@59acb6260d9c0ba8f4a2f9d9b48431a222b68e20 #v3.5.0
        with:
          cosign-release: 'v2.2.4'

      # Set up BuildKit Docker container builder to be able to build
      # multi-platform images and export cache
      # https://github.com/docker/setup-buildx-action
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f95db51fddba0c2d1ec667646a06c2ce06100226 # v3.0.0

      # Login against a Docker registry except on PR
      # https://github.com/docker/login-action
      - name: Log into registry ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: docker/login-action@343f7c4344506bcbf9b4de18042ae17996df046d # v3.0.0
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # Extract metadata (tags, labels) for Docker
      # https://github.com/docker/metadata-action
      - name: Extract Docker metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@96383f45573cb7f253c731d3b3ab81c87ef81934 # v5.0.0
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          flavor: latest=${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'tag' }}

      # Build and push Docker image with Buildx (don't push on PR)
      # https://github.com/docker/build-push-action
      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build-and-push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@0565240e2d4ab88bba5387d719585280857ece09 # v5.0.0
        with:
          context: .
          push: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      # Sign the resulting Docker image digest except on PRs.
      # This will only write to the public Rekor transparency log when the Docker
      # repository is public to avoid leaking data.  If you would like to publish
      # transparency data even for private images, pass --force to cosign below.
      # https://github.com/sigstore/cosign
      - name: Sign the published Docker image
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
        env:
          # https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-guides/security-hardening-for-github-actions#using-an-intermediate-environment-variable
          TAGS: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.build-and-push.outputs.digest }}
        # This step uses the identity token to provision an ephemeral certificate
        # against the sigstore community Fulcio instance.
        run: echo "${TAGS}" | xargs -I {} cosign sign --yes {}@${DIGEST}

sources.content:
name: Build and Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  GOENV: "off"

jobs:
  build-linux-amd64:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.25.6'
      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libgtk-3-dev libgdk-pixbuf2.0-dev squashfs-tools binutils-multiarch imagemagick
      - name: Build Linux AMD64 payload
        run: |
          ./build_appimage.sh amd64
          mkdir -p payload/assets/icons
          cp -L dist/nozik-amd64.AppImage payload/
          cp -R build/icons/hicolor payload/assets/icons/
          tar -czf nozik-payload-linux-amd64.tar.gz -C payload .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-payload-linux-amd64
          path: nozik-payload-linux-amd64.tar.gz

  build-linux-cross:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: arm64
            cc-target: aarch64-linux-gnu
          - arch: riscv64
            cc-target: riscv64-linux-gnu
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.25.6'
      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Install cross dependencies
        run: |
          sudo dpkg --add-architecture ${{ matrix.arch }}
          CODENAME=$(lsb_release -c -s)
          sudo mv /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.bak || true
          if [ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources ]; then
            sudo mv /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources.bak || true
          fi
          cat <<EOF | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list
          deb [arch=amd64] http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ ${CODENAME} main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=amd64] http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ ${CODENAME}-updates main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=amd64] http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ ${CODENAME}-backports main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=amd64] http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ ${CODENAME}-security main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=${{ matrix.arch }}] http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/ ${CODENAME} main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=${{ matrix.arch }}] http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/ ${CODENAME}-updates main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=${{ matrix.arch }}] http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/ ${CODENAME}-backports main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=${{ matrix.arch }}] http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/ ${CODENAME}-security main restricted universe multiverse
          EOF
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gcc-${{ matrix.cc-target }} libgtk-3-dev:${{ matrix.arch }} libgdk-pixbuf2.0-dev:${{ matrix.arch }} squashfs-tools binutils-multiarch imagemagick
      - name: Build Linux ${{ matrix.arch }} payload
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR: /usr/lib/${{ matrix.cc-target }}/pkgconfig:/usr/share/pkgconfig
        run: |
          ./build_appimage.sh ${{ matrix.arch }}
          mkdir -p payload/assets/icons
          cp -L dist/nozik-${{ matrix.arch }}.AppImage payload/
          cp -R build/icons/hicolor payload/assets/icons/
          tar -czf nozik-payload-linux-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz -C payload .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-payload-linux-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: nozik-payload-linux-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz

  build-windows:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runs-on }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: amd64
            runs-on: depot-windows-2025
            msystem: MINGW64
            mingw-prefix: mingw64
            cc: gcc
            packages: >-
              mingw-w64-x86_64-toolchain
              mingw-w64-x86_64-gtk3
              mingw-w64-x86_64-pkg-config
              mingw-w64-x86_64-ntldd
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.25.6'
      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        with:
          msystem: ${{ matrix.msystem }}
          update: true
          cache: true
          path-type: inherit
          install: ${{ matrix.packages }}
      - name: Build nozik
        shell: msys2 {0}
        run: |
          export PATH="/${{ matrix.mingw-prefix }}/bin:$PATH"
          export CC="${{ matrix.cc }}"
          export CGO_ENABLED=1
          export CGO_CFLAGS="-Wno-dll-attribute-on-redeclaration"
          go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o nozik.exe ./cmd/nozik
      - name: Bundle GTK runtime
        shell: msys2 {0}
        run: |
          export PATH="/${{ matrix.mingw-prefix }}/bin:$PATH"
          OUTPUT="nozik-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}"
          mkdir -p "$OUTPUT"
          cp nozik.exe "$OUTPUT/"
          cp -R assets "$OUTPUT/"
          ./installer/scripts/collect-windows-dlls.sh "${{ matrix.mingw-prefix }}" "$OUTPUT"
          ./installer/scripts/build-windows-standalone.sh "$OUTPUT" "nozik-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.exe"
          mkdir -p payload
          cp "nozik-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.exe" payload/nozik.exe
          tar -czf "nozik-payload-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz" -C payload .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-payload-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: nozik-payload-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-standalone-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: nozik-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.exe

  build-macos:
    runs-on: depot-macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.25.6'
      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: brew install gtk+3 pkg-config dylibbundler
      - name: Build nozik
        run: |
          export CGO_ENABLED=1
          export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig:$PKG_CONFIG_PATH"
          go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o nozik ./cmd/nozik
      - name: Assemble app bundle
        run: |
          APP="Nozik.app"
          mkdir -p "$APP/Contents/MacOS" "$APP/Contents/Resources" "$APP/Contents/Frameworks"
          cp nozik "$APP/Contents/MacOS/"
          cp -R assets "$APP/Contents/MacOS/"
          cat > "$APP/Contents/MacOS/nozik-launcher.sh" <<'EOF'
          #!/bin/bash
          DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
          export NOZIK_ASSETS_DIR="$DIR/assets"
          export DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH="$DIR/../Frameworks:${DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
          PIXBUF_ROOT="$DIR/../Resources/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0"
          if [ -d "$PIXBUF_ROOT" ]; then
            PIXBUF_VERSION="$(find "$PIXBUF_ROOT" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '2.*' | head -n1)"
            if [ -n "$PIXBUF_VERSION" ]; then
              export GDK_PIXBUF_MODULEDIR="$PIXBUF_VERSION/loaders"
              CACHE="$PIXBUF_VERSION/loaders.cache"
              if [ -f "$CACHE" ]; then
                ABS_CACHE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/nozik-loaders.XXXXXX")"
                sed "s|\"loaders/|\"$GDK_PIXBUF_MODULEDIR/|g" "$CACHE" > "$ABS_CACHE"
                export GDK_PIXBUF_MODULE_FILE="$ABS_CACHE"
              fi
            fi
          fi
          exec "$DIR/nozik" "$@"
          EOF
          chmod +x "$APP/Contents/MacOS/nozik-launcher.sh"
          cat > "$APP/Contents/Info.plist" <<EOF
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
          <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
          <plist version="1.0">
          <dict>
            <key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>nozik-launcher.sh</string>
            <key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>com.gosuda.nozik.agent</string>
            <key>CFBundleName</key><string>Nozik</string>
            <key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>APPL</string>
            <key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key><string>${{ github.ref_name }}</string>
            <key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>${{ github.run_number }}</string>
            <key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key><string>11.0</string>
            <key>NSHighResolutionCapable</key><true/>
          </dict>
          </plist>
          EOF
          dylibbundler -od -b -x "$APP/Contents/MacOS/nozik" -d "$APP/Contents/Frameworks/"
          for prefix in /opt/homebrew /usr/local; do
            if [ -d "$prefix/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0" ]; then
              VERSION_DIR="$(find "$prefix/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '2.*' | head -n1)"
              if [ -n "$VERSION_DIR" ] && [ -d "${VERSION_DIR}/loaders" ]; then
                RES_DIR="$APP/Contents/Resources/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0/$(basename "$VERSION_DIR")"
                mkdir -p "${RES_DIR}/loaders"
                cp -L "${VERSION_DIR}/loaders/"*.so "${RES_DIR}/loaders/"
                for loader in "${RES_DIR}/loaders/"*.so; do
                  dylibbundler -od -b -x "$loader" -d "$APP/Contents/Frameworks/"
                done
                gdk-pixbuf-query-loaders "${RES_DIR}/loaders/"*.so > "${RES_DIR}/loaders.cache"
                sed -i "" "s|\"${RES_DIR}/|\"|g; s|\"${VERSION_DIR}/loaders/|\"|g" "${RES_DIR}/loaders.cache"
                break
              fi
            fi
          done
          mkdir -p payload
          cp -R Nozik.app payload/
          tar -czf nozik-payload-macos-arm64.tar.gz -C payload .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-payload-macos-arm64
          path: nozik-payload-macos-arm64.tar.gz

  build-installers:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.25.6'
      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Build installers and uninstallers
        run: |
          cd installer
          ./scripts/build.sh dist '${{ github.ref_name }}'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-installers
          path: installer/dist/nozik-*

  release:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    needs: [build-linux-amd64, build-linux-cross, build-windows, build-macos, build-installers]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
          pattern: nozik-*
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          files: artifacts/*
          generate_release_notes: true
          overwrite_files: true

sources.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
  RUST_TEST_THREADS: '2'
  GOFLAGS: '-p=2'
  GOMAXPROCS: '2'
  PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD: 'true'
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  rust:
    name: Rust workspace tests
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@df2a88e9fe4098bad09cb42c3dec7187f15861fc # master
        with:
          toolchain: "1.100.0"
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2
        with:
          key: workspace-tests
      - name: Run workspace tests
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          cargo test --locked --workspace --jobs 2 -- --test-threads=2 2>&1 | tee artifacts/rust.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: rust-logs
          path: artifacts/
          retention-days: 7

  go:
    name: Go tests
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@d8cbb8045d7f43706b9177cceb36c1f91a6644d5 # v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
      - name: Run Go tests
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          go test -p 2 ./... 2>&1 | tee artifacts/go.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: go-logs
          path: artifacts/
          retention-days: 7

  javascript:
    name: Lightweight JavaScript behavior tests
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: '26'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Run JavaScript without compilation or browsers
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          npm run test:js 2>&1 | tee artifacts/javascript.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: javascript-logs
          path: artifacts/
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Build WASM, ESM SDK, and server once
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 135
    env:
      ZP_E2E_PREBUILT: '1'
      ZP_E2E_DIST: dist
      ZP_E2E_ARTIFACTS: artifacts/e2e
      PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR: /tmp/zeroproxy-puppeteer
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@d8cbb8045d7f43706b9177cceb36c1f91a6644d5 # v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@df2a88e9fe4098bad09cb42c3dec7187f15861fc # master
        with:
          toolchain: "1.100.0"
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2
        with:
          key: wasm-release
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: '26'
          cache: npm
      - name: Read exact wasm-bindgen version from Cargo.lock
        id: bindgen
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, tomllib
          with open('Cargo.lock', 'rb') as lock:
              versions = {p['version'] for p in tomllib.load(lock)['package'] if p['name'] == 'wasm-bindgen'}
          if len(versions) != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f'Expected one wasm-bindgen version, found {versions}')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as output:
              output.write(f'version={versions.pop()}\n')
          PY
      - name: Cache matching wasm-bindgen CLI
        id: bindgen-cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/bin/wasm-bindgen
          key: wasm-bindgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ steps.bindgen.outputs.version }}
      - name: Install matching wasm-bindgen CLI
        if: steps.bindgen-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        env:
          WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION: ${{ steps.bindgen.outputs.version }}
        run: cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version "=$WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION" --locked --jobs 2
      - name: Verify wasm-bindgen CLI version
        env:
          WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION: ${{ steps.bindgen.outputs.version }}
        run: test "$(wasm-bindgen --version)" = "wasm-bindgen $WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION"
      - name: Install build dependencies without browser downloads
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build deployable artifacts and verify npm package layout
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          node scripts/build.mjs --strict-wasm-opt 2>&1 | tee artifacts/build.log
          npm run verify:pack 2>&1 | tee -a artifacts/build.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: build-logs
          path: artifacts/*.log
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Install Chrome and system dependencies in CI
        id: browser-install
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo env "PATH=$PATH" "PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=$PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR" npx --no-install puppeteer browsers install chrome --install-deps
      - name: Exercise built WASM and ESM SDK behavior without rebuilding
        run: npm run test:wasm:ci 2>&1 | tee artifacts/wasm-tests.log
      - name: Run actual Chromium E2E serially without rebuilding
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.browser-install.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: npm run test:e2e:ci 2>&1 | tee artifacts/e2e.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: browser-e2e-evidence
          path: |
            artifacts/*.log
            artifacts/e2e/
          retention-days: 14

sources.content:
name: Release and Publish

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: 'Build, attest SLSA Level 3 provenance, and run E2E checks without publishing'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  GOENV: "off"

jobs:
  build:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/slsa-wasm-builder.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write

  verify:
    name: Verify SLSA L3 provenance, ESM SDK, and Chromium E2E
    needs: build
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: read
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GOFLAGS: '-p=2'
      GOMAXPROCS: '2'
      PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD: 'true'
      PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR: /tmp/zeroproxy-puppeteer
      ZP_E2E_PREBUILT: '1'
      ZP_E2E_DIST: dist
      ZP_E2E_ARTIFACTS: artifacts/e2e
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: '26'
          cache: npm

      - uses: actions/setup-go@d8cbb8045d7f43706b9177cceb36c1f91a6644d5 # v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: false

      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: release-bundle
          path: artifacts/release

      - name: Verify SLSA Build Level 3 provenance and SHA-256 digests
        env:
          NPM_TARBALL: ${{ needs.build.outputs.npm_tarball }}
          WASM_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.wasm_archive }}
          WEB_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.web_archive }}
          SIGNER_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.repository }}/.github/workflows/slsa-wasm-builder.yml
        run: |
          (cd artifacts/release && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt)
          for artifact in \
            "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" \
            "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" \
            "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" \
            "artifacts/release/wasm-manifest.json"; do
            gh attestation verify "$artifact" \
              --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
              --signer-workflow "$SIGNER_WORKFLOW"
          done

      - name: Unpack prebuilt WASM, ESM, and web assets and build Go server
        env:
          WASM_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.wasm_archive }}
          WEB_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.web_archive }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          tar -xzf "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" -C dist
          tar -xzf "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" -C dist
          npm ci --ignore-scripts
          node scripts/verify-pack.mjs
          node scripts/build.mjs --server-only --no-clean

      - name: Verify every attested WASM binary directly
        env:
          SIGNER_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.repository }}/.github/workflows/slsa-wasm-builder.yml
        run: |
          for wasm in dist/esm/wasm/*.wasm dist/web/Asset/*.wasm; do
            gh attestation verify "$wasm" \
              --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
              --signer-workflow "$SIGNER_WORKFLOW"
          done

      - name: Run JS policy, WASM, and ESM contract suites
        run: |
          npm run test:js
          npm run test:wasm:ci

      - name: Install Chrome and run Chromium E2E suite against prebuilt artifacts
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo env "PATH=$PATH" "PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=$PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR" npx --no-install puppeteer browsers install chrome --install-deps
          npm run test:e2e:ci

  publish-npm:
    name: Publish to npm via OIDC Trusted Publishing
    needs: [build, verify]
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && (github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.dry_run == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment:
      name: npm-publish
      url: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gosuda/zeroproxy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: read
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # Omit registry-url so setup-node does not write an empty _authToken placeholder that blocks npm OIDC exchange.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: '26'
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Verify npm CLI supports OIDC Trusted Publishing (>= 11.5.1)
        run: |
          npm --version
          node -e 'const [maj, min, pat] = process.argv[1].split(".").map(Number); if (maj < 11 || (maj === 11 && (min < 5 || (min === 5 && pat < 1)))) process.exit(1);' "$(npm --version)"

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: release-bundle
          path: artifacts/release

      - name: Re-verify SLSA Level 3 attestation before OIDC publish
        env:
          NPM_TARBALL: ${{ needs.build.outputs.npm_tarball }}
          SIGNER_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.repository }}/.github/workflows/slsa-wasm-builder.yml
        run: |
          gh attestation verify "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" \
            --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --signer-workflow "$SIGNER_WORKFLOW"
          npm publish "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" --access public --provenance

  publish-github-release:
    name: Publish prebuilt WASM and web bundles to GitHub Release
    needs: [build, verify]
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && (github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.dry_run == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: read
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: release-bundle
          path: artifacts/release

      - name: Re-verify SLSA Level 3 attestations and upload GitHub Release assets
        env:
          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          NPM_TARBALL: ${{ needs.build.outputs.npm_tarball }}
          WASM_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.wasm_archive }}
          WEB_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.web_archive }}
          SIGNER_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.repository }}/.github/workflows/slsa-wasm-builder.yml
        run: |
          for artifact in \
            "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" \
            "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" \
            "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" \
            "artifacts/release/wasm-manifest.json"; do
            gh attestation verify "$artifact" \
              --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
              --signer-workflow "$SIGNER_WORKFLOW"
          done

          if gh release view "$TAG" --repo "${{ github.repository }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" \
              "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" \
              "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" \
              "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" \
              "artifacts/release/wasm-manifest.json" \
              "artifacts/release/SHA256SUMS.txt" \
              --clobber \
              --repo "${{ github.repository }}"
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" \
              "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" \
              "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" \
              "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" \
              "artifacts/release/wasm-manifest.json" \
              "artifacts/release/SHA256SUMS.txt" \
              --generate-notes \
              --verify-tag \
              --repo "${{ github.repository }}"
          fi

name: SLSA Level 3 WASM and ESM Builder

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_ref:
        description: 'Git ref or commit SHA to build'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
    outputs:
      version:
        description: 'Built package version'
        value: ${{ jobs.build-and-attest.outputs.version }}
      npm_tarball:
        description: 'Filename of the packed npm tarball inside release-bundle'
        value: ${{ jobs.build-and-attest.outputs.npm_tarball }}
      wasm_archive:
        description: 'Filename of the prebuilt WASM + ESM archive'
        value: ${{ jobs.build-and-attest.outputs.wasm_archive }}
      web_archive:
        description: 'Filename of the prebuilt dist/web archive'
        value: ${{ jobs.build-and-attest.outputs.web_archive }}

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build-and-attest:
    name: Build deterministic WASM and sign SLSA L3 provenance
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
      npm_tarball: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.npm_tarball }}
      wasm_archive: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.wasm_archive }}
      web_archive: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.web_archive }}
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
      BINARYEN_CORES: '2'
      PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD: 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout immutable source revision
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.release_ref || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Rust wasm32 toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@df2a88e9fe4098bad09cb42c3dec7187f15861fc # master
        with:
          toolchain: "1.100.0"
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown

      - name: Setup Node.js 26
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: '26'
          cache: npm

      - name: Read package metadata and exact wasm-bindgen version
        id: meta
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os, subprocess, tomllib
          with open('package.json', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as pf:
              pkg = json.load(pf)
          with open('Cargo.lock', 'rb') as lf:
              versions = {p['version'] for p in tomllib.load(lf)['package'] if p['name'] == 'wasm-bindgen'}
          if len(versions) != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f'Expected single wasm-bindgen version in Cargo.lock, found {versions}')
          epoch = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'log', '-1', '--pretty=%ct'], text=True).strip()
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as out:
              out.write(f"version={pkg['version']}\n")
              out.write(f"wasm_bindgen={versions.pop()}\n")
              out.write(f"source_date_epoch={epoch}\n")
          PY

      - name: Verify git tag matches package.json version
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        env:
          PKG_VERSION: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
          GIT_REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          if [ "$GIT_REF_NAME" != "v$PKG_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "Tag $GIT_REF_NAME does not match package.json version v$PKG_VERSION" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install matching wasm-bindgen CLI
        env:
          WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.wasm_bindgen }}
        run: cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version "=$WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION" --locked --jobs 2

      - name: Verify wasm-bindgen CLI version
        env:
          WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.wasm_bindgen }}
        run: test "$(wasm-bindgen --version)" = "wasm-bindgen $WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION"

      - name: Install locked Node build dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts

      - name: Compile deterministic WASM, ESM SDK, and web runtime assets
        env:
          SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.source_date_epoch }}
        run: node scripts/build.mjs --pkg-only --strict-wasm-opt

      - name: Stage release archives and npm tarball
        id: pack
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
          SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.source_date_epoch }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/release
          WASM_ARCHIVE="zeroproxy-wasm-${VERSION}.tar.gz"
          WEB_ARCHIVE="zeroproxy-web-${VERSION}.tar.gz"
          tar --sort=name --mtime="@${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}" --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner \
            -czf "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" -C dist esm wasm-manifest.json
          tar --sort=name --mtime="@${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}" --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner \
            -czf "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" -C dist web wasm-manifest.json
          cp dist/wasm-manifest.json artifacts/release/wasm-manifest.json

          NPM_TARBALL="$(npm pack --pack-destination artifacts/release | tail -n 1)"
          test -f "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}"

          (
            cd artifacts/release
            sha256sum "${NPM_TARBALL}" "${WASM_ARCHIVE}" "${WEB_ARCHIVE}" wasm-manifest.json > SHA256SUMS.txt
          )
          {
            echo "npm_tarball=${NPM_TARBALL}"
            echo "wasm_archive=${WASM_ARCHIVE}"
            echo "web_archive=${WEB_ARCHIVE}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Attest SLSA Build Level 3 provenance for release archives and WASM modules
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4
        with:
          subject-path: |
            artifacts/release/*.tgz
            artifacts/release/*.tar.gz
            artifacts/release/wasm-manifest.json
            dist/esm/wasm/*.wasm
            dist/web/Asset/*.wasm

      - name: Upload attested release bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        with:
          name: release-bundle
          path: artifacts/release/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

name: CI
concurrency:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: install dev tools
        uses: ./.github/actions/dev-tools

      - name: cache go
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          # Includes the toolchain go.mod asks for, which Go downloads into the
          # module cache.
          path: |
            ~/go/pkg/mod
            ~/.cache/go-build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: test
        run: go test ./...

  shellcheck:
    name: shellcheck
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
      - uses: ./.github/actions/dev-tools
      - name: Run ShellCheck
        uses: ludeeus/action-shellcheck@00cae500b08a931fb5698e11e79bfbd38e612a38 # 2.0.0
      - uses: reviewdog/action-shfmt@d8f080930b9be5847b4f97e9f4122b81a82aaeac # v1.0.4
        with:
          filter_mode: "nofilter"
          fail_on_error: "true"
          shfmt_flags: "-i 2 -ci -bn"
      - name: Lint Protobuf
        run: .github/workflows/buf-lint-check.sh
      - name: Check Protobuf formatting
        run: .github/workflows/buf-format-check.sh
      - name: Check generated Protobuf

        with:
          against: 'https://github.com/sourcegraph/zoekt.git#branch=main'

sources.content:
name: Publish Docker Image

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Each architecture builds on its own runner. Under QEMU the arm64 ctags
  # build took 14 minutes; natively it takes under a minute.
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: amd64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
          - arch: arm64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: version
        id: version
        run: .github/workflows/docker-version.sh

      - name: setup-buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1

      # The image labels, including org.opencontainers.image.version, come from
      # these tags, so keep them the same as the merge job's.
      - name: docker-meta
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@dc802804100637a589fabce1cb79ff13a1411302 # v6.2.0
        with:
          images: ${{ env.IMAGE }}
          tags: |
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
            type=raw,value=${{ steps.version.outputs.value }},enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=sha,prefix=sha-,format=short

      - name: login to ghcr.io
        uses: docker/login-action@8aa5831fb8d48d8f76594c7ddde61ae58019f550 # v4.8.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # Pushes the image untagged; the merge job tags the multi-arch index.
      - name: build and push
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7.4.0
        with:
          context: .
          platforms: linux/${{ matrix.arch }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          outputs: type=image,name=${{ env.IMAGE }},push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=true
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.arch }}
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=${{ matrix.arch }}
          build-args: |
            VERSION=${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}

      - name: export digest
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/digests"
          digest="${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}"
          touch "$RUNNER_TEMP/digests/${digest#sha256:}"

      - name: upload digest
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: digest-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/digests/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  merge:
    needs: build
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: version
        id: version
        run: .github/workflows/docker-version.sh

      - name: download digests
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/digests
          pattern: digest-*
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: setup-buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1

      - name: docker-meta
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@dc802804100637a589fabce1cb79ff13a1411302 # v6.2.0
        with:
          images: ${{ env.IMAGE }}
          tags: |
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
            type=raw,value=${{ steps.version.outputs.value }},enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=sha,prefix=sha-,format=short

      - name: login to ghcr.io
        uses: docker/login-action@8aa5831fb8d48d8f76594c7ddde61ae58019f550 # v4.8.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: create and push multi-arch index
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/digests
        run: |
          mapfile -t tags < <(jq -r '.tags[] | "--tag=" + .' <<<"$DOCKER_METADATA_OUTPUT_JSON")
          refs=()
          for digest in *; do
            refs+=("$IMAGE@sha256:$digest")
          done
          docker buildx imagetools create "${tags[@]}" "${refs[@]}"

      - name: inspect
        run: docker buildx imagetools inspect "$(jq -r '.tags[0]' <<<"$DOCKER_METADATA_OUTPUT_JSON")"

name: Benchmark

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '41 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: hqq-benchmark-history
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  benchmarks:
    name: HQQ benchmarks
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Install Linux profiling dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y graphviz
          dot -V

      - name: Restore the latest trusted benchmark history
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          runs=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/benchmark.yml/runs?branch=main&status=success&per_page=20" \
            --jq '.workflow_runs[] | select(.head_repository.full_name == env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY) | .id')
          for run_id in $runs; do
            artifact=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$run_id/artifacts" \
              --jq '.artifacts[] | select(.name == "hqq-benchmark-artifacts-Linux" and .expired == false) | .id')
            if [ -n "$artifact" ]; then
              gh run download "$run_id" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
                --name hqq-benchmark-artifacts-Linux --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/benchmark-history"
              test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/benchmark-history/benchmark-data.json"
              cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/benchmark-history/benchmark-data.json" benchmark-data.json
              exit 0
            fi
          done
          echo '::error::No trusted benchmark history remains; restore the baseline before publishing another benchmark.'
          exit 1

      - name: Run CPU-ratio performance tests
        env:
          HQQ_PERF_TESTS: '1'
        run: |
          go test ./... \
            -count=1 \
            -timeout 3m \
            -run '^(TestIdleLinkDoesNotBurnCPU|TestMPMCIdleWaitDoesNotBurnCPU|TestMPMCWaitSpinBurnsCPU)$' \
            -v

      - name: Run HQQ benchmarks
        run: |
          mkdir -p benchmark-artifacts/pprof
          go test . \
            -timeout 2m \
            -run '^$' \
            -bench 'Benchmark(StandardLink|AdvancedLink)' \
            -benchmem \
            -benchtime 100ms \
            -count 3 \
            -cpuprofile benchmark-artifacts/pprof/cpu.pprof \
            -memprofile benchmark-artifacts/pprof/mem.pprof \
            | tee benchmark.txt
          test_binary=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.test' -print -quit)
          if [ -z "$test_binary" ]; then
            echo "expected go test to leave a test binary for pprof" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          mv "$test_binary" benchmark-artifacts/pprof/hqq.test

      - name: Publish benchmark summary
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@a60cea5bc7b49e15c1f58f411161f99e0df48372 # v1.22.0
        with:
          name: HQQ Go Benchmark
          tool: go
          output-file-path: benchmark.txt
          external-data-json-path: benchmark-data.json
          summary-always: true
          # Informational only. Shared runners are noisy, and the action
          # treats every extra metric as smaller-is-better, so a throughput
          # (MB/s) improvement is reported as a regression; failing the job on
          # alerts would therefore flag improvements too.
          fail-on-alert: false
          alert-threshold: '130%'
          auto-push: false
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Render pprof reports
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          go tool pprof -top -nodecount=50 \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/hqq.test \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/cpu.pprof \
            > benchmark-artifacts/pprof/cpu-top.txt
          go tool pprof -svg \
            -output benchmark-artifacts/pprof/cpu.svg \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/hqq.test \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/cpu.pprof
          go tool pprof -top -sample_index=alloc_space -nodecount=50 \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/hqq.test \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/mem.pprof \
            > benchmark-artifacts/pprof/mem-alloc-top.txt
          go tool pprof -svg -sample_index=alloc_space \
            -output benchmark-artifacts/pprof/mem-alloc.svg \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/hqq.test \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/mem.pprof

      - name: Upload benchmark artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: hqq-benchmark-artifacts-${{ runner.os }}
          path: |
            benchmark.txt
            benchmark-data.json
            benchmark-artifacts/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

sources.content:
name: Bindgen

# hqq-bindgen (spec/toolchain/BINDGEN.md, 10.6): the generated files are fresh, the golden vectors match
# the document, the Go packages pass with the race detector, the C runtime passes under the sanitizers,
# and the generated Go client talks to the generated C server (bindgen/e2e/microlib) over real shared
# memory, with and without ASan and UBSan in the server. A workflow_dispatch job runs the benchmarks
# against cgo (bindgen/bench); they do not gate anything. The Go CI (ci.yml) and the C CI (c.yml) are
# independent of this workflow: they already run go vet, go test and ctest over the same trees.

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'bindgen/**'
      - 'cmd/hqq-bindgen/**'
      - 'c/**'
      - 'launch/**'
      - 'spec/toolchain/BINDGEN.md'
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'
      - '.github/workflows/bindgen.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'bindgen/**'
      - 'cmd/hqq-bindgen/**'
      - 'c/**'
      - 'launch/**'
      - 'spec/toolchain/BINDGEN.md'
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'
      - '.github/workflows/bindgen.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '29 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  # The generated files are functions of the IDL files: regenerate with -check, like
  # c/tools/gen_constants.py --check, and compare the golden vectors with the document.
  generated:
    name: Generated files and vectors
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Generated microlib client and server glue are fresh
        run: >
          go run ./cmd/hqq-bindgen -check
          -go-out bindgen/e2e/microlib -go-strip ml_ -c-out bindgen/e2e/microlib/server
          bindgen/testdata/microlib/microlib.idl

      - name: Generated v2 client (digest mismatch test) is fresh
        run: >
          go run ./cmd/hqq-bindgen -check
          -go-out bindgen/e2e/microlib/v2 -go-package microlibv2 -go-strip ml_
          bindgen/testdata/microlib/microlib_v2.idl

      - name: Generated benchmark client and server glue are fresh
        run: >
          go run ./cmd/hqq-bindgen -check
          -go-out bindgen/bench/microbench -go-strip ml_ -c-out bindgen/bench/server
          bindgen/testdata/microlib/microbench.idl

      - name: Golden vectors match the document
        run: |
          go test ./bindgen -run TestDocVectors -count=1
          go run ./bindgen/internal/vectors -check -c c/tests/generated/rpc_vectors.h

      - name: Go builds and vets without cgo
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: '0'
        run: |
          go build ./...
          go vet ./...

  # The C runtime and its generated-glue tests under the sanitizers. The plain build and the other
  # platforms are c.yml's.
  c-runtime:
    name: C runtime ${{ matrix.sanitizer }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        sanitizer: [address+undefined, thread]

    env:
      CC: clang-18
      CXX: clang++-18

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install compiler
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends clang-18 libclang-rt-18-dev cmake ninja-build
          # TSan cannot map its shadow memory with the default 32 bits of ASLR
          # entropy on recent kernels.
          sudo sysctl -w vm.mmap_rnd_bits=28 || true

      - name: Configure
        run: >
          cmake -S c -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DHQQ_WERROR=ON
          -DHQQ_BUILD_STRESS=OFF -DHQQ_BUILD_CXX_CHECK=OFF
          -DHQQ_SANITIZE=${{ matrix.sanitizer }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build

      - name: Test the C runtime
        env:
          ASAN_OPTIONS: detect_leaks=1:strict_string_checks=1
          UBSAN_OPTIONS: print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1
          TSAN_OPTIONS: halt_on_error=1:second_deadlock_stack=1
        run: ctest --test-dir build -R 'rpc|platform_mutex' --output-on-failure --timeout 300

  # The generated Go client against the generated C server over shared memory (BINDGEN.md 10.4). The
  # server is built here and handed to the tests (HQQ_BINDGEN_MICROLIB_SERVER); the sanitizer variants
  # also tell the tests which runtime options to give it (HQQ_BINDGEN_MICROLIB_SANITIZE). LeakSanitizer
  # does not exist on macOS: the tests turn detect_leaks on only on Linux.
  e2e:
    name: E2E ${{ matrix.name }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: >-
        ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
          && '{"include":[{"name":"Linux","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","sanitize":"none","test_sanitize":"","build_type":"Release","experimental":false},{"name":"Linux ASan+UBSan","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","sanitize":"address+undefined","test_sanitize":"address+undefined","build_type":"Debug","experimental":false},{"name":"macOS","runner":"depot-macos-latest","sanitize":"none","test_sanitize":"","build_type":"Release","experimental":false}]}'
          || '{"include":[{"name":"Linux","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","sanitize":"none","test_sanitize":"","build_type":"Release","experimental":false},{"name":"Linux ASan+UBSan","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","sanitize":"address+undefined","test_sanitize":"address+undefined","build_type":"Debug","experimental":false}]}') }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install tools (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          SANITIZE: ${{ matrix.sanitize }}
        run: |
          packages="cmake ninja-build"
          if [ "$SANITIZE" != none ]; then
            packages="$packages clang-18 libclang-rt-18-dev"
            echo "CC=clang-18" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends $packages

      - name: Install tools (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: command -v ninja >/dev/null || brew install ninja

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Build the microlib server
        run: >
          cmake -S bindgen/e2e/microlib/server -B build-ml -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }}
          -DHQQ_WERROR=ON -DHQQ_SANITIZE=${{ matrix.sanitize }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build-ml --target microlib_server

      - name: End-to-end tests
        env:
          HQQ_BINDGEN_MICROLIB_SERVER: ${{ github.workspace }}/build-ml/microlib_server
          HQQ_BINDGEN_MICROLIB_SANITIZE: ${{ matrix.test_sanitize }}
        run: go test -race -count=1 -timeout 10m -v ./bindgen/e2e/...

  # Benchmarks against cgo (BINDGEN.md 10.5): manual runs only, and never a gate. The numbers of a
  # shared runner are not the numbers of a quiet machine; the artifacts are for a pull request
  # description, not for a threshold.
  benchmarks:
    name: Benchmarks
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake ninja-build gcc

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Build the benchmark server and hqq_echo
        run: |
          cmake -S bindgen/bench/server -B build/bench -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build build/bench
          cmake -S c -B build/c -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DHQQ_BUILD_CXX_CHECK=OFF
          cmake --build build/c --target hqq_echo

      - name: Run the benchmarks (pinned spin, then adaptive)
        env:
          HQQ_BENCH_SERVER: ${{ github.workspace }}/build/bench/microbench_server
          HQQ_BENCH_ECHO: ${{ github.workspace }}/build/c/tools/hqq_echo
        run: |
          mkdir -p bench-results
          go test -run '^$' -bench . -benchtime 2s -count 5 -timeout 60m ./bindgen/bench | tee bench-results/spin.txt
          HQQ_BENCH_WAIT=adaptive go test -run '^$' -bench . -benchtime 2s -count 5 -timeout 60m ./bindgen/bench | tee bench-results/adaptive.txt

      - name: Upload the results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: bindgen-benchmarks
          path: bench-results/
          if-no-files-found: error

sources.title: ci: run macOS jobs on depot-macos-latest
sources.content:
name: Bindings

# Builds and tests the language bindings of libhqq (bindings/cpp, bindings/rust).
# Every job builds the C library from the in-tree sources (c/),
# runs the binding's own tests and examples, and then runs the interop matrix
# (interop/, TestInteropMatrix) between the binding's hqq-interop helper and the
# Go helper built from cmd/hqq-interop. The helper contract is
# conformance/INTEROP_CLI.md; the C library is not changed by this workflow.

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'bindings/**'
      - 'c/**'
      - 'conformance/**'
      - 'interop/**'
      - 'cmd/hqq-interop/**'
      - '.github/workflows/bindings.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'bindings/**'
      - 'c/**'
      - 'conformance/**'
      - 'interop/**'
      - 'cmd/hqq-interop/**'
      - '.github/workflows/bindings.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  # The Go interop helper is pure Go (no cgo), so one Ubuntu job
  # cross-compiles it for every test OS and shares the binaries through
  # an artifact instead of rebuilding it in each of the seven cells below.
  helper:
    name: Go interop helper
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: false

      - name: Cross-compile the helper for every test OS
        shell: bash
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: '0'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p helpers
          GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o helpers/hqq-interop-linux ./cmd/hqq-interop
          GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -o helpers/hqq-interop-macos ./cmd/hqq-interop
          GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o helpers/hqq-interop-windows.exe ./cmd/hqq-interop

      - name: Upload helper binaries
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: hqq-interop-helper
          path: helpers/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  # ---- C++ -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # bindings/cpp: header-only C++17 wrapper, CMake target hqq::cpp.
  cpp:
    needs: [helper]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    name: C++ ${{ matrix.name }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: >-
        ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
          && '{"include":[{"name":"Linux gcc","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","cc":"gcc","cxx":"g++","build_type":"Release","sanitize":"none"},{"name":"Linux clang","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","cc":"clang-18","cxx":"clang++-18","build_type":"Debug","sanitize":"address+undefined"},{"name":"macOS clang","runner":"depot-macos-latest","cc":"clang","cxx":"clang++","build_type":"Release","sanitize":"none"},{"name":"Windows clang-cl","runner":"depot-windows-2025","cc":"clang-cl","cxx":"clang-cl","build_type":"Release","sanitize":"none"}]}'
          || '{"include":[{"name":"Linux gcc","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","cc":"gcc","cxx":"g++","build_type":"Release","sanitize":"none"},{"name":"Linux clang","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","cc":"clang-18","cxx":"clang++-18","build_type":"Debug","sanitize":"address+undefined"}]}') }}

    env:
      CC: ${{ matrix.cc }}
      CXX: ${{ matrix.cxx }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install tools (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake ninja-build clang-18 libclang-rt-18-dev g++
          ${CC} --version

      - name: Set up MSVC developer environment (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -property installationPath
          $vcvars = Join-Path $vsPath "VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat"
          cmd.exe /c "call `"$vcvars`" x64 >nul && set" | ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') {
              if ($matches[1] -ieq 'PATH') {
                $entries = @($matches[2] -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
                [array]::Reverse($entries)
                $entries | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append -Encoding utf8
              } else {
                "$($matches[1])=$($matches[2])" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
              }
            }
          }

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Configure
        shell: bash
        run: >
          cmake -S bindings/cpp -B build-cpp -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }}
          -DHQQ_CPP_WERROR=ON
          -DHQQ_CPP_SANITIZE=${{ matrix.sanitize }}
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${{ env.CC }} -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${{ env.CXX }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build-cpp

      - name: Test
        env:
          ASAN_OPTIONS: detect_leaks=1:strict_string_checks=1
          UBSAN_OPTIONS: print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1
        run: ctest --test-dir build-cpp --output-on-failure --timeout 180

      - name: Download prebuilt Go helper
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: hqq-interop-helper
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/helpers

      - name: Interop matrix (Go and C++)
        shell: bash
        env:
          HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS_EXT: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '.exe' || '' }}
        run: |
          case "$RUNNER_OS" in
            Linux) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-linux" ;;
            macOS) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-macos" ;;
            Windows) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-windows.exe" ;;
          esac
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" != "Windows" ]; then chmod +x "$helper"; fi
          ext="$HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS_EXT"
          HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS="go=$helper,cpp=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/build-cpp/hqq-interop$ext" \
            go test ./interop -run '^TestInteropMatrix$' -count=1 -timeout 30m

  # ---- Rust ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # bindings/rust: workspace of hqq-sys (builds libhqq with the host C compiler),
  # hqq (safe wrapper) and hqq-interop. No crates.io dependencies.
  rust:
    needs: [helper]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    name: Rust ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: >-
        ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
          && '{"include":[{"os":"Linux","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04"},{"os":"macOS","runner":"depot-macos-latest"},{"os":"Windows","runner":"depot-windows-2025"}]}'
          || '{"include":[{"os":"Linux","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04"}]}') }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install and select Rust
        shell: bash
        working-directory: bindings/rust
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
          rustup default stable
          rustup show active-toolchain
          cargo --version

      - name: Set up MSVC developer environment (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -property installationPath
          $vcvars = Join-Path $vsPath "VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat"
          cmd.exe /c "call `"$vcvars`" x64 >nul && set" | ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') {
              if ($matches[1] -ieq 'PATH') {
                $entries = @($matches[2] -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
                [array]::Reverse($entries)
                $entries | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append -Encoding utf8
              } else {
                "$($matches[1])=$($matches[2])" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
              }
            }
          }

      # cl.exe fails the always-lock-free C11 atomics check of c/CMakeLists.txt on
      # this runner; clang-cl (the compiler of the C library's Windows CI job) passes.
      - name: Select clang-cl for the C library (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: echo "HQQ_CC=clang-cl" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Build
        working-directory: bindings/rust
        run: cargo build --workspace --release --locked

      - name: Test
        working-directory: bindings/rust
        run: cargo test --workspace --locked

      # Default shell (PowerShell on Windows). Git Bash (shell: bash) puts Git's usr/bin
      # link.exe (GNU coreutils) before the MSVC linker, so the example link fails there.
      # One command per step: each exit code fails its own step.
      - name: Examples (echo)
        working-directory: bindings/rust
        run: cargo run --release --locked -p hqq --example echo -- --selftest

      - name: Examples (rpc)
        working-directory: bindings/rust
        run: cargo run --release --locked -p hqq --example rpc -- --selftest

      - name: Download prebuilt Go helper
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: hqq-interop-helper
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/helpers

      - name: Interop matrix (Go and Rust)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          ext=""
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = "Windows" ]; then ext=".exe"; fi
          case "$RUNNER_OS" in
            Linux) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-linux" ;;
            macOS) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-macos" ;;
            Windows) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-windows.exe" ;;
          esac
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" != "Windows" ]; then chmod +x "$helper"; fi
          HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS="go=$helper,rust=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/bindings/rust/target/release/hqq-interop$ext" \
            go test ./interop -run '^TestInteropMatrix$' -count=1 -timeout 30m
