sources.content:
name: C

# Builds, tests and verifies the C reference library under c/. The Go CI
# (ci.yml) is independent of this workflow.

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'c/**'
      - 'spec/**'
      - '.github/workflows/c.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'c/**'
      - 'spec/**'
      - '.github/workflows/c.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  # Pinned tool versions for the memory-model job (see c/verify/ and
  # spec/toolchain/VERIFICATION_TOOLING.md).
  GENMC_COMMIT: 9f6c4c0772d0c42b325681581acc6a0f3eb9b5f7 # v0.19.0
  GENMC_LLVM_MAJOR: '19'
  HERDTOOLS_VERSION: '7.58'

jobs:
  # Linux, x86_64 and arm64 (arm64 is real weak-memory hardware).
  linux:
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.arch }} ${{ matrix.cc }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 20

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            arch: x86_64
            cc: gcc-14
            cxx: g++-14
            packages: gcc-14 g++-14
          - runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            arch: x86_64
            cc: clang-18
            cxx: clang++-18
            packages: clang-18 libclang-rt-18-dev
          - runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm
            arch: arm64
            cc: clang-18
            cxx: clang++-18
            packages: clang-18 libclang-rt-18-dev

    env:
      CC: ${{ matrix.cc }}
      CXX: ${{ matrix.cxx }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install compiler
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ${{ matrix.packages }} cmake ninja-build
          ${CC} --version
          cmake --version

      - name: Configure
        run: cmake -S c -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DHQQ_WERROR=ON

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build

      - name: Test
        run: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure --timeout 120

      - name: Weak-memory stress (arm64 only, bounded)
        if: matrix.arch == 'arm64'
        run: |
          # Three bounded passes of at most 3 s per test; the strong variants
          # must never show a forbidden outcome.
          for _ in 1 2 3; do
            build/verify/stress/hqq_stress_litmus --iterations 400000 --seconds 3
          done

  # AddressSanitizer + UBSan and ThreadSanitizer on Linux.
  linux-sanitizers:
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.arch }} ${{ matrix.sanitizer }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 20

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [depot-ubuntu-24.04, depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm]
        sanitizer: [address+undefined, thread]
        include:
          - runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            arch: x86_64
          - runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm
            arch: arm64

    env:
      CC: clang-18
      CXX: clang++-18

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install compiler
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends clang-18 libclang-rt-18-dev cmake ninja-build
          # TSan cannot map its shadow memory with the default 32 bits of ASLR
          # entropy on recent kernels.
          sudo sysctl -w vm.mmap_rnd_bits=28 || true

      - name: Configure
        run: >
          cmake -S c -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DHQQ_WERROR=ON
          -DHQQ_SANITIZE=${{ matrix.sanitizer }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build

      - name: Test
        env:
          ASAN_OPTIONS: detect_leaks=1:strict_string_checks=1
          UBSAN_OPTIONS: print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1
          TSAN_OPTIONS: halt_on_error=1:second_deadlock_stack=1
        run: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure --timeout 300

  macos:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    name: macOS ${{ matrix.arch }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 20

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: depot-macos-latest
            arch: arm64

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Configure
        run: cmake -S c -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DHQQ_WERROR=ON

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build

      - name: Test
        run: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure --timeout 120

  windows:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    name: Windows ${{ matrix.arch }} ${{ matrix.compiler }}${{ matrix.experimental && ' (best effort)' || '' }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: depot-windows-2025
            arch: x64
            compiler: clang-cl
            cc: clang-cl
            cxx: clang-cl
            experimental: false

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up MSVC developer environment
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -property installationPath
          $vcvars = Join-Path $vsPath "VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat"
          cmd.exe /c "call `"$vcvars`" ${{ matrix.arch }} >nul && set" | ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') {
              if ($matches[1] -ieq 'PATH') {
                $entries = @($matches[2] -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
                [array]::Reverse($entries)
                $entries | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append -Encoding utf8
              } else {
                "$($matches[1])=$($matches[2])" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
              }
            }
          }

      - name: Configure
        shell: bash
        run: >
          cmake -S c -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DHQQ_WERROR=ON
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${{ matrix.cc }} -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${{ matrix.cxx }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build

      - name: Test
        run: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure --timeout 120

  # C++17 consumers of the public header (extern "C", no <stdatomic.h>).
  cxx17:
    name: C++17 ${{ matrix.cxx }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - cc: gcc-14
            cxx: g++-14
            packages: gcc-14 g++-14
          - cc: clang-18
            cxx: clang++-18
            packages: clang-18

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install compiler
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ${{ matrix.packages }} cmake ninja-build

      - name: Header-only syntax checks
        env:
          CC: ${{ matrix.cc }}
          CXX: ${{ matrix.cxx }}
        run: |
          for std in c++17 c++20 c++23; do
            "$CXX" -x c++ "-std=$std" -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror \
              -fsyntax-only c/include/hqq/hqq.h
          done
          "$CC" -x c -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror \
            -fsyntax-only c/include/hqq/hqq.h

      - name: Build and run the C++17 consumer
        env:
          CC: ${{ matrix.cc }}
          CXX: ${{ matrix.cxx }}
        run: |
          cmake -S c -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DHQQ_WERROR=ON \
            "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=$CC" "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=$CXX"
          cmake --build build --target test_cxx17
          build/tests/test_cxx17

  # Memory-model verification: GenMC (C11/RC11 model checker) and herd7
  # (axiomatic litmus tests). See spec/toolchain/VERIFICATION_TOOLING.md.
  memory-model:
    name: Memory model (GenMC, herd7)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            cmake make bc \
            "llvm-${GENMC_LLVM_MAJOR}-dev" "clang-${GENMC_LLVM_MAJOR}" "libclang-${GENMC_LLVM_MAJOR}-dev" \
            libffi-dev zlib1g-dev libedit-dev \
            opam ocaml-nox build-essential libgmp-dev pkg-config m4 unzip curl git

      - name: Harness host checks (syntax of every variant, then a short native pthread run)
        env:
          CC: clang-${{ env.GENMC_LLVM_MAJOR }}
        run: |
          c/verify/genmc/run.sh --check
          c/verify/genmc/run.sh --host 5000

      - name: Cache GenMC
        id: genmc-cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.local/genmc
          key: genmc-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ env.GENMC_COMMIT }}-llvm${{ env.GENMC_LLVM_MAJOR }}-${{ hashFiles('c/verify/install-genmc.sh') }}

      - name: Build GenMC
        if: steps.genmc-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        env:
          LLVM_MAJOR: ${{ env.GENMC_LLVM_MAJOR }}
          GENMC_COMMIT: ${{ env.GENMC_COMMIT }}
          JOBS: '4'
        run: c/verify/install-genmc.sh "$HOME/.local/genmc"

      - name: GenMC (ring core harnesses and handshake PoC; positive variants verify, negative variants fail)
        env:
          GENMC_TIMEOUT: '300'
        run: c/verify/genmc/run.sh --genmc "$HOME/.local/genmc/bin/genmc"

      # herd7 does not depend on GenMC: it runs even when the GenMC step failed,
      # so a failure of one tool does not hide the verdict of the other.
      - name: Cache herdtools7
        if: always()
        id: herd-cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.opam
          key: herdtools7-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ env.HERDTOOLS_VERSION }}-${{ hashFiles('c/verify/install-herd.sh') }}

      - name: Install herdtools7
        if: always() && steps.herd-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: c/verify/install-herd.sh

      - name: herd7 litmus tests (C11)
        if: always()
        run: |
          eval "$(opam env --switch=herd)"
          c/verify/litmus/run-herd.sh "$(command -v herd7)"

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '11 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  test:
    name: Go ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: >-
        ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
          && '{"os":["depot-ubuntu-24.04","depot-macos-latest","depot-windows-2025"]}'
          || '{"os":["depot-ubuntu-24.04"]}') }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Install Linux graph tools
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y graphviz
          dot -V

      - name: Run vet
        run: go vet ./...

      # The end-to-end suite of hqq-bindgen builds and starts a C server and runs
      # in its own workflow (bindgen.yml) with timeouts that fit it.
      - name: Run tests
        shell: bash
        run: go test $(go list ./... | grep -v '/bindgen/e2e/') -count=1 -timeout=90s

      - name: Run multi-process and lifecycle tests
        run: go test . -run 'TestMultiProcess|TestPeer|TestThirdEndpoint|TestListenDial|TestOpener|TestCloseDoesNotRemove|TestUnlinkRemovesStaleName|TestLargeMessageThresholdAPI' -count=2 -v -timeout=120s

      - name: Run race tests
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: go test -race $(go list ./... | grep -v '/bindgen/e2e/') -count=1 -timeout=120s

      - name: Run fuzz smoke tests
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          go test ./internal/protocol -run '^$' -fuzz=FuzzPacketRoundTrip -fuzztime=5s
          go test . -run '^$' -fuzz='^FuzzConsumeAdvancedChunk$' -fuzztime=5s
          go test . -run '^$' -fuzz='^FuzzOpenOverCorruptSuperblock$' -fuzztime=5s
          go test ./bindgen/idl -run '^$' -fuzz='^FuzzParse$' -fuzztime=5s
          go test ./bindgen/rt -run '^$' -fuzz='^FuzzDecodeResponse$' -fuzztime=5s
          go test ./bindgen/rt -run '^$' -fuzz='^FuzzDecodeValues$' -fuzztime=5s

  tlc:
    name: TLA+ Model Check
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Run TLC on MPMC specification
        run: sh scripts/tlc.sh

sources.content:
name: Interop

# Runs the HQQ interoperability matrix (interop/) over every implementation
# that has a helper executable: the Go helper always, the C helper when present.
# The helper contract is conformance/INTEROP_CLI.md.
#
# The C helper is c/tools/hqq_interop.c. The C steps below are guarded by
#   if: hashFiles('c/tools/hqq_interop.c') != ''
# and are skipped while that source file is absent. They build the CMake target
# named by HQQ_INTEROP_C_TARGET (clang-cl on Windows, as in c.yml) and add the
# helper to HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS as c=<path>.
#
# To add another implementation (Rust, C++, ...): add a build step that
# produces an executable named hqq-interop (hqq-interop.exe on Windows), then
# append ",<label>=<path>" to HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS in the "Run interop matrix" step.

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    # Weekly, Monday 03:17 UTC: long soak sizes (HQQ_INTEROP_LONG=1).
    - cron: '17 3 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  # CMake target of the C helper. Its executable is located under build-c/
  # by name (hqq-interop or this target name), so the target can change here.
  HQQ_INTEROP_C_TARGET: hqq_interop

jobs:
  # The Go helper is pure Go (no cgo), so one Ubuntu job cross-compiles it
  # for every test OS and shares the binaries through an artifact instead
  # of rebuilding it in each matrix cell.
  helper:
    name: Go interop helper
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Cross-compile the helper for every test OS
        shell: bash
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: '0'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p helpers
          GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o helpers/hqq-interop-linux ./cmd/hqq-interop
          GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -o helpers/hqq-interop-macos ./cmd/hqq-interop
          GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o helpers/hqq-interop-windows.exe ./cmd/hqq-interop

      - name: Upload helper binaries
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: hqq-interop-helper
          path: helpers/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  interop:
    needs: [helper]
    name: Interop ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: >-
        ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
          && '{"os":["depot-ubuntu-24.04","depot-macos-latest","depot-windows-2025"]}'
          || '{"os":["depot-ubuntu-24.04"]}') }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Download prebuilt Go helper
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: hqq-interop-helper
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/helpers

      # C helper gate: every step below is skipped while the C helper source
      # is absent (see the header comment).

      - name: Set up MSVC developer environment (C helper, Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && hashFiles('c/tools/hqq_interop.c') != ''
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -property installationPath
          $vcvars = Join-Path $vsPath "VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat"
          cmd.exe /c "call `"$vcvars`" x64 >nul && set" | ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') {
              if ($matches[1] -ieq 'PATH') {
                $entries = @($matches[2] -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
                [array]::Reverse($entries)
                $entries | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append -Encoding utf8
              } else {
                "$($matches[1])=$($matches[2])" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
              }
            }
          }

      - name: Configure C helper
        if: hashFiles('c/tools/hqq_interop.c') != ''
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Windows uses clang-cl, the supported Windows C compiler (see c.yml and
          # spec/toolchain/C_TOOLCHAIN.md): default MSVC cl fails the C11 atomics probe.
          args=(-S c -B build-c -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DHQQ_WERROR=ON)
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = "Windows" ]; then
            args+=(-G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-cl -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang-cl)
          fi
          cmake "${args[@]}"

      - name: Build C helper
        if: hashFiles('c/tools/hqq_interop.c') != ''
        shell: bash
        run: cmake --build build-c --config Release --target "$HQQ_INTEROP_C_TARGET"

      - name: Locate C helper
        id: c-helper
        if: hashFiles('c/tools/hqq_interop.c') != ''
        shell: bash
        run: |
          path="$(find build-c -type f \( -name hqq-interop -o -name hqq-interop.exe \
            -o -name "$HQQ_INTEROP_C_TARGET" -o -name "$HQQ_INTEROP_C_TARGET.exe" \) | head -n 1)"
          if [ -z "$path" ]; then
            echo "C helper executable not found under build-c" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          # Absolute path: the driver runs from the package directory.
          echo "path=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$path" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # Vectors are checked on depot-ubuntu-24.04 only. Superblock, ring, packet and
      # frame vectors are host independent and are compared in full. Golden
      # sequences exist per page family (only the host family is generated, and
      # only the families that are committed are compared), so they are compared
      # for the runner's page size alone.
      - name: Check golden vectors are reproducible
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          go run ./cmd/hqq-interop gen-vectors --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/vectors"
          diff -r -x sequences conformance/vectors "$RUNNER_TEMP/vectors"
          page="$(getconf PAGESIZE)"
          if [ -d "conformance/vectors/sequences/$page" ]; then
            diff -r "conformance/vectors/sequences/$page" "$RUNNER_TEMP/vectors/sequences/$page"
          fi

      - name: Conformance tests
        run: go test ./conformance/... -count=1 -timeout 15m

      - name: Run interop matrix
        shell: bash
        env:
          C_HELPER: ${{ steps.c-helper.outputs.path }}
          HQQ_INTEROP_LONG: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' && '1' || '' }}
        run: |
          case "$RUNNER_OS" in
            Linux) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-linux" ;;
            macOS) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-macos" ;;
            Windows) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-windows.exe" ;;
          esac
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" != "Windows" ]; then chmod +x "$helper"; fi
          impls="go=$helper"
          if [ -n "$C_HELPER" ]; then impls="$impls,c=$C_HELPER"; fi
          HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS="$impls" go test ./interop/... -count=1 -timeout 30m

sources.content:
name: Build and Test

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: 'Commit or branch to build and test (default: calling ref)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  GOENV: "off"
  GO_VERSION: '1.27.4'
  ZIG_VERSION: '0.17.1'
  ZIG_SHA256: '3581863e3cbcfd0fce0efc682ce7e9e93da96668a977791d356a26d2a7e9b17a'

jobs:
  build:
    name: build (${{ matrix.goos }}/${{ matrix.goarch }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - goos: linux
            goarch: amd64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            zig_target: x86_64-linux-musl
          - goos: linux
            goarch: arm64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            zig_target: aarch64-linux-musl
          - goos: darwin
            goarch: arm64
            runner: depot-macos-latest
            zig_target: ''
          - goos: darwin
            goarch: amd64
            runner: depot-macos-latest
            zig_target: ''
          - goos: windows
            goarch: amd64
            runner: depot-windows-2025
            zig_target: ''
          - goos: windows
            goarch: arm64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            zig_target: aarch64-windows-gnu
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}

      - name: Checkout HQQ core
        shell: bash
        run: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/gosuda/HQQ.git ../HQQ

      - name: Ensure build tools (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          if ! command -v ninja >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v xz >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ninja-build xz-utils
          fi

      - name: Select newest Xcode (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          xcode=$(ls -d /Applications/Xcode_*.app | sort -V | tail -1)
          sudo xcode-select -s "$xcode"
          xcodebuild -version
          clang --version

      - name: Set up MSVC developer environment (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -property installationPath
          $vcvars = Join-Path $vsPath "VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat"
          cmd.exe /c "call `"$vcvars`" x64 >nul && set" | ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') {
              if ($matches[1] -ieq 'PATH') {
                $entries = @($matches[2] -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
                [array]::Reverse($entries)
                $entries | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append -Encoding utf8
              } else {
                "$($matches[1])=$($matches[2])" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
              }
            }
          }

      - name: Build zstd_server (${{ matrix.goos }}/${{ matrix.goarch }})
        shell: bash
        env:
          ZIG_TARGET: ${{ matrix.zig_target }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tmp_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP"
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Windows" ]; then
            tmp_dir=$(cygpath -u "$RUNNER_TEMP")
          fi
          zdir=$(scripts/release/fetch-zstd.sh -d "$HOME/.cache/hqq-zstd/zstd-src")
          bdir="$tmp_dir/hqq-zstd-build"

          if [ -n "$ZIG_TARGET" ]; then
            mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/hqq-zstd"
            zig_tar="$HOME/.cache/hqq-zstd/zig.tar.xz"
            if ! echo "${ZIG_SHA256}  ${zig_tar}" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
                -o "$zig_tar" "https://ziglang.org/download/${ZIG_VERSION}/zig-x86_64-linux-${ZIG_VERSION}.tar.xz"
              echo "${ZIG_SHA256}  ${zig_tar}" | sha256sum -c -
            fi
            mkdir -p "$tmp_dir/zig"
            tar -xJ -f "$zig_tar" -C "$tmp_dir/zig" --strip-components=1
            "$tmp_dir/zig/zig" version
            "$tmp_dir/zig/zig" cc --version

            printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "%s/zig/zig" cc -target %s "$@"\n' "$tmp_dir" "$ZIG_TARGET" > "$tmp_dir/zig-cc"
            printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "%s/zig/zig" ar "$@"\n' "$tmp_dir" > "$tmp_dir/zig-ar"
            printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "%s/zig/zig" ranlib "$@"\n' "$tmp_dir" > "$tmp_dir/zig-ranlib"
            chmod +x "$tmp_dir/zig-cc" "$tmp_dir/zig-ar" "$tmp_dir/zig-ranlib"

            sys_name="Linux"
            sys_proc="x86_64"
            if [ "${{ matrix.goos }}" = "windows" ]; then
              sys_name="Windows"
              sys_proc="ARM64"
            elif [ "${{ matrix.goarch }}" = "arm64" ]; then
              sys_proc="aarch64"
            fi

            cmake -S server -B "$bdir" -G Ninja \
              -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME="$sys_name" \
              -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR="$sys_proc" \
              -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
              -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="$tmp_dir/zig-cc" \
              -DCMAKE_AR="$tmp_dir/zig-ar" \
              -DCMAKE_RANLIB="$tmp_dir/zig-ranlib" \
              -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-s" \
              -DHQQ_ZSTD_DIR="$zdir"
          elif [ "${{ matrix.goos }}" = "windows" ]; then
            clang-cl --version
            zdir=$(cygpath -m "$zdir")
            bdir=$(cygpath -m "$bdir")
            cmake -S server -B "$bdir" -G Ninja \
              -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
              -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-cl \
              -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang-cl \
              -DCMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=MultiThreaded \
              -DHQQ_ZSTD_DIR="$zdir"
          else
            osx_arch="arm64"
            if [ "${{ matrix.goarch }}" = "amd64" ]; then osx_arch="x86_64"; fi
            cmake -S server -B "$bdir" -G "Unix Makefiles" \
              -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
              -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES="$osx_arch" \
              -DHQQ_ZSTD_DIR="$zdir"
          fi

          cmake --build "$bdir" --target zstd_server
          mkdir -p dist
          ext=""
          if [ "${{ matrix.goos }}" = "windows" ]; then ext=".exe"; fi
          out="dist/zstd_server_${{ matrix.goos }}_${{ matrix.goarch }}${ext}"
          cp "$bdir/zstd_server${ext}" "$out"
          if [ "${{ matrix.goos }}" = "darwin" ]; then
            strip -x "$out"
            codesign --force --sign - "$out"
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: bin-${{ matrix.goos }}-${{ matrix.goarch }}
          path: dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  test:
    name: test (${{ matrix.name }})
    needs: [build]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: linux/amd64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            cc: clang-18
          - name: linux/arm64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm
            cc: clang-18
          - name: darwin/arm64
            runner: depot-macos-latest
            cc: clang
          - name: windows/amd64
            runner: depot-windows-2025
            cc: ''
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          fetch-tags: true

      - name: Checkout HQQ core
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/gosuda/HQQ.git ../HQQ

      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
          cache: false

      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Install the Linux test compiler
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends clang-18 cmake ninja-build

      - name: Ensure Ninja is installed (POSIX)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          if ! command -v ninja >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Linux" ]; then
              sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ninja-build
            else
              brew install ninja
            fi
          fi

      - name: Download built server binaries
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: bin-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Pin built binaries locally for testing
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" != "Windows" ]; then
            chmod +x dist/zstd_server_linux_* dist/zstd_server_darwin_*
          fi
          py=python3
          if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! python3 --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            py=python
          fi
          tag=$("$py" scripts/release/zstd-release.py next-tag)
          "$py" scripts/release/zstd-release.py update-hashes --dist dist --tag "$tag"

      - name: Run release script unit tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          py=python3
          if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! python3 --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            py=python
          fi
          "$py" -m unittest scripts/release/test_zstd_release.py -v

      - name: Run Go tests against embedded binary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          go vet ./...
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Windows" ]; then
            go test -short -v -timeout 10m ./...
          else
            go test -short -v -race -timeout 10m ./...
          fi

      - name: Run cgo cross-check tests (POSIX)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        env:
          CC: ${{ matrix.cc }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$(TMPDIR="$HOME/.cache/hqq-zstd/tmp" ./build.sh -b "$RUNNER_TEMP/hqq-zstd-build")"
          go test -short -v -race -timeout 10m -tags zstdcgo ./...

name: Release

on:

    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:

      tag:
        description: 'Release tag to publish (default: auto-computed next tag)'
        required: false

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:

jobs:
  build_and_test:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build-and-test.yml

  publish:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    needs: [build_and_test]
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.4'
          cache: false

      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: bin-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Attest SLSA Build Provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: 'dist/zstd_server_*'

      - name: Compute SHA256SUMS and pin embedded binaries
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin --tags
          if [ -n "$INPUT_TAG" ]; then
            tag="$INPUT_TAG"
          elif [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = "tag" ]; then
            tag="$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          else
            tag=$(python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py next-tag)
          fi
          echo "TAG=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          chmod +x dist/zstd_server_linux_* dist/zstd_server_darwin_*
          python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py update-hashes --dist dist --tag "$tag" --update-docs
          cat dist/SHA256SUMS
          cat hashes.go

          git add hashes.go internal/embedded/bin/ README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
          if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" != "tag" ] && ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git commit -m "chore(release): pin embedded binaries and digests for ${tag}"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi

      - name: Create or update GitHub Release
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          target=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" != "tag" ]; then
            git tag -f "$TAG" "$target"
            git push origin -f "refs/tags/$TAG"
          fi
          if gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" dist/* \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --target "$target" \
              --title "$TAG" \
              --generate-notes
          fi

sources.content:
name: Track Zstandard Releases

# Automatically checks upstream facebook/zstd releases on a schedule, pins new
# releases onto a staging branch, builds and tests all six platforms, and
# promotes passing builds to main with SLSA provenance, tag, and GitHub Release.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Upstream Zstandard version to pin (default: latest release)'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      force_release:
        description: 'Run build, test, and release even if Zstandard version is unchanged'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: track-zstd
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  GOENV: "off"

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      branch: ${{ steps.pin.outputs.branch }}
      zstd_version: ${{ steps.pin.outputs.zstd_version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - name: Check upstream Zstandard release and stage branch
        id: pin
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          FORCE_RELEASE: ${{ inputs.force_release }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          current=$(sed -n 's/^version=//p' third_party/zstd/VERSION)
          if [ -n "$INPUT_VERSION" ]; then
            target="${INPUT_VERSION#v}"
          else
            target=$(python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py latest)
          fi
          echo "Current pinned Zstandard: ${current}"
          echo "Target upstream Zstandard: ${target}"

          branch="auto-release/zstd-${target}-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          if [ "$target" != "$current" ]; then
            python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py pin --version "$target"
            if git diff --quiet -- third_party/zstd; then
              echo "No changes in third_party/zstd for ${target}"
              exit 0
            fi
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git switch -c "$branch"
            git add third_party/zstd
            git commit -m "third_party/zstd: update to Zstandard ${target}"
            git push origin "$branch"
            echo "branch=${branch}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "zstd_version=${target}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ "$FORCE_RELEASE" = "true" ]; then
            git switch -c "$branch"
            git push origin "$branch"
            echo "branch=${branch}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "zstd_version=${target}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "Zstandard ${target} is already pinned; nothing to release."
          fi

  build_and_test:
    needs: [check]
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: needs.check.outputs.branch != ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build-and-test.yml
    with:
      ref: ${{ needs.check.outputs.branch }}

  promote:
    needs: [check, build_and_test]
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.check.outputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.4'
          cache: false

      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Download tested server binaries
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: bin-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Attest SLSA Build Provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: 'dist/zstd_server_*'

      - name: Promote to main, tag, and publish GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ZSTD_VERSION: ${{ needs.check.outputs.zstd_version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main --tags
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD; then
            echo "main moved while build_and_test was running; aborting promote" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          chmod +x dist/zstd_server_linux_* dist/zstd_server_darwin_*
          tag=$(python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py next-tag --zstd-version "$ZSTD_VERSION")
          python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py update-hashes \
            --dist dist \
            --tag "$tag" \
            --zstd-version "$ZSTD_VERSION" \
            --update-docs
          cat dist/SHA256SUMS
          cat hashes.go

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git reset --soft origin/main
          git add third_party/zstd hashes.go internal/embedded/bin README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore(release): release ${tag} (Zstandard ${ZSTD_VERSION})"
            git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/main"
          fi

          target=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          git tag -f "$tag" "$target"
          git push origin -f "refs/tags/${tag}"
          if gh release view "$tag" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$tag" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$tag" dist/* \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --target "$target" \
              --title "$tag" \
              --generate-notes
          fi

  cleanup:
    needs: [check, build_and_test, promote]
    permissions:
      contents: write
    if: always() && needs.check.outputs.branch != ''
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
      - name: Delete temporary staging branch
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ needs.check.outputs.branch }}
        run: |
          if git ls-remote --exit-code origin "refs/heads/${BRANCH}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            git push origin --delete "$BRANCH"
          fi

sources.content:
name: Track Chromium

# Follows the Chromium Stable channel. When a new stable release appears:
#   1. pin: rewrites third_party/chromium with `engine.py pin` and pushes the commit to
#      chromium/<version>;
#   2. engine: builds and tests all six engines from that branch (engine.yml);
#   3. promote: attests the six engines that step 2 built and tested, computes the next Go
#      semver tag (`engine.py release-tag`), pins them in internal/embedded (binaries, hashes.go)
#      with their license texts, pushes the pins and binaries to main as one commit, tags the
#      commit, and publishes the GitHub release. The bot owns exactly those files in gosuda/0
#      (per-file OWNERS), so the lander lands the push into the monorepo tree.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Chromium version to pin (default: latest stable)'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
  attestations: write

concurrency:
  group: track-chromium
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  GOENV: "off"

jobs:
  pin:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    outputs:
      branch: ${{ steps.pin.outputs.branch }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
      - name: Pin the Chromium release
        id: pin
        env:
          INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(python3 scripts/engine/engine.py pin --version "${INPUT_VERSION:-latest-stable}")
          branch="chromium/$version"
          if git diff --quiet -- third_party/chromium; then
            echo "Chromium $version is already pinned"
            exit 0
          fi
          if git ls-remote --exit-code origin "refs/heads/$branch" >/dev/null; then
            echo "$branch already exists"
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git switch -c "$branch"
          git add third_party/chromium
          git commit -m "third_party/chromium: update to Chromium $version"
          git push origin "$branch"
          echo "branch=$branch" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  engine:
    needs: [pin]
    if: needs.pin.outputs.branch != ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/engine.yml
    with:
      ref: ${{ needs.pin.outputs.branch }}

  promote:
    needs: [pin, engine]
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.pin.outputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true
      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.3'
          cache: false
      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: engine-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Attest build provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: 'dist/chrome_net_server_*'
      - name: Push pins, tag, and publish GitHub release
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ needs.pin.outputs.branch }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main --tags
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD; then
            echo "main moved since the pin was made; rerun this workflow" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          chromium=$(sed -n 's/^version=//p' third_party/chromium/VERSION)
          tag=$(python3 scripts/engine/engine.py release-tag --chromium "$chromium")
          (cd dist && sha256sum chrome_net_server_* | sort -k2 > SHA256SUMS)
          cat dist/SHA256SUMS
          scripts/engine/pin-embedded.sh dist "$tag" "$chromium"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git reset --soft origin/main
          git add third_party/chromium internal/embedded
          git commit -m "net/chromenet: update to Chromium $chromium ($tag)" \
            -m "Pins the Chromium $chromium source archive and toolchains, and embeds the six chrome_net_server binaries built and tested from them."
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/main"
          git push origin --delete "$BRANCH"
          target=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          git tag "$tag" "$target"
          git push origin "refs/tags/$tag"
          if gh release view "$tag" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$tag" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$tag" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --target "$target" \
              --title "$tag" --generate-notes
          fi

sources.content:
name: Engine

# Builds chrome_net_server from the pinned Chromium release (third_party/chromium) and runs the Go
# tests against the fresh binaries. Linux and Windows engines build in a gvx sandbox on Linux;
# macOS engines build natively. release.yml calls this workflow to produce release binaries.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '47 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: 'Commit or branch to build (default: the calling commit)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  GOENV: "off"

jobs:
  build-linux-host:
    name: build ${{ matrix.target }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target: [linux-amd64, linux-arm64, windows-amd64, windows-arm64]
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 360
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.3'
          cache: false
      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Use the runner's scratch disk
        run: |
          sudo mkdir -p /mnt/chromenet-engine
          sudo chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /mnt/chromenet-engine
          df -h / /mnt
      - name: Cache the rungv release archive
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: /mnt/chromenet-engine/rungv-*.tar.gz
          key: rungv-${{ hashFiles('scripts/engine/BUILDENV') }}
      - name: Build ${{ matrix.target }} in gvx
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: scripts/engine/build.sh -w /mnt/chromenet-engine -d dist ${{ matrix.target }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: engine-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-macos:
    name: build ${{ matrix.target }}
    strategy:

sources.content:
name: Release

# Builds the six chrome_net_server binaries with engine.yml, attests their build provenance, pins
# them in internal/embedded (hashes.go and bin/), commits that to main as github-actions[bot] and
# publishes a GitHub release. The commit reaches gosuda/0 as an inbound mirror change that a
# member lands.

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Release tag to publish (default: next tag from latest v<major>.<minor> and Chromium version)'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
  attestations: write

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  GOENV: "off"

jobs:
  engine:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/engine.yml

  publish:
    needs: [engine]
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true
      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.3'
          cache: false
      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: engine-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Attest build provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: 'dist/chrome_net_server_*'
      - name: Pin binaries and digests
        env:
          INPUT_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin --tags
          chromium=$(sed -n 's/^version=//p' third_party/chromium/VERSION)
          if [ -n "$INPUT_TAG" ]; then
            tag="$INPUT_TAG"
          elif [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = "tag" ]; then
            tag="$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          else
            tag=$(python3 scripts/engine/engine.py release-tag --chromium "$chromium")
          fi
          echo "TAG=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          (cd dist && sha256sum chrome_net_server_* | sort -k2 > SHA256SUMS)
          cat dist/SHA256SUMS
          scripts/engine/pin-embedded.sh dist "$tag" "$chromium"
          git add internal/embedded third_party/chromium/notices
          if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" != "tag" ] && ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git commit -m "internal/embedded: pin chrome_net_server ${tag} (Chromium ${chromium})"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi
      - name: Create or update the GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          target=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" != "tag" ]; then
            git tag -f "$TAG" "$target"
            git push origin -f "refs/tags/$TAG"
          fi
          if gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --target "$target" \
              --title "$TAG" --generate-notes
          fi

sources.content:
name: Track Chromium

# Follows the Chromium Stable channel. When a new stable release appears:
#   1. pin: rewrites third_party/chromium with `engine.py pin` and pushes the commit to
#      chromium/<version>;
#   2. engine: builds and tests all six engines from that branch (engine.yml);
#   3. promote: attests the six engines that step 2 built and tested, computes the next Go
#      semver tag (`engine.py release-tag`), pins them in internal/embedded (binaries, hashes.go)
#      with their license texts, pushes the pins and binaries to main as one commit, tags the
#      commit, and publishes the GitHub release. The bot owns exactly those files in gosuda/0
#      (per-file OWNERS), so the lander lands the push into the monorepo tree.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Chromium version to pin (default: latest stable)'
        required: false
        type: string
      retry_existing:
        description: 'Rebuild this revision; only current main may promote the result'
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
  attestations: write

concurrency:
  group: track-chromium
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""

jobs:
  pin:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    outputs:
      branch: ${{ steps.pin.outputs.branch }}
      source: ${{ steps.pin.outputs.source }}
      source_is_main: ${{ steps.pin.outputs.source_is_main }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
      - name: Pin the Chromium release
        id: pin
        env:
          INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          RETRY_EXISTING: ${{ inputs.retry_existing }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          git fetch origin refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
          main=$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)
          printf 'source=%s\n' "$source" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf 'source_is_main=%s\n' "$([ "$source" = "$main" ] && printf true || printf false)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          version=$(python3 scripts/engine/engine.py pin --version "${INPUT_VERSION:-latest-stable}")
          branch="chromium/$version"
          changed=true
          if git diff --quiet -- third_party/chromium; then
            changed=false
            if [ "$RETRY_EXISTING" != true ] || [ "$source" = "$main" ]; then
              printf 'Chromium %s is already pinned in the selected revision\n' "$version"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          if [ "$source" != "$main" ]; then
            # Builds from other revisions can never promote; keep them off the shared branch.
            branch="$branch-try-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          elif [ "$RETRY_EXISTING" = true ]; then
            # Keep the failed version branch as evidence; retries get distinct refs.
            branch="$branch-retry-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          elif git ls-remote --exit-code origin "refs/heads/$branch" >/dev/null; then
            printf '%s already exists; dispatch with retry_existing=true to rebuild it\n' "$branch"
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git switch -c "$branch"
          if [ "$changed" = true ]; then
            git add third_party/chromium
            git commit -m "third_party/chromium: update to Chromium $version"
          fi
          git push origin "$branch"
          printf 'branch=%s\n' "$branch" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  engine:
    needs: [pin]
    if: needs.pin.outputs.branch != ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/engine.yml
    with:
      ref: ${{ needs.pin.outputs.branch }}

  promote:
    needs: [pin, engine]
    if: needs.pin.outputs.source_is_main == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.pin.outputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true
      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.3'
          cache: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: engine-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Attest build provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: 'dist/chrome_net_server_*'
      - name: Push pins, tag, and publish GitHub release
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ needs.pin.outputs.branch }}
          PIN_SOURCE: ${{ needs.pin.outputs.source }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main --tags
          if [ "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" != "$PIN_SOURCE" ]; then
            printf '%s\n' 'main moved since the pin was made; dispatch this workflow again from main with retry_existing=true for the failed version' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          chromium=$(sed -n 's/^version=//p' third_party/chromium/VERSION)
          tag=$(python3 scripts/engine/engine.py release-tag --chromium "$chromium")
          (cd dist && sha256sum chrome_net_server_* | sort -k2 > SHA256SUMS)
          cat dist/SHA256SUMS
          scripts/engine/pin-embedded.sh dist "$tag" "$chromium"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git reset --soft origin/main
          git add third_party/chromium internal/embedded
          git commit -m "net/chromenet: update to Chromium $chromium ($tag)" \
            -m "Pins the Chromium $chromium source archive and toolchains, and embeds the six chrome_net_server binaries built and tested from them."
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/main"
          git push origin --delete "$BRANCH"
          target=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          git tag "$tag" "$target"
          git push origin "refs/tags/$tag"
          if gh release view "$tag" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$tag" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$tag" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --target "$target" \
              --title "$tag" --generate-notes
          fi

          subject-path: 'dist/chrome_net_server_*'
      - name: Pin binaries and digests
        env:
          INPUT_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin --tags
          chromium=$(sed -n 's/^version=//p' third_party/chromium/VERSION)
          if [ -n "$INPUT_TAG" ]; then
            tag="$INPUT_TAG"
          elif [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = "tag" ]; then
            tag="$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          else
            tag=$(python3 scripts/engine/engine.py release-tag --chromium "$chromium")
          fi
          echo "TAG=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          (cd dist && sha256sum chrome_net_server_* | sort -k2 > SHA256SUMS)
          cat dist/SHA256SUMS
          scripts/engine/pin-embedded.sh dist "$tag" "$chromium"
          git add internal/embedded third_party/chromium/notices
          if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" != "tag" ] && ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git commit -m "internal/embedded: pin chrome_net_server ${tag} (Chromium ${chromium})"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi
      - name: Create or update the GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          target=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" != "tag" ]; then
            git tag -f "$TAG" "$target"
            git push origin -f "refs/tags/$TAG"
          fi
          if gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --target "$target" \
              --title "$TAG" --generate-notes
          fi

sources.content:
name: build

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  schedule:
    - cron: '47 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  linux:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        ocaml-compiler: ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && '["5.4.0","5.5.1"]' || '["5.5.1"]') }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    # Keep a finite bound; new Depot cold/warm runtimes need measurement.
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - id: stamp
        run: echo "month=$(date -u +%Y-%m)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        shell: bash
      - id: opam-restore
        uses: actions/cache/restore@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && 'C:/.opam' || '~/.opam' }}
            _opam
          key: opam-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-ocaml${{ matrix.ocaml-compiler }}-${{ hashFiles('dune-project', '*.opam', '.ocamlformat', '.github/workflows/build.yml') }}-${{ steps.stamp.outputs.month }}
      - uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@ff66428f72b64472e749b22e0ad4dded4b2ddca6 # v3
        id: ocaml
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: ${{ matrix.ocaml-compiler }}
          cache: false
      - id: deps
        run: opam install . --deps-only --with-test
      - id: fmt-tool
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.ocaml.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: opam install ocamlformat.0.29.0
      - uses: actions/cache/save@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.opam-restore.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' && steps.deps.outcome == 'success' && steps.fmt-tool.outcome == 'success' }}
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && 'C:/.opam' || '~/.opam' }}
            _opam
          key: ${{ steps.opam-restore.outputs.cache-primary-key }}

      # Save dependencies before a test can hang or fail.
      - run: opam exec -- dune build @fmt
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.fmt-tool.outcome == 'success' }}
      - run: opam exec -- dune build --profile release
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.deps.outcome == 'success' }}
      - run: opam exec -- dune runtest --profile release
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.deps.outcome == 'success' }}

  # The weekly/manual native suite checks platform-specific behavior.
  native:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [depot-macos-latest, depot-windows-2025]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    # Scheduling less often provides the cost cut; keep the complete suite.
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - id: stamp
        run: echo "month=$(date -u +%Y-%m)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        shell: bash
      - id: opam-restore
        uses: actions/cache/restore@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && 'C:/.opam' || '~/.opam' }}
            _opam
          key: opam-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-ocaml5.5.1-${{ hashFiles('dune-project', '*.opam', '.ocamlformat', '.github/workflows/build.yml') }}-${{ steps.stamp.outputs.month }}
      - uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@ff66428f72b64472e749b22e0ad4dded4b2ddca6 # v3
        id: ocaml
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: "5.5.1"
          windows-compiler: mingw
          cache: false
      - id: deps
        run: opam install . --deps-only --with-test
      # dune runtest builds the libraries first, but not the bin/
      # executables, so the explicit release build stays: it is the only
      # proof the shipped binaries compile on this platform.
      - uses: actions/cache/save@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.opam-restore.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' && steps.deps.outcome == 'success' }}
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && 'C:/.opam' || '~/.opam' }}
            _opam
          key: ${{ steps.opam-restore.outputs.cache-primary-key }}
      - run: opam exec -- dune build --profile release
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.deps.outcome == 'success' }}
      - run: opam exec -- dune runtest --profile release
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.deps.outcome == 'success' }}

        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: pnpm test

sources.content:
name: Benchmark

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '41 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      reset_history:
        description: Start a new benchmark history after the retained baseline expires
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && 'hqq-benchmark-history' || format('hqq-benchmark-skip-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  benchmarks:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    name: HQQ benchmarks
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Install Linux profiling dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y graphviz
          dot -V

      - name: Restore the latest trusted benchmark history
        if: ${{ !inputs.reset_history }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          page=1
          while true; do
            page_runs=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/benchmark.yml/runs?branch=main&status=completed&per_page=20&page=$page" \
              --jq '.workflow_runs')
            if [ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$page_runs")" -eq 0 ]; then break; fi
            runs=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.head_repository.full_name == env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY) | [.id, .conclusion] | @tsv' <<< "$page_runs")
            while IFS=$'\t' read -r run_id conclusion; do
              if [ -z "$run_id" ]; then continue; fi
              artifact=$(RUN_CONCLUSION="$conclusion" gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$run_id/artifacts" \
                --jq '[.artifacts[] | select((.name == "hqq-benchmark-history" or (.name == "hqq-benchmark-artifacts-Linux" and env.RUN_CONCLUSION == "success")) and .expired == false)] | sort_by(.name != "hqq-benchmark-history") | .[0].name // empty')
              if [ -n "$artifact" ]; then
                gh run download "$run_id" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
                  --name "$artifact" --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/benchmark-history"
                test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/benchmark-history/benchmark-data.json"
                cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/benchmark-history/benchmark-data.json" benchmark-data.json
                exit 0
              fi
            done <<< "$runs"
            page=$((page + 1))
          done
          printf '%s\n' '::error::No trusted benchmark history remains. Dispatch this workflow on main with reset_history=true to explicitly begin a new history.'
          exit 1

      - name: Run CPU-ratio performance tests
        env:
          HQQ_PERF_TESTS: '1'
        run: |
          go test ./... \
            -count=1 \
            -timeout 3m \
            -run '^(TestIdleLinkDoesNotBurnCPU|TestMPMCIdleWaitDoesNotBurnCPU|TestMPMCWaitSpinBurnsCPU)$' \
            -v

      - name: Run HQQ benchmarks
        run: |
          mkdir -p benchmark-artifacts/pprof
          go test . \
            -timeout 2m \
            -run '^$' \
            -bench 'Benchmark(StandardLink|AdvancedLink)' \
            -benchmem \
            -benchtime 100ms \
            -count 3 \
            -cpuprofile benchmark-artifacts/pprof/cpu.pprof \
            -memprofile benchmark-artifacts/pprof/mem.pprof \
            | tee benchmark.txt
          test_binary=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.test' -print -quit)
          if [ -z "$test_binary" ]; then
            echo "expected go test to leave a test binary for pprof" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          mv "$test_binary" benchmark-artifacts/pprof/hqq.test

      - name: Publish benchmark summary
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@a60cea5bc7b49e15c1f58f411161f99e0df48372 # v1.22.0
        with:
          name: HQQ Go Benchmark
          tool: go
          output-file-path: benchmark.txt
          external-data-json-path: benchmark-data.json
          summary-always: true
          # Informational only. Shared runners are noisy, and the action
          # treats every extra metric as smaller-is-better, so a throughput
          # (MB/s) improvement is reported as a regression; failing the job on
          # alerts would therefore flag improvements too.
          fail-on-alert: false
          alert-threshold: '130%'
          auto-push: false
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Preserve benchmark history
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: hqq-benchmark-history
          path: benchmark-data.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

      - name: Render pprof reports
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          go tool pprof -top -nodecount=50 \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/hqq.test \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/cpu.pprof \
            > benchmark-artifacts/pprof/cpu-top.txt
          go tool pprof -svg \
            -output benchmark-artifacts/pprof/cpu.svg \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/hqq.test \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/cpu.pprof
          go tool pprof -top -sample_index=alloc_space -nodecount=50 \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/hqq.test \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/mem.pprof \
            > benchmark-artifacts/pprof/mem-alloc-top.txt
          go tool pprof -svg -sample_index=alloc_space \
            -output benchmark-artifacts/pprof/mem-alloc.svg \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/hqq.test \
            benchmark-artifacts/pprof/mem.pprof

      - name: Upload benchmark artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: hqq-benchmark-artifacts-${{ runner.os }}
          path: |
            benchmark.txt
            benchmark-data.json
            benchmark-artifacts/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
