sources.content:
name: Bindings

# Builds and tests the language bindings of libhqq (bindings/cpp, bindings/rust).
# Every job builds the C library from the in-tree sources (c/),
# runs the binding's own tests and examples, and then runs the interop matrix
# (interop/, TestInteropMatrix) between the binding's hqq-interop helper and the
# Go helper built from cmd/hqq-interop. The helper contract is
# conformance/INTEROP_CLI.md; the C library is not changed by this workflow.

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'bindings/**'
      - 'c/**'
      - 'conformance/**'
      - 'interop/**'
      - 'cmd/hqq-interop/**'
      - '.github/workflows/bindings.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'bindings/**'
      - 'c/**'
      - 'conformance/**'
      - 'interop/**'
      - 'cmd/hqq-interop/**'
      - '.github/workflows/bindings.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  # The Go interop helper is pure Go (no cgo), so one Ubuntu job
  # cross-compiles it for every test OS and shares the binaries through
  # an artifact instead of rebuilding it in each of the seven cells below.
  helper:
    name: Go interop helper
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: false

      - name: Cross-compile the helper for every test OS
        shell: bash
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: '0'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p helpers
          GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o helpers/hqq-interop-linux ./cmd/hqq-interop
          GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -o helpers/hqq-interop-macos ./cmd/hqq-interop
          GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o helpers/hqq-interop-windows.exe ./cmd/hqq-interop

      - name: Upload helper binaries
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: hqq-interop-helper
          path: helpers/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  # ---- C++ -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # bindings/cpp: header-only C++17 wrapper, CMake target hqq::cpp.
  cpp:
    needs: [helper]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    name: C++ ${{ matrix.name }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: >-
        ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
          && '{"include":[{"name":"Linux gcc","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","cc":"gcc","cxx":"g++","build_type":"Release","sanitize":"none"},{"name":"Linux clang","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","cc":"clang-18","cxx":"clang++-18","build_type":"Debug","sanitize":"address+undefined"},{"name":"macOS clang","runner":"depot-macos-latest","cc":"clang","cxx":"clang++","build_type":"Release","sanitize":"none"},{"name":"Windows clang-cl","runner":"depot-windows-2025","cc":"clang-cl","cxx":"clang-cl","build_type":"Release","sanitize":"none"}]}'
          || '{"include":[{"name":"Linux gcc","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","cc":"gcc","cxx":"g++","build_type":"Release","sanitize":"none"},{"name":"Linux clang","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04","cc":"clang-18","cxx":"clang++-18","build_type":"Debug","sanitize":"address+undefined"}]}') }}

    env:
      CC: ${{ matrix.cc }}
      CXX: ${{ matrix.cxx }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install tools (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake ninja-build clang-18 libclang-rt-18-dev g++
          ${CC} --version

      - name: Set up MSVC developer environment (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -property installationPath
          $vcvars = Join-Path $vsPath "VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat"
          cmd.exe /c "call `"$vcvars`" x64 >nul && set" | ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') {
              if ($matches[1] -ieq 'PATH') {
                $entries = @($matches[2] -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
                [array]::Reverse($entries)
                $entries | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append -Encoding utf8
              } else {
                "$($matches[1])=$($matches[2])" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
              }
            }
          }

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Configure
        shell: bash
        run: >
          cmake -S bindings/cpp -B build-cpp -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }}
          -DHQQ_CPP_WERROR=ON
          -DHQQ_CPP_SANITIZE=${{ matrix.sanitize }}
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${{ env.CC }} -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${{ env.CXX }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build-cpp

      - name: Test
        env:
          ASAN_OPTIONS: detect_leaks=1:strict_string_checks=1
          UBSAN_OPTIONS: print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1
        run: ctest --test-dir build-cpp --output-on-failure --timeout 180

      - name: Require the Go helper for interoperability checks
        if: needs.helper.result != 'success'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "Standalone binding checks passed; interoperability is blocked by the failed Go helper job." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          printf '%s\n' "::error::Go helper prerequisite failed; interoperability has not been verified."
          exit 1

      - name: Download prebuilt Go helper
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: hqq-interop-helper
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/helpers

      - name: Interop matrix (Go and C++)
        shell: bash
        env:
          HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS_EXT: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '.exe' || '' }}
        run: |
          case "$RUNNER_OS" in
            Linux) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-linux" ;;
            macOS) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-macos" ;;
            Windows) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-windows.exe" ;;
          esac
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" != "Windows" ]; then chmod +x "$helper"; fi
          ext="$HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS_EXT"
          HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS="go=$helper,cpp=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/build-cpp/hqq-interop$ext" \
            go test ./interop -run '^TestInteropMatrix$' -count=1 -timeout 30m

  # ---- Rust ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # bindings/rust: workspace of hqq-sys (builds libhqq with the host C compiler),
  # hqq (safe wrapper) and hqq-interop. No crates.io dependencies.
  rust:
    needs: [helper]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    name: Rust ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: >-
        ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
          && '{"include":[{"os":"Linux","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04"},{"os":"macOS","runner":"depot-macos-latest"},{"os":"Windows","runner":"depot-windows-2025"}]}'
          || '{"include":[{"os":"Linux","runner":"depot-ubuntu-24.04"}]}') }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install and select Rust
        shell: bash
        working-directory: bindings/rust
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
          rustup default stable
          rustup show active-toolchain
          cargo --version

      - name: Set up MSVC developer environment (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -property installationPath
          $vcvars = Join-Path $vsPath "VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat"
          cmd.exe /c "call `"$vcvars`" x64 >nul && set" | ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') {
              if ($matches[1] -ieq 'PATH') {
                $entries = @($matches[2] -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
                [array]::Reverse($entries)
                $entries | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append -Encoding utf8
              } else {
                "$($matches[1])=$($matches[2])" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
              }
            }
          }

      # cl.exe fails the always-lock-free C11 atomics check of c/CMakeLists.txt on
      # this runner; clang-cl (the compiler of the C library's Windows CI job) passes.
      - name: Select clang-cl for the C library (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: echo "HQQ_CC=clang-cl" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.mod
            go.sum

      - name: Build
        working-directory: bindings/rust
        run: cargo build --workspace --release --locked

      - name: Test
        working-directory: bindings/rust
        run: cargo test --workspace --locked

      # Default shell (PowerShell on Windows). Git Bash (shell: bash) puts Git's usr/bin
      # link.exe (GNU coreutils) before the MSVC linker, so the example link fails there.
      # One command per step: each exit code fails its own step.
      - name: Examples (echo)
        working-directory: bindings/rust
        run: cargo run --release --locked -p hqq --example echo -- --selftest

      - name: Examples (rpc)
        working-directory: bindings/rust
        run: cargo run --release --locked -p hqq --example rpc -- --selftest

      - name: Require the Go helper for interoperability checks
        if: needs.helper.result != 'success'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "Standalone binding checks passed; interoperability is blocked by the failed Go helper job." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          printf '%s\n' "::error::Go helper prerequisite failed; interoperability has not been verified."
          exit 1

      - name: Download prebuilt Go helper
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: hqq-interop-helper
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/helpers

      - name: Interop matrix (Go and Rust)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          ext=""
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = "Windows" ]; then ext=".exe"; fi
          case "$RUNNER_OS" in
            Linux) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-linux" ;;
            macOS) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-macos" ;;
            Windows) helper="$RUNNER_TEMP/helpers/hqq-interop-windows.exe" ;;
          esac
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" != "Windows" ]; then chmod +x "$helper"; fi
          HQQ_INTEROP_IMPLS="go=$helper,rust=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/bindings/rust/target/release/hqq-interop$ext" \
            go test ./interop -run '^TestInteropMatrix$' -count=1 -timeout 30m

sources.title: Restore main checks and enforce the live sandbox probe
sources.content:
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: 1.99.1

jobs:
  rukie:
    name: ci / rukie
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Read the Go toolchain
        id: go_toolchain
        run: |
          go_version=$(sed -n 's/^toolchain go//p' go.mod)
          [[ "$go_version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          printf 'version=%s\n' "$go_version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        id: go
        with:
          go-version: ${{ steps.go_toolchain.outputs.version }}
          cache: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.sum
            Makefile
      - name: Provide supported Podman for the sandbox probe
        run: bash tools/ci-podman.sh
      - name: Verify Rukie, including the live sandbox
        run: |
          tools/passgate.sh '--- PASS: TestSandboxP11LiveProbe (' -- make check
  ruk-integration:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Read the Go toolchain
        id: go_toolchain
        run: |
          go_version=$(sed -n 's/^toolchain go//p' go.mod)
          [[ "$go_version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          printf 'version=%s\n' "$go_version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        id: go
        with:
          go-version: ${{ steps.go_toolchain.outputs.version }}
          cache: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.sum
            tools/ruk.pin
      - name: Check out pinned Ruk
        id: source
        run: |
          ruk_revision=$(<tools/ruk.pin)
          [[ "$ruk_revision" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          git init ruk
          git -C ruk remote add origin https://github.com/gosuda/ruk.git
          git -C ruk fetch --no-tags --depth 1 origin "$ruk_revision"
          git -C ruk checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
      - id: rust
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install "$RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2.9.3
        with:
          workspaces: ruk -> target
          cache-workspace-crates: true
          cache-bin: false
          save-if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@893d6ee8d714b6c7dfe2bcd94e5759e9a7958a7e # v2.90.10
        id: nextest
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.rust.outcome == 'success' }}
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest@0.9.148
          fallback: none
      - if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.rust.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
        working-directory: ruk
      - if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.rust.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings
        working-directory: ruk
      - run: |
          cargo nextest run --workspace --locked --no-fail-fast
        working-directory: ruk
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.nextest.outcome == 'success' }}
      - if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.rust.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          cargo test --workspace --locked --doc --no-fail-fast
        working-directory: ruk
      - id: build
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.rust.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          cargo build --manifest-path ruk/Cargo.toml --locked -p ruk
      - name: Export the pinned Ruk model
        id: model
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          ruk/target/debug/ruk model --format json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ruk-model.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.model.outcome == 'success' }}
        with:
          name: ruk-model-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ruk-model.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Test the daemon, SSH, and application startup
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.go.outcome == 'success' && steps.build.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          tools/passgate.sh \
            '--- PASS: TestDaemonLifecycle (' \
            '--- PASS: TestModelCLIMatchesSnapshot (' \
            '--- PASS: TestDaemonPushReconcilePagination (' \
            '--- PASS: TestGCRejectsUnavailableDaemonRepos (' \
            '--- PASS: TestSSHStockGitCloneAndPush (' \
            '--- PASS: TestDevLoopStarts (' -- \
            env RUK_BIN="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/ruk/target/debug/ruk" RUK_COORDINATOR=off \
            go test -race -count=1 -v -timeout 30m -tags integration \
            ./internal/ruk/... ./internal/gitssh/... ./internal/sysops/... ./cmd/rukie/...
      - name: Test Git and agent workflows against the daemon
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.go.outcome == 'success' && steps.build.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          tools/passgate.sh \
            '--- PASS: TestGitPushFetchRoundTrip (' \
            '--- PASS: TestConcurrentPushesSerialize (' \
            '--- PASS: TestRepositoryPurgeUsesOpenedPath (' \
            '--- PASS: TestAgentFlow (' \
            '--- PASS: TestAgentFlow/change (' -- \
            env RUK_BIN="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/ruk/target/debug/ruk" RUK_COORDINATOR=off \
            go test -race -count=1 -v -timeout 30m -tags e2e ./tests/e2e/...

sources.head: 50c84a974e4fef3fa7ed146b0480cf63a5e78b95
sources.title: ci: align workflow policy tests and isolate release Go configuration
sources.content:
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - '*.md'
      - 'LICENSE'
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/*.md'
  # A workflow that owns a required check must start for every PR or that check
  # remains pending.
  # The scope job below keeps docs-only PRs lightweight without suppressing the
  # required aggregate `build` context.
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  workflow_dispatch:
  # One weekly, off-peak UTC run of the full 206-language exhaustive CGo
  # parity sweep (parity-cgo-exhaustive), which otherwise only runs on
  # workflow_dispatch or a PR that touches a narrow parser-result, C-recovery,
  # or C-oracle path filter. exhaustive_parity_scope below turns run_exhaustive
  # on for this event.
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * 1'

# A scheduled run's github.ref is the default branch, the same ref pushes to
# main use. Give schedule its own concurrency group so a push to main never
# cancels an in-flight weekly exhaustive run (and vice versa); two
# overlapping scheduled runs still cancel each other, which is desired.
#
# cancel-in-progress stays true for pull_request runs, workflow_dispatch runs,
# and pushes to any non-default branch, so superseded work still gets
# cancelled quickly. It is false only for a push to the default branch: a
# rapid run of pushes to main was cancelling every prior in-flight run before
# it reported a verdict, so most commits on main never got a pass/fail result
# at all. main pushes now queue and each one finishes with its own verdict.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' && 'weekly-exhaustive' || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ !(github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') }}

# VM runner services can share HOME and /tmp. Isolate their native Go
# caches and scratch, and disable setup-go archives, which retain producer
# paths. Hosted runners keep their standard cache paths and warm builds.
env:
  GOWORK: 'off'
  GOMAXPROCS: '2'
  GOFLAGS: '-p=1'

# Correctness and timing jobs use isolated Depot VMs with 16 GiB of memory.
# Planning and aggregation use the smaller Depot runner.
jobs:
  compile:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Repository hygiene
        run: bash scripts/repository_hygiene_test.sh

      - name: Editor-latency scope rule tests
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/editor_latency_scope_test.sh
          bash .github/scripts/editor_latency_legs_test.sh

      - name: R6 engine and environment guardrails
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin main
          GOWORK=off go test ./cmd/v1guard -count=1
          GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/v1guard -base FETCH_HEAD

      - name: L0 root, API, and test-move guardrails
        run: |
          GOWORK=off go test ./cmd/v1layout -count=1
          GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/v1layout -base FETCH_HEAD

      - name: Randomized benchmark driver contracts
        run: bash scripts/run_randomized_benchmarks_test.sh

      - name: Verify pinned benchmark fixtures
        run: |
          python3 scripts/benchfixture_corpus.py verify --role sample
          GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/benchfixturehash

      - name: A0 manifest cascade refresher contracts and live check
        run: |
          bash scripts/refresh_a0_manifest_cascade_test.sh
          bash scripts/refresh_a0_manifest_cascade.sh --check --tracked

      - name: Verify test package execution coverage
        run: |
          go test ./cmd/citestplan -count=1
          go run ./cmd/citestplan

      - name: Verify workflow -run/--run test name references
        # Fails when a `-run`/`--run` pattern under .github/workflows/*.yml
        # names a Test/Benchmark/Fuzz/Example that no longer exists, so a
        # rename or deletion cannot leave a CI step silently testing
        # nothing. Root selectors resolve only against root tests.
        # See cmd/citestplan/staleruns.go.
        run: go run ./cmd/citestplan -stale-run-names

      - name: Build
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Build emergency parser
        run: go build -tags gts_no_parsercorephase0 ./...

      - name: Test emergency parser routing
        run: go test . -tags gts_no_parsercorephase0 -run '^TestAdmissionSwitchDefaultBuildFallsBackLoudly$' -count=1

      - name: Build without copyleft-licensed grammars
        # gotreesitter_no_copyleft excludes caddy, disassembly, jq, and nim
        # (GPL-3.0/MPL-2.0 upstream grammars) from the public registry and
        # drops their hand-ported scanner source from compilation. See
        # docs/licensing.md.
        run: go build -tags gotreesitter_no_copyleft ./...

      - name: Test copyleft grammar opt-out
        run: go test ./grammars/ -tags gotreesitter_no_copyleft -run '^TestCopyleftLanguageSetMatchesRegistry$' -count=1 -v

      - name: Build grammar subsets
        run: bash scripts/subset_build_sweep.sh

      - name: Vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Install staticcheck
        run: go install honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@v0.6.1

      - name: Staticcheck (real-bug checks only)
        # Scoped to SA4000 (identical binary operands), SA4003 (impossible
        # comparison after a truncating conversion), SA5011 (nil dereference
        # before a nil check), SA4006 (dead store), SA4009 (parameter
        # overwritten before use), and SA1019 (deprecated use). Test files
        # are in scope: the SA4006 findings that once lived in
        # internal/parsercorephase0 test fixtures are fixed, so the gate now
        # covers both production and test code. ./grammars/ and ./cmd/...
        # are clean under the same checks and stay in the gate.
        run: staticcheck -checks 'SA4000,SA4003,SA5011,SA4006,SA4009,SA1019' . ./internal/... ./grammargen/ ./grammars/ ./cmd/...

      - name: Test Compile
        run: go test ./... -run '^$' -count=1

      - name: Incremental invariant ledger does not increase
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$BASE_SHA"
          python3 scripts/check_incremental_invariant_ledger.py "$BASE_SHA"

      - name: Incremental invariant sessions and no-edit allocation gate
        run: |
          GOWORK=off go test . \
            -run '^(TestIssue454ReconstructedSessionMatrix|TestIncrementalInvariantProbeLedger|TestIncrementalNoEditAllocations)$' \
            -count=1 -timeout=10m -v

      - name: Test immediate token precedence
        run: GOMAXPROCS=1 go test ./grammargen -run '^(TestBuildLexDFAPreservesLongerPreferredTokenAfterImmediateAccept|TestNormalizeNamedImmediateTokenKeepsAuthoredPrecedence)$' -count=1 -timeout=2m

      - name: Test generated repeat associativity
        run: GOMAXPROCS=1 go test ./grammargen -run '^TestResolveActionConflictVisibleLoweredRepeatBodyAssociativity$' -count=1 -timeout=2m

      - name: Test generated supertype aliases
        run: GOMAXPROCS=1 go test ./grammargen -run '^TestSupertypeMap(UsesPublicAlias|DeduplicatesPublicAliases)$' -count=1 -timeout=2m

  selected_store_admission:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Selected-store internal package (staged and one-pass)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test -race ./internal/parsercorephase0 -count=1
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test -race -tags gts_parsercorephase0_selectedstore_onepass ./internal/parsercorephase0 -count=1

      - name: Selected-store exact admission (staged and one-pass)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          admission='^TestDiagnosticParserCoreSelectedStore(CanonicalAdmissions|CompletenessFailureReleasesBacking|GoHighlightParity|QueryDirectiveParity)$'
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test -tags gts_parsercorephase0 . -run "$admission" -count=1
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test -tags 'gts_parsercorephase0 gts_parsercorephase0_selectedstore_onepass' . -run "$admission" -count=1

  compact_admission_ratchet:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Validate compact admission breadth, route precedence, depth, and incremental bridge
        # GTS_COMPAT_TAIL_ELISION_EXHAUSTIVE=1 adds the full-registry (206
        # language) compat-tail elision equivalence gate
        # (TestCompatTailElisionEquivalenceSmokeExhaustive,
        # admission_compat_tail_elision_test.go) to this lane. It shares this
        # lane's own reason for gating a full-registry sweep behind an opt-in
        # env var instead of running it unconditionally (loading every
        # registered grammar in one process disturbs
        # TestArenaGCRetentionAfterRelease elsewhere in this package's
        # default suite); this lane's own `-run` selection already excludes
        # that test, so the two do not interact here. Measured added cost is
        # a few seconds.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GTS_ADMISSION_SCORECARD=1 \
          GTS_ADMISSION_SCORECARD_RATCHET=1 \
          GTS_COMPAT_TAIL_ELISION_EXHAUSTIVE=1 \
          GOMAXPROCS=1 \
          go test -tags gts_parsercorephase0 . \
            -run '^(TestAdmissionCandidateScorecard206|TestAdmissionSwitchRoutePrecedenceRatchet|TestAdmissionCandidateYAMLZeroWidthDepth|TestAdmissionCandidateRepresentativeDepthRatchet|TestAdmissionCompactTreeCarriesIncrementalReuseProof|TestCompactJavaScriptRecoveryIncrementalReuse|TestDiagnosticParserCoreClassifiedBoundaryAndReductionPlanShape|TestDiagnosticParserCoreSummaryReceiptPreservesExactRewrite|TestCompatTailElisionEquivalenceSmokeExhaustive)$' \
            -count=1 -timeout 10m

  phase0_tagged_suite:
    # gts_parsercorephase0-tagged root-package tests reachable by no other
    # CI lane. docs/ci-gate-coverage.md (2026-08-02) found 277 tagged
    # top-level functions with only about a dozen executed by the two narrow
    # -run allow-lists above (selected_store_admission,
    # compact_admission_ratchet) plus the compact-per-version-lexer-scala
    # docker lane. This job runs most of the remainder (issue #1052).
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Tagged root-package tests outside the narrow allow-lists
        # The 333 names below (recounted 2026-09-18 after removing 3 stale
        # references to a deleted test file and fixing 2 renamed references;
        # see cmd/citestplan -stale-run-names) passed, or skipped on a
        # missing fixture or env var, in a full-set local measurement (1
        # process, 86.6s wall, 1.5 GiB max RSS). One name per line keeps the
        # diff reviewable; the
        # script below joins them into one anchored -run regex at run time,
        # the same allow-list convention the two lanes above use. -timeout
        # is set to roughly twice the measured wall time.
        #
        # Elm and external-payload contracts run in isolated grammar steps below.
        # 10 tagged tests are excluded, not fixed here (out of scope for
        # this maintenance lane; see docs/ci-gate-coverage.md Part 4):
        #   TestDiagnosticParserCoreConflictAllUnchangedPauses: conflict creation sequence overflow
        #   TestDiagnosticParserCoreConflictFiltersUnchangedArm: conflict creation sequence overflow
        #   TestDiagnosticParserCoreGenericSchedulerCapsPublishNothing: no_action drop coverage mismatch (before-accept)
        #   TestDiagnosticParserCoreGenericSchedulerClosesAtRequestedByte: scheduler work-counter mismatch
        #   TestDiagnosticParserCoreGenericSchedulerContinuesToNextRequestedClosedByte: continuation-result mismatch
        #   TestDiagnosticParserCoreGenericSchedulerCrossesMultiHeadExtraCohort: brace-baseline mismatch
        #   TestDiagnosticParserCoreGenericSchedulerCrossesReductionFreshnessCycle: byte-closure mismatch
        #   TestDiagnosticParserCoreStateDependentRelexKeepsExactSpanBranch: no_action drop coverage mismatch
        #   TestG18DropPathRejectsForeignInlineRED: RED — foreign inline lineage certified a current-arena drop
        #   TestG18D6aProducerTelemetry: order-dependent — fails only inside this full set (D3 pool baseline drift)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tests='
          TestAdmissionCandidateBoundedRecursiveInsertionCorpus
          TestAdmissionCandidateCooklangSmokeRatchet
          TestAdmissionCandidateDFASmokeMatchesPreferredTokenSource
          TestAdmissionCandidateGraphQLRootFieldsDirect
          TestAdmissionCandidateNoLookaheadSmokeRatchet
          TestAdmissionCandidateRealCorpusMatrix
          TestAdmissionCandidateScorecardExactDenominator
          TestAdmissionCandidateSvelteButtonDirect
          TestAdmissionCandidateTokenSourceEntriesExposeDFASmoke
          TestAdmissionRouteEqualitySwiftCloseAngleDeferralWitnessesStillFallBack
          TestAdmissionScorecardLabelsProductionErrorTree

  admission_route_equality_fuzz:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Route-equality seed corpus regression (required)
        # TestAdmissionRouteEqualityLockedCExceptions was removed for issue
        # 984 (production now matches tree-sitter C output for those
        # inputs); FuzzAdmissionRouteEquality's seed corpus carries the same
        # fixed inputs directly, so it alone covers this regression.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test . -run '^FuzzAdmissionRouteEquality$' -count=1 -v

      - name: Route-equality bounded live fuzzing, 45s (advisory)
        # Keep this non-blocking until clean-cache, per-language soaks bound
        # the workload and reproduce or retire the reported Haskell residual.
        run: |
          set +e
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test . -run '^$' -fuzz '^FuzzAdmissionRouteEquality$' -fuzztime=45s
          status=$?
          set -e

          if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::warning::route-equality live fuzzing found a divergence (status ${status}); informational until the clean-cache promotion gate completes."
            {
              echo "### Admission Route-Equality Live Fuzzing"
              echo
              echo "\`go test . -run '^\$' -fuzz FuzzAdmissionRouteEquality -fuzztime=45s\` exited with status \`${status}\`."
              echo
              echo "This step is informational until clean-cache, per-language promotion soaks complete."
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

  race_root_shards:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Root Package Race Tests, Examples, and Fuzz Targets (shard ${{ matrix.shard }} of 5)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p harness_out/root-race
          pattern="$(bash .github/scripts/root_race_shard.sh regex "${{ matrix.shard }}" 5)"
          go test . -race -count=1 -timeout 15m -run "$pattern" -json |
            tee "harness_out/root-race/shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json"

  root_race_plan:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      isolated: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.isolated }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - id: plan
        name: Plan isolated root race gates
        run: echo "isolated=$(bash .github/scripts/root_race_shard.sh isolated-json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  race_root_isolated:
    needs:
      - exhaustive_parity_scope
      - root_race_plan
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target: ${{ fromJSON(needs.root_race_plan.outputs.isolated) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Root Package Isolated Race Gate (${{ matrix.target }})
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p harness_out/root-race
          go test . -race -count=1 -timeout 15m -run '^${{ matrix.target }}$' -json |
            tee "harness_out/root-race/isolated-${{ matrix.target }}.json"

  # Preserve the existing aggregate job ID consumed by the required `build`
  # context. The matrix result is successful only when every race shard passes.
  race_root:
    needs:
      - exhaustive_parity_scope
      - race_root_shards
      - race_root_isolated
    if: always() && needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check root race shards
        env:
          SHARDS_RESULT: ${{ needs.race_root_shards.result }}
          ISOLATED_RESULT: ${{ needs.race_root_isolated.result }}
        run: |
          if [ "$SHARDS_RESULT" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::race_root_shards finished with result=${SHARDS_RESULT}"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$ISOLATED_RESULT" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::race_root_isolated finished with result=${ISOLATED_RESULT}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All root race shards and isolated gates passed"

  race_packages:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: cmd
            package_filter: '/cmd/'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: grammarreceipt
            package_filter: '/internal/grammarreceipt$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: grammars-a-c
            package_filter: '/grammars($|/runtime$)'
            test_filter: '^(Test[A-C].*)$'
          - name: grammars-d-j
            package_filter: '/grammars($|/runtime$)'

          - name: grammars-k-p
            package_filter: '/grammars($|/runtime$)'

          - name: grammars-q-z

          - name: grammars-other

          - name: grammargen-support

          - name: parser-result

          - name: support

            test_filter: ''
          - name: grammar-support

            test_filter: ''
          - name: query

            test_filter: ''
          - name: highlight

            test_filter: ''
          - name: parse

          - name: wasm

          - name: recover

          - name: ccore

            test_filter: ''
          - name: ccore-bind
