  perf-regression:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Benchmark correctness and advisory thresholds
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PERF_LEGACY_BASE_SHA: 7a29f591d7fcc54b3d0639b3e38a1bacd8fcb386
          # Contract rebased after the 2026-07-11 audit proved the old
          # BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA silently enabled no-tree mode. This floor
          # is the first commit where that benchmark calls Parser.Parse and
          # measures a fully materialized tree; parser-core attribution moved
          # to BenchmarkGoParseCoreDFA. Never compare the corrected public
          # full-parse lane with the retired parser-core numbers.
          PERF_BENCH_CONTRACT_BASE_SHA: 1717ce84179a850501ec86684f80a77e24d661a8
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="${BASE_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD^)}"

          BENCH_RE='^(BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA|BenchmarkGoParseIncrementalSingleByteEditDFA|BenchmarkGoParseIncrementalNoEditDFA)$'
          BENCH_REQUIRED='BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA,BenchmarkGoParseIncrementalSingleByteEditDFA,BenchmarkGoParseIncrementalNoEditDFA'
          OUT_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/bench-gate"
          BASE_TREE="${RUNNER_TEMP}/bench-base"
          mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"

          GATE_BASE_SHA="${BASE_SHA}"
          if git fetch --no-tags origin "${PERF_BENCH_CONTRACT_BASE_SHA}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "${PERF_BENCH_CONTRACT_BASE_SHA}" "${BASE_SHA}"; then
              GATE_BASE_SHA="${PERF_BENCH_CONTRACT_BASE_SHA}"
            fi
          fi
          if [ "${GATE_BASE_SHA}" = "${BASE_SHA}" ] && git fetch --no-tags origin "${PERF_LEGACY_BASE_SHA}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "${PERF_LEGACY_BASE_SHA}" "${BASE_SHA}"; then
              GATE_BASE_SHA="${PERF_LEGACY_BASE_SHA}"
            fi
          fi
          echo "perf gate base: ${GATE_BASE_SHA} (pr base: ${BASE_SHA})"

          # The legacy base needs a higher node budget for comparable full-parse
          # results. The benchmark-contract floor already uses current settings.
          BENCH_NODE_SCALE=""
          if [ "${GATE_BASE_SHA}" = "${PERF_LEGACY_BASE_SHA}" ]; then
            BENCH_NODE_SCALE="3"
            echo "perf gate: using GOT_PARSE_NODE_LIMIT_SCALE=${BENCH_NODE_SCALE} for benchmark comparability"
          fi

          git fetch --no-tags origin "${BASE_SHA}" "${GATE_BASE_SHA}"
          git worktree add "${BASE_TREE}" "${GATE_BASE_SHA}"
          PR_BASE_TREE=""
          cleanup_bench_worktrees() {
            if [ -n "${PR_BASE_TREE}" ]; then
              git worktree remove --force "${PR_BASE_TREE}" || true
            fi
            git worktree remove --force "${BASE_TREE}"
          }
          trap cleanup_bench_worktrees EXIT

          export GOMAXPROCS=1
          run_paired_comparison() {
            local baseline_root=$1
            local baseline_output=$2
            local head_output=$3
            local args=(
              --baseline-root "${baseline_root}"
              --baseline-output "${baseline_output}"
              --output "${head_output}"
              --lock-path "/tmp/gotreesitter-ci-bench-${UID}.lock"
              --runs 20 --seed-start 1 --benchtime 750ms
              --primary-go-suite --package . --tags ''
              --require-benchmarks "${BENCH_REQUIRED}"
            )
            if [ -n "${BENCH_NODE_SCALE}" ]; then
              GOT_PARSE_NODE_LIMIT_SCALE="${BENCH_NODE_SCALE}" \
                bash scripts/run_randomized_benchmarks.sh "${args[@]}"
            else
              bash scripts/run_randomized_benchmarks.sh "${args[@]}"
            fi
          }
          run_paired_comparison "${BASE_TREE}" "${OUT_DIR}/base.txt" "${OUT_DIR}/head.txt"
          if [ "${GATE_BASE_SHA}" != "${BASE_SHA}" ]; then
            PR_BASE_TREE="${RUNNER_TEMP}/bench-pr-base"
            git worktree add "${PR_BASE_TREE}" "${BASE_SHA}"
            run_paired_comparison "${PR_BASE_TREE}" "${OUT_DIR}/pr_base.txt" "${OUT_DIR}/pr_head.txt"
            git worktree remove --force "${PR_BASE_TREE}"
            PR_BASE_TREE=""
            echo "informational compare vs PR base (non-blocking):"
            if ! go run ./cmd/benchgate \
              -base "${OUT_DIR}/pr_base.txt" \
              -head "${OUT_DIR}/pr_head.txt" \
              -max-ns-regression 10 \
              -max-bytes-regression 10 \
              -max-allocs-regression 10; then
              echo "informational compare vs PR base unavailable (missing benchmarks/metrics)"
            fi
          fi

          BASE_RSS_BIN="${OUT_DIR}/base_rss.test"
          HEAD_RSS_BIN="${OUT_DIR}/head_rss.test"
          (cd "${BASE_TREE}" && go test -c -o "${BASE_RSS_BIN}" .)
          go test -c -o "${HEAD_RSS_BIN}" .

          if [ -n "${BENCH_NODE_SCALE}" ]; then
            (
              cd "${BASE_TREE}" && \
              GOT_BENCH_FUNC_COUNT=5000 GOT_PARSE_NODE_LIMIT_SCALE="${BENCH_NODE_SCALE}" /usr/bin/time -v \
              "${BASE_RSS_BIN}" -test.run '^$' -test.bench '^BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA$' -test.benchmem -test.count=1 -test.benchtime=3x \
              > "${OUT_DIR}/base_rss_bench.txt" 2> "${OUT_DIR}/base_rss_time.txt"
            )
            GOT_BENCH_FUNC_COUNT=5000 GOT_PARSE_NODE_LIMIT_SCALE="${BENCH_NODE_SCALE}" /usr/bin/time -v \
              "${HEAD_RSS_BIN}" -test.run '^$' -test.bench '^BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA$' -test.benchmem -test.count=1 -test.benchtime=3x \
              > "${OUT_DIR}/head_rss_bench.txt" 2> "${OUT_DIR}/head_rss_time.txt"
          else
            (
              cd "${BASE_TREE}" && \
              GOT_BENCH_FUNC_COUNT=5000 /usr/bin/time -v \
              "${BASE_RSS_BIN}" -test.run '^$' -test.bench '^BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA$' -test.benchmem -test.count=1 -test.benchtime=3x \
              > "${OUT_DIR}/base_rss_bench.txt" 2> "${OUT_DIR}/base_rss_time.txt"
            )
            GOT_BENCH_FUNC_COUNT=5000 /usr/bin/time -v \
              "${HEAD_RSS_BIN}" -test.run '^$' -test.bench '^BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA$' -test.benchmem -test.count=1 -test.benchtime=3x \
              > "${OUT_DIR}/head_rss_bench.txt" 2> "${OUT_DIR}/head_rss_time.txt"
          fi

          # benchgate applies a minimum +1 alloc/op floor for low-allocation
          # benches, so we can keep strict ratio thresholds.
          gate_status=0
          go run ./cmd/benchgate \
            -base "${OUT_DIR}/base.txt" \
            -head "${OUT_DIR}/head.txt" \
            -base-rss "${OUT_DIR}/base_rss_time.txt" \
            -head-rss "${OUT_DIR}/head_rss_time.txt" \
            -max-ns-regression 0.08 \
            -max-bytes-regression 0.05 \
            -max-allocs-regression 0.05 \
            -max-rss-regression 0.10 || gate_status=$?

          if [ "${gate_status}" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::warning::performance thresholds exceeded; keep the result visible as directional evidence"
            {
              echo "### Advisory Performance Result"
              echo ""
              echo "- outcome: \`REGRESSION_RECORDED\`"
              echo "- release effect: non-blocking"
              echo "- required action: document the tradeoff and continue optimization work"
            } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
          fi

          # Keep edit attribution separate from the unchanged timing inputs.
          # Capture the runner CPU because hosted depot-ubuntu-24.04 spans hardware.
          if ! bash scripts/run_go_edit_attribution.sh "${BASE_TREE}" \
            "${OUT_DIR}/edit-attribution" "${BASE_RSS_BIN}" "${HEAD_RSS_BIN}"; then
            echo "::warning::edit attribution is unavailable; the completed benchmark comparison remains valid"
            printf '%s\n' '- edit attribution: unavailable (advisory)' >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
          fi

      - name: Perf Definitive Outcome Summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUT_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/bench-gate"
          if [ "$(tail -n 1 "${OUT_DIR}/base.txt" 2>/dev/null)" != '# status: complete' ] || \
             [ "$(tail -n 1 "${OUT_DIR}/head.txt" 2>/dev/null)" != '# status: complete' ]; then
            {
              echo "### Perf Definitive Outcome"
              echo ""
              echo "- outcome: \`INCONCLUSIVE\`"
              echo "- reason: randomized benchmark campaign is missing or incomplete"
            } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
            exit 0
          fi

          go run ./cmd/benchgate \
            -base "${OUT_DIR}/base.txt" \
            -head "${OUT_DIR}/head.txt" \
            -max-ns-regression 0.08 \
            -max-bytes-regression 0.05 \
            -max-allocs-regression 0.05 \
            -exit-on-fail=false \
            -post-definitive \
            -definitive-output "${OUT_DIR}/definitive.md" || true

          if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/definitive.md" ]; then
            cat "${OUT_DIR}/definitive.md" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
          else
            {
              echo "### Perf Definitive Outcome"
              echo ""
              echo "- outcome: \`INCONCLUSIVE\`"
              echo "- reason: no definitive win/loss from current thresholds"
            } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
          fi

sources.content:
name: cliff-report

on:
  # Weekly reports measure the default branch; manual runs measure the selected ref.
  schedule:
    - cron: '53 1 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# VM runner services can share HOME and /tmp. Isolate their native Go
# caches and scratch, and disable setup-go archives, which retain producer
# paths. Hosted runners keep their standard cache paths and warm builds.
env:
  GOWORK: 'off'
  GOMAXPROCS: '2'
  GOFLAGS: '-p=1'

jobs:
  cliff-detector:
    # Workstream R7 reports failures. Graduation makes this gate blocking.
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - name: Measure the cliff and apply the report-only rule
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        env:
          # A scheduled run always measures the default branch, so it does not
          # depend on the event payload naming that branch.
          GTS_CLIFF_ON_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The commit is hex, the event name is a fixed word, and the branch
          # flag is true or false, so all three are safe in the command string.
          # They land in every report row. Never add a branch name here: it can
          # hold shell metacharacters.
          flock /tmp/gts-docker.lock bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
            --wall-timeout 140m -- "GTS_CLIFF_REVISION=$GITHUB_SHA GTS_CLIFF_EVENT=$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME GTS_CLIFF_ON_DEFAULT_BRANCH=$GTS_CLIFF_ON_DEFAULT_BRANCH bash /workspace/scripts/run_cliff_report_in_docker.sh"

      # A cliff-rule failure stays report-only, so the measure step cannot turn
      # the run red. A missing report is different: the run did not measure what
      # it should have. A weekly fails on it, so a partial weekly cannot pass
      # for a good one. A pull request run or a manual run only warns.
      - name: Check that every expected report exists
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          GTS_CLIFF_EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          dir=harness_out/cliffs
          problems=()
          if [[ ! -s "$dir/expected.txt" ]]; then
            problems+=("$dir/expected.txt is missing or empty, so the run never reached the measurement.")
          else
            # The second test keeps a last line that has no newline.
            while IFS= read -r fixture || [[ -n "$fixture" ]]; do
              if [[ ! -s "$dir/$fixture.json" ]]; then
                problems+=("Missing cliff report: $fixture")
              fi
            done < "$dir/expected.txt"
          fi
          if [[ -e "$dir/fixture-table.FAILED" ]]; then
            problems+=("TestCliffFixtureTable failed. The measure step log has its output.")
          fi
          if [[ ${#problems[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "Every expected cliff report exists."
            exit 0
          fi
          level=warning
          if [[ "$GTS_CLIFF_EVENT" == schedule ]]; then
            level=error
          fi
          for problem in "${problems[@]}"; do
            echo "::$level::$problem"
          done
          if [[ "$level" == error ]]; then
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Upload the cliff report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          # The name carries the trigger and the measured commit, so a weekly
          # report on main cannot pass for a pull request report, or the
          # reverse. A manual run also says whether it measured the default
          # branch. It repeats the test from the measure step, because a step
          # env value is not visible here. For a pull request the commit is the
          # merge commit.
          name: cliff-report-${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' && 'weekly' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'pr' || github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) && 'manual-main' || 'manual-branch' }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: harness_out/cliffs/*.json
          if-no-files-found: warn

sources.content:
name: cross-platform-smoke

# Nightly focused checks on platforms that ci.yml does not cover: macOS
# arm64, Windows, Linux arm64, and wasip1 under a WASI runtime. The set is
# small on purpose (vet and short tests for grammars, internal, and grep).
# It does not run the root package or grammargen.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 5 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: cross-platform-smoke
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  GOWORK: 'off'

jobs:
  native:
    name: native (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # macos-14 images retire on 2026-11-02 (actions/runner-images#13518).
        os: [depot-macos-latest, depot-windows-2025, depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Vet
        shell: bash
        run: go vet ./grammars/... ./internal/... ./grep

      - name: Test
        shell: bash
        run: go test -short -count=1 -p 2 ./grammars/... ./internal/... ./grep

  wasip1:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      # Go's wasip1 exec wrapper reads GOWASIRUNTIME and runs `wazero`.
      GOWASIRUNTIME: wazero
      WAZERO_VERSION: v1.9.0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Build every package
        env:
          GOOS: wasip1
          GOARCH: wasm
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Install wazero
        run: go install "github.com/tetratelabs/wazero/cmd/wazero@${WAZERO_VERSION}"

      - name: Test small packages under wazero
        env:
          GOOS: wasip1
          GOARCH: wasm
        run: |
          export PATH="$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin"
          # Go 1.24 moved the exec wrapper from misc/wasm to lib/wasm; go.mod
          # pins Go 1.22, so use whichever path this toolchain has.
          wasm_exec="$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/go_wasip1_wasm_exec"
          [ -x "$wasm_exec" ] || wasm_exec="$(go env GOROOT)/misc/wasm/go_wasip1_wasm_exec"
          go test -short -count=1 -exec "$wasm_exec" \
            ./internal/luapattern ./internal/syntaxfacts ./internal/benchorder

sources.content:
name: fuzz-nightly

# Nightly coverage-guided fuzzing discovers Fuzz targets in every package.
# The target list comes from `go test -json -list`, so a new package or fuzz
# target is picked up without a hand-kept list.
#
# A normal package test only replays each target's seed corpus. This workflow runs the actual
# mutation-based fuzzing engine (`go test -fuzz`), which is what finds new
# crashers. It is intentionally kept out of the required PR-blocking path in
# ci.yml: a fuzz-discovered crasher should open a tracked follow-up, not
# block an unrelated PR merge.

on:
  schedule:
    # 41 minutes past the hour, distinct from ci.yml's 03:17 UTC nightly
    # exhaustive-parity run, so the two scheduled jobs do not contend for the
    # same runner minute.
    - cron: '41 4 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      fuzztime:
        description: 'Per-target fuzz duration (Go duration string, e.g. 30s, 2m)'
        required: false
        default: '30s'
      report:
        description: 'Open, update, and close fuzz-nightly issues for this manual run (a short fuzztime counts as a green night; use 30s or more)'
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false
      close_after:
        description: 'Consecutive green nights that close a fuzz issue'
        required: false
        default: '3'

concurrency:
  group: fuzz-nightly
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

# VM runner services can share HOME and /tmp. Isolate their native Go
# caches and scratch, and disable setup-go archives, which retain producer
# paths. Hosted runners keep their standard cache paths and warm builds.
env:
  GOWORK: 'off'
  GOMAXPROCS: '2'
  GOFLAGS: '-p=1'

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      targets: ${{ steps.list.outputs.targets }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: List Fuzz targets
        id: list
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GOWORK=off go test -json ./... -list '^Fuzz' -run '^$' > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/fuzz-discovery.jsonl"
          json="$(jq -sc '[.[] | select(.Action == "output" and ((.Output // "") | test("^Fuzz[A-Za-z0-9_]+\\n$"))) | {package: .Package, target: (.Output | rtrimstr("\n"))}] | unique_by(.package, .target)' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/fuzz-discovery.jsonl")"
          test "$json" != '[]' || { echo "::error::no Fuzz targets discovered"; exit 1; }
          echo "targets=$json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Discovered $(jq 'length' <<< "$json") Fuzz targets across $(jq '[.[].package] | unique | length' <<< "$json") packages"

  fuzz:
    needs: discover
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 20
      matrix:
        target: ${{ fromJson(needs.discover.outputs.targets) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Fuzz ${{ matrix.target.package }} ${{ matrix.target.target }}
        id: fuzz
        shell: bash
        env:
          FUZZ_PACKAGE: ${{ matrix.target.package }}
          FUZZ_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target.target }}
          FUZZ_TIME: ${{ github.event.inputs.fuzztime || '30s' }}
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          GOWORK=off go test "$FUZZ_PACKAGE" -run '^$' \
            -fuzz "^${FUZZ_TARGET}\$" \
            -fuzztime "$FUZZ_TIME" 2>&1 | tee fuzz.log
          rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          echo "rc=$rc" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          exit "$rc"

      # Record the outcome for the report job. The step fails the job only if
      # the script itself breaks; the fuzz step above keeps the job red.
      - name: Record fuzz result
        continue-on-error: true
        if: always() && (steps.fuzz.outcome == 'success' || steps.fuzz.outcome == 'failure')
        shell: bash
        env:
          FUZZ_PACKAGE: ${{ matrix.target.package }}
          FUZZ_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target.target }}
          FUZZ_RC: ${{ steps.fuzz.outputs.rc }}
        run: |
          python3 .github/scripts/fuzz_issues.py collect --log fuzz.log \
            --package "$FUZZ_PACKAGE" --target "$FUZZ_TARGET" \
            --exit-code "${FUZZ_RC:-1}" --out fuzz-result/result.json

      - name: Upload fuzz result
        continue-on-error: true
        if: always() && (steps.fuzz.outcome == 'success' || steps.fuzz.outcome == 'failure')
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: fuzz-result-${{ strategy.job-index }}
          path: fuzz-result/result.json
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload crashers
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: fuzz-crasher-${{ matrix.target.target }}-${{ strategy.job-index }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: '**/testdata/fuzz/${{ matrix.target.target }}'
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90

  # One issue per failing target, closed after N green nights. The report job
  # never fails the run: the red fuzz leg already does.
  report:
    needs: [discover, fuzz]
    if: always() && needs.discover.result == 'success' && (github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event.inputs.report == 'true')
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    concurrency:
      group: fuzz-nightly-report
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      # Needs python3 and gh on the runner (both ship on depot-ubuntu-24.04).
      - name: Download fuzz results
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: fuzz-result-*
          path: fuzz-results

      - name: Sync fuzz issues
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CLOSE_AFTER: ${{ github.event.inputs.close_after || '3' }}
        run: |
          python3 .github/scripts/fuzz_issues.py sync --results fuzz-results \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --sha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --run-url "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            --close-after "$CLOSE_AFTER"

name: grammar-lock-update

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 6 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: grammar-update-report
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOWORK: "off"

jobs:
  report-updates:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Plan grammar updates
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          go run ./cmd/grammar_updater \
            -lock grammars/languages.lock \
            -allow-list grammars/update_tier1_core100.txt \
            -workers 8 \
            -report grammars/grammar_updates.plan.json \
            -fail-on-error=true

      - name: Check scanner-facing changes
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          go run ./cmd/grammar_update_guard \
            -updates grammars/grammar_updates.plan.json \
            -report grammars/grammar_scanner_update_report.json \
            -blocked-list grammars/grammar_held_back.txt \
            -fail-on-blocked=false

      - name: Report grammar updates in an issue
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/render_grammar_update_issue.py \
            --plan grammars/grammar_updates.plan.json \
            --guard grammars/grammar_scanner_update_report.json \
            --output grammar_update_issue.md
          bash scripts/sync_grammar_update_issue.sh \
            grammars/grammar_updates.plan.json grammar_update_issue.md

      - name: Upload update artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: grammar-lock-update-artifacts
          path: |
            grammars/grammar_updates.plan.json
            grammars/grammar_held_back.txt
            grammars/grammar_scanner_update_report.json
            grammar_update_issue.md

sources.content:
name: grammar receipts

# One gts-grammar-receipt/v1 receipt per grammar, uploaded as a workflow
# artifact. Receipts are never committed. Each grammar runs on an isolated
# Depot VM. No secrets are needed.
#
# The corpus lock is not committed: blocker receipts under cgo_harness assert
# that the repository has no corpus_sources.lock. Each run reads it from the
# `corpus_lock_url` input or the GTS_CORPUS_LOCK_URL repository variable and
# checks it against the digest in cgo_harness/perf_scan/corpus_sources.lock.sha256
# (scripts/fetch_grammar_receipt_lock.sh). The URL is not a secret: the lock lists
# only public repositories, and the digest is what authenticates it.
# Scheduled and release runs require GTS_CORPUS_LOCK_URL. Manual runs fail
# if neither the input nor that variable supplies the authenticated lock.
#
# Triggers
#   workflow_dispatch  the `grammars` input: "smoke", "all", or a list such as "go,python"
#   schedule, release  all 206 default grammars plus Lean 4, a few at a time

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      grammars:
        description: 'Grammars to run: "smoke", "all" (207), or a comma-separated list such as "go,python"'
        required: false
        default: smoke
        type: string
      max_parallel:
        description: "Jobs at a time (1 to 8)"
        required: false
        default: "6"
        type: string
      corpus_lock_url:
        description: "https URL of the corpus lock; overrides the GTS_CORPUS_LOCK_URL repository variable"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      triage:
        description: "Shrink fresh mismatches and upload their witnesses with each receipt"
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
  schedule:
    - cron: "41 9 * * 1"
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: grammar-receipts-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

# VM runner services can share HOME and /tmp. Isolate their native Go
# caches and scratch, and disable setup-go archives, which retain producer
# paths. Hosted runners keep their standard cache paths and warm builds.
env:
  GOWORK: 'off'
  GOMAXPROCS: '2'
  GOFLAGS: '-p=1'
  # Each receipt has an 8 GiB Docker limit; the matrix bounds job count.
  GTS_GRAMMAR_RECEIPT_ALLOW_CONCURRENT: '1'
  GTS_IMAGE_TAG: gotreesitter/cgo-harness:go1.25-local

jobs:
  plan:
    # Automatic fleet runs require an explicitly configured corpus lock.
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || vars.GTS_CORPUS_LOCK_URL != ''
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.matrix }}
      count: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.count }}
      mode: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.mode }}
      parallel: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.parallel }}
      run: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - name: List the pull request's changed files
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files" \
            --jq '[.[] | {filename, patch}]' | jq -s 'add // []' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pr-files.json"

      - name: Choose grammars
        id: plan
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          GRAMMARS_INPUT: ${{ inputs.grammars }}
          MAX_PARALLEL_INPUT: ${{ inputs.max_parallel }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--event "$EVENT_NAME")
          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            args+=(--grammars "$GRAMMARS_INPUT" --max-parallel "$MAX_PARALLEL_INPUT")
          elif [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == "pull_request" ]]; then
            args+=(--pr-files "$RUNNER_TEMP/pr-files.json")
          fi
          python3 scripts/plan_grammar_receipts.py "${args[@]}"

      - name: Check the corpus lock source
        id: lock
        env:
          LOCK_URL: ${{ inputs.corpus_lock_url || vars.GTS_CORPUS_LOCK_URL }}
          MATRIX: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.matrix }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if ! jq -e '.include | map(.grammar != "lean") | any' <<< "$MATRIX" > /dev/null; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"   # Lean only: it uses its own committed lock
            exit 0
          fi
          status=0
          scripts/fetch_grammar_receipt_lock.sh "$LOCK_URL" "$RUNNER_TEMP/corpus_sources.lock" || status=$?
          if [[ "$status" == 0 ]]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "$status" == 3 && "$EVENT_NAME" == "pull_request" ]]; then
            echo "::notice::No corpus lock URL is configured, so the receipt jobs are skipped for this pull request."
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            exit 1
          fi

  image:
    # Build the cgo harness image once per Dockerfile and cache it, so the
    # per-grammar jobs load it instead of building it.
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - name: Look for the cached image
        id: cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/gts-harness-image.tar.zst
          key: grammar-receipt-image-${{ hashFiles('cgo_harness/docker/Dockerfile') }}
          lookup-only: true

      - name: Build and save the image
        if: steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh --build-only
          docker save "$GTS_IMAGE_TAG" | zstd -T0 -3 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gts-harness-image.tar.zst"
          ls -l "$RUNNER_TEMP/gts-harness-image.tar.zst"

      - name: Cache the image
        if: steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/gts-harness-image.tar.zst
          key: grammar-receipt-image-${{ hashFiles('cgo_harness/docker/Dockerfile') }}

  receipt:
    needs: [plan, image]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 120
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.parallel) }}
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    env:
      GRAMMAR: ${{ matrix.grammar }}
      GTS_GRAMMAR_RECEIPT_WALL_TIMEOUT: 90m
    steps:
      # A pull request receipt records the pull request head, not the
      # synthetic merge commit.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - name: Restore the harness image
        id: image
        uses: actions/cache/restore@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/gts-harness-image.tar.zst
          key: grammar-receipt-image-${{ hashFiles('cgo_harness/docker/Dockerfile') }}

      - name: Load or build the harness image
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/gts-harness-image.tar.zst" ]]; then
            zstd -dc "$RUNNER_TEMP/gts-harness-image.tar.zst" | docker load
          else
            bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh --build-only
          fi
          docker image inspect "$GTS_IMAGE_TAG" > /dev/null

      - name: Restore this grammar's C oracle build
        uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: harness_out/parity_c_ref_cache
          key: grammar-receipt-c-ref-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.grammar }}-${{ hashFiles('grammars/languages.lock', 'cgo_harness/go.mod', 'cgo_harness/parity_c_loader_cgo.go', 'cgo_harness/grammar_receipts/*lock') }}

      - name: Check the corpus lock and pick this grammar's entry
        id: corpus
        env:
          LOCK_URL: ${{ inputs.corpus_lock_url || vars.GTS_CORPUS_LOCK_URL }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sha256sum -c cgo_harness/grammar_receipts/lean_c_oracle.lock.sha256
          sha256sum -c cgo_harness/grammar_receipts/lean_corpus_sources.lock.sha256
          if [[ "$GRAMMAR" == "lean" ]]; then
            lock=cgo_harness/grammar_receipts/lean_corpus_sources.lock
          else
            scripts/fetch_grammar_receipt_lock.sh "$LOCK_URL" "$RUNNER_TEMP/corpus_sources.lock"
            lock="$RUNNER_TEMP/corpus_sources.lock"
          fi
          entry="$(awk -v g="$GRAMMAR" '!/^#/ && $1 == g' "$lock")"
          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | wc -l)" -eq 1
          {
            echo "lock=$lock"
            echo "url=$(awk '{print $2}' <<< "$entry")"
            echo "commit=$(awk '{print $3}' <<< "$entry")"
            echo "digest=$(sha256sum <<< "$entry" | cut -c1-16)"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Restore this grammar's corpus checkout
        id: corpus-cache
        uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/corpus_sources/${{ matrix.grammar }}
          key: grammar-receipt-corpus-${{ matrix.grammar }}-${{ steps.corpus.outputs.digest }}

      - name: Fetch the corpus checkout at its locked commit
        if: steps.corpus-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        env:
          CORPUS_URL: ${{ steps.corpus.outputs.url }}
          CORPUS_COMMIT: ${{ steps.corpus.outputs.commit }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/corpus_sources/$GRAMMAR"
          rm -rf "$dir"
          mkdir -p "$dir"
          git -C "$dir" init -q
          git -C "$dir" remote add origin "$CORPUS_URL"
          git -C "$dir" fetch --quiet --depth 1 origin "$CORPUS_COMMIT"
          git -C "$dir" checkout --quiet --detach FETCH_HEAD
          test "$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CORPUS_COMMIT"

      - name: Generate one grammar receipt
        env:
          LOCK: ${{ steps.corpus.outputs.lock }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RECEIPT_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/gts-receipts"
          CORPUS_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/corpus_sources"
          test -x /usr/bin/time || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends time > /dev/null; }
          mkdir -p "$RECEIPT_DIR"
          if [[ "$GRAMMAR" == "lean" ]]; then
            expected="$(awk 'NF {print $1; exit}' "$LOCK.sha256")"
            extra=(1)
          else
            expected="$(awk 'NF {print $1; exit}' cgo_harness/perf_scan/corpus_sources.lock.sha256)"
            extra=()
          fi
          cgo_harness/grammar_receipts/run_one_in_docker.sh \
            "$GRAMMAR" "$CORPUS_DIR" "$LOCK" "$expected" "$RECEIPT_DIR" "${extra[@]}"
          cat "$RECEIPT_DIR/.$GRAMMAR.time"

      - name: Shrink fresh mismatches
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.triage && matrix.grammar != 'lean'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RECEIPT_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/gts-receipts"
          mkdir -p "$RECEIPT_DIR/triage"
          bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
            --no-build --cpus 1 --memory 3g --gomemlimit 2GiB \
            --label "grammar-triage-$GRAMMAR" \
            --mount "$RUNNER_TEMP/corpus_sources:/corpus_sources:ro" \
            --mount "$RECEIPT_DIR:/receipts" \
            -- "cd /workspace/cgo_harness && GOWORK=off GOMAXPROCS=1 go run -tags treesitter_c_parity ./cmd/gts_mismatch \
              -mode triage -grammar $GRAMMAR -receipt /receipts/$GRAMMAR.json \
              -corpus /corpus_sources -dump /receipts/triage \
              -max-tests 1500 -timeout 1m -parse-timeout 2s -max-dumps 0 \
              > /receipts/triage/$GRAMMAR.jsonl"

      - name: Upload the receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: grammar-receipt-${{ matrix.grammar }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/gts-receipts/${{ matrix.grammar }}.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/gts-receipts/.${{ matrix.grammar }}.time
            ${{ runner.temp }}/gts-receipts/.${{ matrix.grammar }}.runner-time
            ${{ runner.temp }}/gts-receipts/triage/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90

  summary:
    needs: [plan, receipt]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.run == 'true' }}
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - name: Download the receipts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: grammar-receipt-*-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: receipts
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Summarize
        env:
          EXPECTED_MATRIX: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.matrix }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          status=0
          python3 scripts/summarize_grammar_receipts.py --report-dir receipts --expected-matrix "$EXPECTED_MATRIX" || status=$?
          cat receipts/summary.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          exit "$status"

      - name: Upload the summary
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: grammar-receipt-summary-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            receipts/summary.md
            receipts/parity-failures.md
            receipts/c-incremental-diagnostics.md
            receipts/run-metrics.json
          retention-days: 90

sources.head: 50c84a974e4fef3fa7ed146b0480cf63a5e78b95
sources.title: ci: align workflow policy tests and isolate release Go configuration
sources.content:
name: perf-scan-hard-gate

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      corpus_lock_url:
        description: HTTPS corpus lock URL; defaults to GTS_CORPUS_LOCK_URL
        type: string
        required: false

concurrency:
  group: perf-scan-hard-gate
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  fleet:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      PERF_OUT: cgo_harness/perf_scan/out/hard_gate
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version-file: cgo_harness/go.mod

      - name: Set the corpus directory
        run: printf 'PERF_CORPUS_DIR=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/gotreesitter-perf" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Provision the authenticated corpus on the Depot VM
        shell: bash
        env:
          CORPUS_LOCK_URL: ${{ inputs.corpus_lock_url || vars.GTS_CORPUS_LOCK_URL }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash scripts/fetch_grammar_receipt_lock.sh "$CORPUS_LOCK_URL" "$PERF_CORPUS_DIR/corpus_sources.lock"
          while read -r name repo commit _ || [[ -n "${name:-}" ]]; do
            [[ -z "${name:-}" || "$name" == \#* ]] && continue
            [[ "$name" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ ]] || { echo "Invalid corpus name" >&2; exit 1; }
            checkout="$PERF_CORPUS_DIR/corpus_sources/$name"
            mkdir -p "$checkout"
            git -C "$checkout" init -q
            git -C "$checkout" remote add origin "$repo"
            git -C "$checkout" fetch --quiet --depth 1 origin "$commit"
            git -C "$checkout" checkout --quiet --detach FETCH_HEAD
          done < "$PERF_CORPUS_DIR/corpus_sources.lock"

      - name: Authenticate corpus lock
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expected="$(awk 'NF { print $1; exit }' cgo_harness/perf_scan/corpus_sources.lock.sha256)"
          actual="$(sha256sum "$PERF_CORPUS_DIR/corpus_sources.lock" | awk '{ print $1 }')"
          test "$actual" = "$expected"
          test -d "$PERF_CORPUS_DIR/corpus_sources"

      - name: Verify pinned corpus checkouts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          lock="$PERF_CORPUS_DIR/corpus_sources.lock"
          root="$PERF_CORPUS_DIR/corpus_sources"
          rows=0
          declare -A seen=()
          fail() {
            echo "::error::$*" >&2
            exit 1
          }
          while read -r name repo commit subdir extensions extra; do
            if test -z "${name:-}" || [[ "$name" == \#* ]]; then
              continue
            fi
            test -z "${extra:-}" || fail "invalid extra field in corpus lock row for $name"
            test -n "${repo:-}" || fail "missing repository URL for $name"
            test -n "${commit:-}" || fail "missing commit for $name"
            test -n "${extensions:-}" || test "$name" = "gomod" || fail "missing extension filter for $name"
            test -z "${seen[$name]:-}" || fail "duplicate corpus lock row for $name"
            seen[$name]=1
            rows=$((rows + 1))

            checkout="$root/$name"
            test -d "$checkout" || fail "missing corpus checkout for $name: $checkout"
            actual_repo="$(git -C "$checkout" remote get-url origin)" || fail "cannot resolve origin URL for $name"
            test "${actual_repo%.git}" = "${repo%.git}" || fail "corpus origin drift for $name: got $actual_repo, want $repo"
            test ! -s "$checkout/.git/objects/info/alternates" || fail "external Git object alternate is not allowed for $name"
            git -C "$checkout" cat-file -e "$commit^{commit}" || fail "locked commit is unavailable for $name: $commit"
            head="$(git -C "$checkout" rev-parse --verify HEAD)" || fail "cannot resolve HEAD for $name"
            test "$head" = "$commit" || fail "corpus HEAD drift for $name: got $head, want $commit"
            git -C "$checkout" diff --quiet --ignore-submodules=none "$commit" -- || fail "tracked worktree drift for $name"
            git -C "$checkout" diff --cached --quiet --ignore-submodules=none "$commit" -- || fail "index drift for $name"

            if test -n "${subdir:-}" && test "$subdir" != "."; then
              test -e "$checkout/$subdir" || fail "locked corpus subpath is missing for $name: $subdir"
            fi
          done < "$lock"
          test "$rows" -eq 206 || fail "corpus lock contains $rows language rows, want 206"

      - name: Verify provisioned corpus files
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf "$PERF_OUT"
          mkdir -p "$PERF_OUT"
          (
            cd cgo_harness
            GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/real_corpus_inventory \
              -grammar-dir ../grammars/grammar_blobs \
              -lock ../grammars/languages.lock \
              -corpus-source-root "$PERF_CORPUS_DIR/corpus_sources" \
              -corpus-source-lock "$PERF_CORPUS_DIR/corpus_sources.lock" \
              -require-corpus-sources \
              -out-json "../$PERF_OUT/source_inventory.json"
          )

      - name: Restore C reference build cache
        uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: harness_out/parity_c_ref_cache
          key: perf-c-ref-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('grammars/languages.lock') }}

      - name: Run authenticated fleet gate in Docker
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
            --label perf-scan-hard-gate \
            --memory 8g \
            --cpus 2 \
            --pids 4096 \
            --gomemlimit 6GiB \
            --goflags -p=1 \
            --mount "$PERF_CORPUS_DIR:/corpus:ro" \
            -- "cd /workspace/cgo_harness && \
              GOWORK=off \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN=1 \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_HARD_GATE=1 \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_REQUIRE_FLEET=1 \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_CORPUS_ROOT=/corpus/corpus_sources \
              GTS_REAL_CORPUS_BENCH_LOCK=/corpus/corpus_sources.lock \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_MAX_FILES=8 \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_ORDER=largest \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_REPS=5 \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_WARMUP=1 \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_FILE_BUDGET_MS=10000 \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_LANG_TIMEOUT_MS=900000 \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_CHILD_RSS_LIMIT_MB=6144 \
              GTS_PERF_SCAN_OUT=perf_scan/out/hard_gate \
              go test -tags 'treesitter_c_parity treesitter_c_perfscan' \
                -run '^TestPerfScanSweep$' -v -count=1 -timeout 0 -p 1 ."

      - name: Render gate status
        if: always()
        working-directory: cgo_harness
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GOWORK=off go test ./cmd/perf_scan_budget ./cmd/perf_scan_status -count=1
          GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/perf_scan_budget \
            -budget perf_scan/perf_ratio_budgets.json
          if test -f perf_scan/out/hard_gate/scoreboard.json; then
            budget_result=0
            GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/perf_scan_budget \
              -budget perf_scan/perf_ratio_budgets.json \
              -scoreboard perf_scan/out/hard_gate/scoreboard.json \
              -hard-gate-only \
              -out-md perf_scan/out/hard_gate/budget.md || budget_result=$?
            GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/perf_scan_status \
              -budget perf_scan/perf_ratio_budgets.json \
              -fleet tier_scan/exts.tsv \
              -scoreboards perf_scan/out/hard_gate/scoreboard.json \
              -out-json perf_scan/out/hard_gate/status.json \
              -out-md perf_scan/out/hard_gate/status.md
            exit "$budget_result"
          fi

      - name: Upload perf gate evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: perf-hard-gate-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            cgo_harness/perf_scan/out/hard_gate
            harness_out/docker
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90

sources.head: 50c84a974e4fef3fa7ed146b0480cf63a5e78b95
sources.title: ci: align workflow policy tests and isolate release Go configuration
sources.content:
name: release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Exact vX.Y.Z release version
        required: true
        type: string
      candidate_sha:
        description: Exact lowercase 40-character main commit hash
        required: true
        type: string
      release_kind:
        description: Governed release route
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - planned-minor
          - urgent-patch
      receipt_uri:
        description: "Signed Hyphae receipt ID: hypha-receipt:YYYY-MM-DD:<short-id>"
        required: true
        type: string
      incident:
        description: Urgent patch incident
        required: false
        type: string
      why_waiting_is_worse:
        description: Reason that an urgent patch cannot wait
        required: false
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  GOENV: "off"
  ARBITER_VERSION: "1.9.0"
  ARBITER_LINUX_AMD64_SHA256: c6c5c6c069d33cc39b689201f30d4561472d6ed59731e3ba395b44079e53af38

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
      RELEASE_KIND: ${{ inputs.release_kind }}
      RECEIPT_URI: ${{ inputs.receipt_uri }}
      INCIDENT: ${{ inputs.incident }}
      WHY_WAITING_IS_WORSE: ${{ inputs.why_waiting_is_worse }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - name: Require a main workflow revision
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$CANDIDATE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/main"
          test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$CANDIDATE_SHA"

      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Install the pinned Arbiter CLI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/arbiter.tar.gz"
          bin_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/arbiter-bin"
          url="https://github.com/odvcencio/arbiter/releases/download/v$ARBITER_VERSION/arbiter_${ARBITER_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "$url" --output "$archive"
          echo "$ARBITER_LINUX_AMD64_SHA256  $archive" | sha256sum --check -
          mkdir -p "$bin_dir"
          tar --extract --gzip --file "$archive" --directory "$bin_dir" arbiter
          chmod 0755 "$bin_dir/arbiter"
          echo "$bin_dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Test the release policy
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          arbiter check policy/release.arb
          arbiter fmt --check policy/release.arb policy/release.test.arb
          arbiter test policy/release.test.arb

      - id: facts
        name: Collect main and hosted check facts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch --force --tags origin refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
          main_sha="$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)"
          main_exact_candidate=false
          if test "$main_sha" = "$CANDIDATE_SHA"; then
            main_exact_candidate=true
          fi

          latest_tag="$(git tag --list --sort=-version:refname |
            awk '$0 ~ /^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/ && first == "" { first=$0 } END { print first }')"
          test -n "$latest_tag"

          response="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-runs.json"
          url="https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?head_sha=$CANDIDATE_SHA&status=completed&event=workflow_dispatch&per_page=100"
          if ! status="$(curl --silent --show-error --location \
            --output "$response" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
            "$url")"; then
            echo "The hosted check query failed." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if test "$status" != "200"; then
            jq -r '.message // "The hosted check query returned an error."' "$response" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          jq --arg sha "$CANDIDATE_SHA" \
            '[.workflow_runs[] | select(
              .head_sha == $sha
              and .status == "completed"
              and .event == "workflow_dispatch"
            )] | sort_by([.run_number, .run_attempt]) | last' \
            "$response" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json"

          ci_run_id=""
          ci_run_url=""
          ci_event=""
          ci_sha=""
          ci_conclusion=""
          ci_completed_at=""
          if jq -e '. != null' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json" >/dev/null; then
            ci_run_id="$(jq -r '.id | tostring' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_run_url="$(jq -r '.html_url // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_event="$(jq -r '.event // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_sha="$(jq -r '.head_sha // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_conclusion="$(jq -r '.conclusion // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_completed_at="$(jq -r '.updated_at // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
          fi

          {
            echo "main_exact_candidate=$main_exact_candidate"
            echo "latest_tag=$latest_tag"
            echo "ci_run_id=$ci_run_id"
            echo "ci_run_url=$ci_run_url"
            echo "ci_event=$ci_event"
            echo "ci_sha=$ci_sha"
            echo "ci_conclusion=$ci_conclusion"
            echo "ci_completed_at=$ci_completed_at"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - id: presence
        name: Collect tag and release facts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          query_absence() {
            local label="$1"
            local url="$2"
            local body="$RUNNER_TEMP/${label}.json"
            local status
            if ! status="$(curl --silent --show-error --location \
              --output "$body" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
              "$url")"; then
              echo "The $label query failed." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            if test "$status" = "404"; then
              echo "true"
              return
            fi
            if test "$status" = "200"; then
              echo "false"
              return
            fi
            jq -r '.message // "The GitHub query returned an error."' "$body" >&2
            exit 1
          }

          api="https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          tag_absent="$(query_absence "tag" "$api/git/ref/tags/$VERSION")"
          release_absent="$(query_absence "release" "$api/releases/tags/$VERSION")"
          {
            echo "tag_absent=$tag_absent"
            echo "release_absent=$release_absent"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Test the release validator
        run: go test ./cmd/releasegate -count=1

      - name: Validate release evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$RUNNER_TEMP/releasegate-verify"
          go run ./cmd/releasegate \
            -version "$VERSION" \
            -candidate-sha "$CANDIDATE_SHA" \
            -release-kind "$RELEASE_KIND" \
            -receipt-uri "$RECEIPT_URI" \
            -incident "$INCIDENT" \
            -why-waiting-is-worse "$WHY_WAITING_IS_WORSE" \
            -latest-tag "${{ steps.facts.outputs.latest_tag }}" \
            -ci-run-id "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_run_id }}" \
            -ci-run-url "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_run_url }}" \
            -ci-event "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_event }}" \
            -ci-sha "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_sha }}" \
            -ci-conclusion "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_conclusion }}" \
            -ci-completed-at "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_completed_at }}" \
            -main-exact-candidate="${{ steps.facts.outputs.main_exact_candidate }}" \
            -tag-absent="${{ steps.presence.outputs.tag_absent }}" \
            -release-absent="${{ steps.presence.outputs.release_absent }}" \
            -output-directory "$output"

      - name: Decide release publication
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$RUNNER_TEMP/releasegate-verify"
          arbiter strategy policy/release.arb \
            --name ReleasePublication \
            --data "$(jq --compact-output . "$output/policy-facts.json")" \
            > "$output/policy-decision.json"
          jq -r '"- Arbiter decision: `\(.selected)`\n- Arbiter reason: \(.params.reason)"' \
            "$output/policy-decision.json" >> "$output/summary.md"
          jq -e '.selected == "Allow" and .params.action == "allow"' \
            "$output/policy-decision.json" >/dev/null

      - name: Preserve verification evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: release-gate-${{ inputs.version }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/releasegate-verify
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    needs: verify
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    environment: release
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
      RELEASE_KIND: ${{ inputs.release_kind }}
      RECEIPT_URI: ${{ inputs.receipt_uri }}
      INCIDENT: ${{ inputs.incident }}
      WHY_WAITING_IS_WORSE: ${{ inputs.why_waiting_is_worse }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - name: Require the original main workflow revision
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$CANDIDATE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/main"
          test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$CANDIDATE_SHA"

      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Verify release Go cache isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cache_program=$(go env GOCACHEPROG)
          test -z "$cache_program"

      - name: Install the pinned Arbiter CLI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/arbiter.tar.gz"
          bin_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/arbiter-bin"
          url="https://github.com/odvcencio/arbiter/releases/download/v$ARBITER_VERSION/arbiter_${ARBITER_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "$url" --output "$archive"
          echo "$ARBITER_LINUX_AMD64_SHA256  $archive" | sha256sum --check -
          mkdir -p "$bin_dir"
          tar --extract --gzip --file "$archive" --directory "$bin_dir" arbiter
          chmod 0755 "$bin_dir/arbiter"
          echo "$bin_dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - id: facts
        name: Recollect main and hosted check facts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch --force --tags origin refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
          main_sha="$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)"
          main_exact_candidate=false
          if test "$main_sha" = "$CANDIDATE_SHA"; then
            main_exact_candidate=true
          fi

          latest_tag="$(git tag --list --sort=-version:refname |
            awk '$0 ~ /^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/ && first == "" { first=$0 } END { print first }')"
          test -n "$latest_tag"

          response="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-runs.json"
          url="https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?head_sha=$CANDIDATE_SHA&status=completed&event=workflow_dispatch&per_page=100"
          if ! status="$(curl --silent --show-error --location \
            --output "$response" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
            "$url")"; then
            echo "The hosted check query failed." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if test "$status" != "200"; then
            jq -r '.message // "The hosted check query returned an error."' "$response" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          jq --arg sha "$CANDIDATE_SHA" \
            '[.workflow_runs[] | select(
              .head_sha == $sha
              and .status == "completed"
              and .event == "workflow_dispatch"
            )] | sort_by([.run_number, .run_attempt]) | last' \
            "$response" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json"

          ci_run_id=""
          ci_run_url=""
          ci_event=""
          ci_sha=""
          ci_conclusion=""
          ci_completed_at=""
          if jq -e '. != null' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json" >/dev/null; then
            ci_run_id="$(jq -r '.id | tostring' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_run_url="$(jq -r '.html_url // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_event="$(jq -r '.event // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_sha="$(jq -r '.head_sha // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_conclusion="$(jq -r '.conclusion // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_completed_at="$(jq -r '.updated_at // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
          fi

          {
            echo "main_exact_candidate=$main_exact_candidate"
            echo "latest_tag=$latest_tag"
            echo "ci_run_id=$ci_run_id"
            echo "ci_run_url=$ci_run_url"
            echo "ci_event=$ci_event"
            echo "ci_sha=$ci_sha"
            echo "ci_conclusion=$ci_conclusion"
            echo "ci_completed_at=$ci_completed_at"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - id: presence
        name: Recollect tag and release facts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          query_absence() {
            local label="$1"
            local url="$2"
            local body="$RUNNER_TEMP/${label}.json"
            local status
            if ! status="$(curl --silent --show-error --location \
              --output "$body" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
              "$url")"; then
              echo "The $label query failed." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            if test "$status" = "404"; then
              echo "true"
              return
            fi
            if test "$status" = "200"; then
              echo "false"
              return
            fi
            jq -r '.message // "The GitHub query returned an error."' "$body" >&2
            exit 1
          }

          api="https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          tag_absent="$(query_absence "tag" "$api/git/ref/tags/$VERSION")"
          release_absent="$(query_absence "release" "$api/releases/tags/$VERSION")"
          {
            echo "tag_absent=$tag_absent"
            echo "release_absent=$release_absent"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Revalidate release evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$RUNNER_TEMP/releasegate-publish"
          go run ./cmd/releasegate \
            -version "$VERSION" \
            -candidate-sha "$CANDIDATE_SHA" \
            -release-kind "$RELEASE_KIND" \
            -receipt-uri "$RECEIPT_URI" \
            -incident "$INCIDENT" \
            -why-waiting-is-worse "$WHY_WAITING_IS_WORSE" \
            -latest-tag "${{ steps.facts.outputs.latest_tag }}" \
            -ci-run-id "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_run_id }}" \
            -ci-run-url "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_run_url }}" \
            -ci-event "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_event }}" \
            -ci-sha "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_sha }}" \
            -ci-conclusion "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_conclusion }}" \
            -ci-completed-at "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_completed_at }}" \
            -main-exact-candidate="${{ steps.facts.outputs.main_exact_candidate }}" \
            -tag-absent="${{ steps.presence.outputs.tag_absent }}" \
            -release-absent="${{ steps.presence.outputs.release_absent }}" \
            -output-directory "$output"

      - name: Reevaluate release publication
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$RUNNER_TEMP/releasegate-publish"
          arbiter strategy policy/release.arb \
            --name ReleasePublication \
            --data "$(jq --compact-output . "$output/policy-facts.json")" \
            > "$output/policy-decision.json"
          jq -r '"- Arbiter decision: `\(.selected)`\n- Arbiter reason: \(.params.reason)"' \
            "$output/policy-decision.json" >> "$output/summary.md"
          jq -e '.selected == "Allow" and .params.action == "allow"' \
            "$output/policy-decision.json" >/dev/null

      - name: Publish the immutable tag and release
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$RUNNER_TEMP/releasegate-publish"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git fetch --force origin refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
          test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)" = "$CANDIDATE_SHA"
          git tag --annotate "$VERSION" "$CANDIDATE_SHA" --message "gotreesitter $VERSION"
          git push origin "refs/tags/$VERSION:refs/tags/$VERSION"
          gh release create "$VERSION" \
            --verify-tag \
            --title "$(cat "$output/title.txt")" \
            --notes-file "$output/notes.md"

      - name: Verify the published release
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$RUNNER_TEMP/releasegate-publish"
          peeled_sha="$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/$VERSION^{}" | awk '{print $1}')"
          test "$peeled_sha" = "$CANDIDATE_SHA"

          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$VERSION" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.json"
          jq -e --arg version "$VERSION" \
            '.tag_name == $version and .draft == false and .prerelease == false' \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.json" >/dev/null
          {
            echo
            echo "- Verified remote tag commit: \`$peeled_sha\`"
            echo "- Verified GitHub release: \`$VERSION\`"
          } >> "$output/summary.md"

      - name: Preserve publication evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: release-publication-${{ inputs.version }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/releasegate-publish
          if-no-files-found: error

name: repository-hygiene

# Runs for every pull request, including docs-only ones, so the evidence guard
# also sees changes that ci.yml skips. Do not add a paths filter.
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: repository-hygiene-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  evidence-paths:
    name: evidence paths
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      # A pull request checks only the paths it adds. A push to main checks the
      # whole tree.
      - name: Check evidence paths in the pull request
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$BASE_SHA"
          bash scripts/check_evidence_paths.sh "$BASE_SHA"

      - name: Check evidence paths in the tree
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: bash scripts/check_evidence_paths.sh

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
name: CI
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: install dev tools
        uses: ./.github/actions/dev-tools

      - name: cache go
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          # Includes the toolchain go.mod asks for, which Go downloads into the
          # module cache.
          path: |
            ~/go/pkg/mod
            ~/.cache/go-build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: test
        run: go test ./...

  shellcheck:
    name: shellcheck
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
      - uses: ./.github/actions/dev-tools
      - name: Run ShellCheck
        uses: ludeeus/action-shellcheck@00cae500b08a931fb5698e11e79bfbd38e612a38 # 2.0.0
      - uses: reviewdog/action-shfmt@d8f080930b9be5847b4f97e9f4122b81a82aaeac # v1.0.4
        with:
          filter_mode: "nofilter"
          fail_on_error: "true"
          shfmt_flags: "-i 2 -ci -bn"
      - name: Lint Protobuf
        run: .github/workflows/buf-lint-check.sh
      - name: Check Protobuf formatting
        run: .github/workflows/buf-format-check.sh
      - name: Check generated Protobuf
        run: .github/workflows/buf-generate-check.sh
      - name: Checkout the exact PR base for Protobuf compatibility
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.repo.full_name }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          path: .ci-protobuf-base
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check webserver Protobuf compatibility
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: bufbuild/buf-breaking-action@c57b3d842a5c3f3b454756ef65305a50a587c5ba # v1.1.4
        with:
          input: grpc/protos
          against: .ci-protobuf-base/grpc/protos
      - name: Check indexserver Protobuf compatibility
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: bufbuild/buf-breaking-action@c57b3d842a5c3f3b454756ef65305a50a587c5ba # v1.1.4
        with:
          input: cmd/zoekt-sourcegraph-indexserver/grpc/protos
          against: .ci-protobuf-base/cmd/zoekt-sourcegraph-indexserver/grpc/protos

name: Promote Docker Aliases

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [Publish Docker Image]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  promote:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency:
      group: zoekt-container-aliases
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: checkout promotion script
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout: .github/workflows/docker-promote.sh
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: setup-buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1

      - name: login to ghcr.io
        uses: docker/login-action@8aa5831fb8d48d8f76594c7ddde61ae58019f550 # v4.8.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Promote current published targets
        run: bash .github/workflows/docker-promote.sh all

name: Publish Docker Image

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Each architecture builds on its own runner. Under QEMU the arm64 ctags
  # build took 14 minutes; natively it takes under a minute.
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: amd64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
          - arch: arm64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: version
        id: version
        run: .github/workflows/docker-version.sh

      - name: setup-buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1

      # The image labels, including org.opencontainers.image.version, come from
      # the same immutable version rules as the merge job.
      - name: docker-meta
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@dc802804100637a589fabce1cb79ff13a1411302 # v6.2.0
        with:
          images: ${{ env.IMAGE }}
          tags: |
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=raw,value=${{ steps.version.outputs.value }},enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=sha,prefix=sha-,format=short

      - name: login to ghcr.io
        uses: docker/login-action@8aa5831fb8d48d8f76594c7ddde61ae58019f550 # v4.8.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # Pushes the image untagged; the merge job tags the multi-arch index.
      - name: build and push
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7.4.0
        with:
          context: .
          platforms: linux/${{ matrix.arch }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          outputs: type=image,name=${{ env.IMAGE }},push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=true
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.arch }}
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=${{ matrix.arch }}
          build-args: |
            VERSION=${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}

      - name: export digest
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/digests"
          digest="${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}"
          touch "$RUNNER_TEMP/digests/${digest#sha256:}"

      - name: upload digest
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: digest-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/digests/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  merge:
    needs: build
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: version
        id: version
        run: .github/workflows/docker-version.sh

      - name: download digests
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/digests
          pattern: digest-*
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: setup-buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1

      - name: immutable source identity
        id: publication
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          revision=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          source=$(bash .github/workflows/docker-promote.sh source-tag "$GITHUB_REF" "$revision")
          printf 'source=%s\n' "$source" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: docker-meta
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@dc802804100637a589fabce1cb79ff13a1411302 # v6.2.0
        with:
          images: ${{ env.IMAGE }}
          flavor: latest=false
          tags: |
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=raw,value=${{ steps.version.outputs.value }},enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=raw,value=${{ steps.publication.outputs.source }},priority=50
            type=sha,prefix=sha-,format=short

      - name: login to ghcr.io
        uses: docker/login-action@8aa5831fb8d48d8f76594c7ddde61ae58019f550 # v4.8.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: create and push multi-arch index
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/digests
        run: |
