name: test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '19 5 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && '["depot-ubuntu-24.04","depot-macos-latest","depot-windows-2025"]' || '["depot-ubuntu-24.04"]') }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.24.x"

      - name: Vet secure
        run: go vet ./secure/

      - name: Build all
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Test all
        run: go test ./... -count=1

      # -race needs cgo (a C toolchain); not reliably available on the
      # depot-windows-2025 runner, so it only runs on Unix.
      - name: Test secure with race detector
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: go test ./secure/ -race -count=1 -v

  freebsd:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Test on FreeBSD
        uses: vmactions/freebsd-vm@v1
        with:
          usesh: true
          run: |
            pkg install -y go
            go version
            go vet ./secure/
            go build ./...
            go test ./... -count=1
            go test ./secure/ -count=1 -v

  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '15 4 * * 1'

name: Test common files and sanity checks

concurrency:
  group: ci-common-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-native:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    container:
      image: pqclean/ci-container:${{ matrix.arch }}
      env:
        CC: ccache ${{ matrix.cc }}
        CCACHE_NOSTATS: 1
        CCACHE_DIR: /ccache
        CCACHE_SLOPPINESS: include_file_mtime
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && '["amd64","i386"]' || '["amd64"]') }}
        cc:
          - gcc
          - clang
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - name: Cache ccache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        env:
          cache-name: cache-ccache
        with:
          path: /ccache
          key: v1-${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ matrix.cc }}-${{ env.GITHUB_WORKFLOW }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        env:
          cache-name: cache-python
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: v1-python-pip
      - name: Install python dependencies
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd test
          python3 test_common.py --numprocesses=auto
      - name: Verify generated workflows
        if: matrix.arch == 'amd64' && matrix.cc == 'gcc'
        run: |
          cd test
          python3 test_workflows.py
  test-emulated:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch:
          - armhf
          - unstable-ppc
        cc: [gcc]
    env:
      CC: ${{ matrix.cc }}
    steps:
      - name: Register qemu-user-static
        run: |
          docker run --rm --privileged multiarch/qemu-user-static --reset -p yes
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - name: Cache ccache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        env:
          cache-name: cache-ccache

        env:
          cache-name: cache-python
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip

          docker run --rm -e CI -e CC -v $PWD:$PWD -w $PWD -v ~/ccache:/ccache pqclean/ci-container:${{ matrix.arch }} /bin/bash -c "\
          export CCACHE_NOSTATS=1 && \
          export CCACHE_DIR=/ccache && \
          export CCACHE_SLOPPINESS=include_file_mtime && \
          export CC=\"ccache $CC\" && \
          pip3 install -U --break-system-packages --ignore-installed -r requirements.txt && \
          cd test && \
          python3 test_common.py --numprocesses=auto"

          submodules: true
      - uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@v1

      - name: Setup astyle

          Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\.NetFramework\\v4.0.30319" -Name "SchUseStrongCrypto" -Value '1' -Type DWord

        with:
          python-version: "3.x"
      - name: Install python requirements
        run: python -m pip install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd test
          python test_common.py --numprocesses=auto
        shell: cmd
  test-macos:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    env:
      CC: clang
      CCACHE_NOSTATS: 1
      CCACHE_SLOPPINESS: include_file_mtime
    runs-on: depot-macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: maxim-lobanov/setup-xcode@v1
        with:
          xcode-version: latest-stable
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.x"
      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: |

          python test_common.py --numprocesses=auto

name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      verify_only:
        description: Run tests and build without publishing to Cloudflare
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: azure-magpie-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: bun test

      - name: Build Pages Bundle
        run: bun run build.ts

      - name: Ensure Cloudflare Pages Project Exists
        if: ${{ !inputs.verify_only }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID || vars.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: |
          npx wrangler pages project create azure-magpie --production-branch=main 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Sync GitHub App Secrets to Cloudflare Pages
        if: ${{ !inputs.verify_only }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID || vars.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          MAGPIE_APP_ID: ${{ secrets.MAGPIE_APP_ID || vars.MAGPIE_APP_ID || secrets.CAPY_APP_ID || vars.CAPY_APP_ID }}
          MAGPIE_INSTALLATION_ID: ${{ secrets.MAGPIE_INSTALLATION_ID || vars.MAGPIE_INSTALLATION_ID || secrets.CAPY_INSTALLATION_ID || vars.CAPY_INSTALLATION_ID }}
          MAGPIE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.MAGPIE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY || secrets.CAPY_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${{ secrets.WEBHOOK_SECRET }}
          LANDER_WAKE_URL: ${{ secrets.LANDER_WAKE_URL || vars.LANDER_WAKE_URL }}
          LANDER_WAKE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.LANDER_WAKE_SECRET }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN_FALLBACK: ${{ secrets.SUDA_MIRROR_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY' > /tmp/worker-secrets.json
          import json, os
          secrets = {}
          for key in ("MAGPIE_APP_ID", "MAGPIE_INSTALLATION_ID", "MAGPIE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY", "WEBHOOK_SECRET", "LANDER_WAKE_URL", "LANDER_WAKE_SECRET"):
              val = os.environ.get(key, "").strip()
              if val:
                  secrets[key] = val
          if "MAGPIE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY" not in secrets and os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN_FALLBACK", "").strip():
              secrets["GITHUB_TOKEN"] = os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN_FALLBACK"].strip()
          print(json.dumps(secrets))
          PY
          if [ "$(jq 'length' /tmp/worker-secrets.json)" -gt 0 ]; then
            npx wrangler pages secret bulk /tmp/worker-secrets.json --project-name=azure-magpie
          fi
          rm -f /tmp/worker-secrets.json

      - name: Deploy Bundle to Cloudflare Pages
        if: ${{ !inputs.verify_only }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID || vars.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: |
          npx wrangler pages deploy public --project-name=azure-magpie --branch=main

sources.content:
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - '*.md'
      - 'LICENSE'
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/*.md'
  # A workflow that owns a required check must start for every PR or that check
  # remains pending.
  # The scope job below keeps docs-only PRs lightweight without suppressing the
  # required aggregate `build` context.
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  workflow_dispatch:
  # One weekly, off-peak UTC run of the full 206-language exhaustive CGo
  # parity sweep (parity-cgo-exhaustive), which otherwise only runs on
  # workflow_dispatch or a PR that touches a narrow parser-result, C-recovery,
  # or C-oracle path filter. exhaustive_parity_scope below turns run_exhaustive
  # on for this event.
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * 1'

# A scheduled run's github.ref is the default branch, the same ref pushes to
# main use. Give schedule its own concurrency group so a push to main never
# cancels an in-flight weekly exhaustive run (and vice versa); two
# overlapping scheduled runs still cancel each other, which is desired.
#
# cancel-in-progress stays true for pull_request runs, workflow_dispatch runs,
# and pushes to any non-default branch, so superseded work still gets
# cancelled quickly. It is false only for a push to the default branch: a
# rapid run of pushes to main was cancelling every prior in-flight run before
# it reported a verdict, so most commits on main never got a pass/fail result
# at all. main pushes now queue and each one finishes with its own verdict.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' && 'weekly-exhaustive' || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ !(github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') }}

# VM runner services can share HOME and /tmp. Isolate their native Go
# caches and scratch, and disable setup-go archives, which retain producer
# paths. Hosted runners keep their standard cache paths and warm builds.
env:
  GOWORK: 'off'
  GOMAXPROCS: '2'
  GOFLAGS: '-p=1'

# Correctness and timing jobs use isolated Depot VMs with 16 GiB of memory.
# Planning and aggregation use the smaller Depot runner.
jobs:
  compile:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Repository hygiene
        run: bash scripts/repository_hygiene_test.sh

      - name: Editor-latency scope rule tests
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/editor_latency_scope_test.sh
          bash .github/scripts/editor_latency_legs_test.sh

      - name: R6 engine and environment guardrails
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin main
          GOWORK=off go test ./cmd/v1guard -count=1
          GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/v1guard -base FETCH_HEAD

      - name: L0 root, API, and test-move guardrails
        run: |
          GOWORK=off go test ./cmd/v1layout -count=1
          GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/v1layout -base FETCH_HEAD

      - name: Randomized benchmark driver contracts
        run: bash scripts/run_randomized_benchmarks_test.sh

      - name: Verify pinned benchmark fixtures
        run: |
          python3 scripts/benchfixture_corpus.py verify --role sample
          GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/benchfixturehash

      - name: A0 manifest cascade refresher contracts and live check
        run: |
          bash scripts/refresh_a0_manifest_cascade_test.sh
          bash scripts/refresh_a0_manifest_cascade.sh --check --tracked

      - name: Verify test package execution coverage
        run: |
          go test ./cmd/citestplan -count=1
          go run ./cmd/citestplan

      - name: Verify workflow -run/--run test name references
        # Fails when a `-run`/`--run` pattern under .github/workflows/*.yml
        # names a Test/Benchmark/Fuzz/Example that no longer exists, so a
        # rename or deletion cannot leave a CI step silently testing
        # nothing. Root selectors resolve only against root tests.
        # See cmd/citestplan/staleruns.go.
        run: go run ./cmd/citestplan -stale-run-names

      - name: Build
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Build emergency parser
        run: go build -tags gts_no_parsercorephase0 ./...

      - name: Test emergency parser routing
        run: go test . -tags gts_no_parsercorephase0 -run '^TestAdmissionSwitchDefaultBuildFallsBackLoudly$' -count=1

      - name: Build without copyleft-licensed grammars
        # gotreesitter_no_copyleft excludes caddy, disassembly, jq, and nim
        # (GPL-3.0/MPL-2.0 upstream grammars) from the public registry and
        # drops their hand-ported scanner source from compilation. See
        # docs/licensing.md.
        run: go build -tags gotreesitter_no_copyleft ./...

      - name: Test copyleft grammar opt-out
        run: go test ./grammars/ -tags gotreesitter_no_copyleft -run '^TestCopyleftLanguageSetMatchesRegistry$' -count=1 -v

      - name: Build grammar subsets
        run: bash scripts/subset_build_sweep.sh

      - name: Vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Install staticcheck
        run: go install honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@v0.6.1

      - name: Staticcheck (real-bug checks only)
        # Scoped to SA4000 (identical binary operands), SA4003 (impossible
        # comparison after a truncating conversion), SA5011 (nil dereference
        # before a nil check), SA4006 (dead store), SA4009 (parameter
        # overwritten before use), and SA1019 (deprecated use). Test files
        # are in scope: the SA4006 findings that once lived in
        # internal/parsercorephase0 test fixtures are fixed, so the gate now
        # covers both production and test code. ./grammars/ and ./cmd/...
        # are clean under the same checks and stay in the gate.
        run: staticcheck -checks 'SA4000,SA4003,SA5011,SA4006,SA4009,SA1019' . ./internal/... ./grammargen/ ./grammars/ ./cmd/...

      - name: Test Compile
        run: go test ./... -run '^$' -count=1

      - name: Incremental invariant ledger does not increase
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$BASE_SHA"
          python3 scripts/check_incremental_invariant_ledger.py "$BASE_SHA"

      - name: Incremental invariant sessions and no-edit allocation gate
        run: |
          GOWORK=off go test . \
            -run '^(TestIssue454ReconstructedSessionMatrix|TestIncrementalInvariantProbeLedger|TestIncrementalNoEditAllocations)$' \
            -count=1 -timeout=10m -v

      - name: Test immediate token precedence
        run: GOMAXPROCS=1 go test ./grammargen -run '^(TestBuildLexDFAPreservesLongerPreferredTokenAfterImmediateAccept|TestNormalizeNamedImmediateTokenKeepsAuthoredPrecedence)$' -count=1 -timeout=2m

      - name: Test generated repeat associativity
        run: GOMAXPROCS=1 go test ./grammargen -run '^TestResolveActionConflictVisibleLoweredRepeatBodyAssociativity$' -count=1 -timeout=2m

      - name: Test generated supertype aliases
        run: GOMAXPROCS=1 go test ./grammargen -run '^TestSupertypeMap(UsesPublicAlias|DeduplicatesPublicAliases)$' -count=1 -timeout=2m

  selected_store_admission:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Selected-store internal package (staged and one-pass)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test -race ./internal/parsercorephase0 -count=1
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test -race -tags gts_parsercorephase0_selectedstore_onepass ./internal/parsercorephase0 -count=1

      - name: Selected-store exact admission (staged and one-pass)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          admission='^TestDiagnosticParserCoreSelectedStore(CanonicalAdmissions|CompletenessFailureReleasesBacking|GoHighlightParity|QueryDirectiveParity)$'
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test -tags gts_parsercorephase0 . -run "$admission" -count=1
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test -tags 'gts_parsercorephase0 gts_parsercorephase0_selectedstore_onepass' . -run "$admission" -count=1

  compact_admission_ratchet:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:

  admission_route_equality_fuzz:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Route-equality seed corpus regression (required)
        # TestAdmissionRouteEqualityLockedCExceptions was removed for issue
        # 984 (production now matches tree-sitter C output for those
        # inputs); FuzzAdmissionRouteEquality's seed corpus carries the same
        # fixed inputs directly, so it alone covers this regression.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test . -run '^FuzzAdmissionRouteEquality$' -count=1 -v

      - name: Route-equality bounded live fuzzing, 45s (advisory)
        # Keep this non-blocking until clean-cache, per-language soaks bound
        # the workload and reproduce or retire the reported Haskell residual.
        run: |
          set +e
          GOMAXPROCS=1 go test . -run '^$' -fuzz '^FuzzAdmissionRouteEquality$' -fuzztime=45s
          status=$?
          set -e

          if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::warning::route-equality live fuzzing found a divergence (status ${status}); informational until the clean-cache promotion gate completes."
            {
              echo "### Admission Route-Equality Live Fuzzing"
              echo
              echo "\`go test . -run '^\$' -fuzz FuzzAdmissionRouteEquality -fuzztime=45s\` exited with status \`${status}\`."
              echo
              echo "This step is informational until clean-cache, per-language promotion soaks complete."
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Root Package Race Tests, Examples, and Fuzz Targets (shard ${{ matrix.shard }} of 5)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p harness_out/root-race
          pattern="$(bash .github/scripts/root_race_shard.sh regex "${{ matrix.shard }}" 5)"
          go test . -race -count=1 -timeout 15m -run "$pattern" -json |
            tee "harness_out/root-race/shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json"

  root_race_plan:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      isolated: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.isolated }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - id: plan
        name: Plan isolated root race gates
        run: echo "isolated=$(bash .github/scripts/root_race_shard.sh isolated-json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  race_root_isolated:
    needs:
      - exhaustive_parity_scope
      - root_race_plan
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target: ${{ fromJSON(needs.root_race_plan.outputs.isolated) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Root Package Isolated Race Gate (${{ matrix.target }})
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p harness_out/root-race
          go test . -race -count=1 -timeout 15m -run '^${{ matrix.target }}$' -json |
            tee "harness_out/root-race/isolated-${{ matrix.target }}.json"

  # Preserve the existing aggregate job ID consumed by the required `build`
  # context. The matrix result is successful only when every race shard passes.
  race_root:
    needs:
      - exhaustive_parity_scope
      - race_root_shards
      - race_root_isolated
    if: always() && needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check root race shards
        env:
          SHARDS_RESULT: ${{ needs.race_root_shards.result }}
          ISOLATED_RESULT: ${{ needs.race_root_isolated.result }}
        run: |
          if [ "$SHARDS_RESULT" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::race_root_shards finished with result=${SHARDS_RESULT}"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$ISOLATED_RESULT" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::race_root_isolated finished with result=${ISOLATED_RESULT}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All root race shards and isolated gates passed"

  race_packages:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: cmd
            package_filter: '/cmd/'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: grammarreceipt
            package_filter: '/internal/grammarreceipt$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: grammars-a-c
            package_filter: '/grammars($|/runtime$)'
            test_filter: '^(Test[A-C].*)$'
          - name: grammars-d-j
            package_filter: '/grammars($|/runtime$)'
            test_filter: '^(Test[D-J].*)$'
          - name: grammars-k-p
            package_filter: '/grammars($|/runtime$)'
            test_filter: '^(Test[K-P].*)$'
          - name: grammars-q-z
            package_filter: '/grammars($|/runtime$)'
            test_filter: '^(Test[Q-Z].*)$'
          - name: grammars-other
            package_filter: '/grammars($|/runtime$)'
            test_filter: '^(Test($|[^A-Z].*))$'
          - name: grammargen-support
            package_filter: '/grammargen/'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: parser-result
            package_filter: '/parser_result_test$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: support
            package_filter: '/grep$|/taproot($|/)|/internal/(luapattern|benchfixtures|benchorder|scannerstate|grammarpatch|sched|incr|reducechoice|declarationfacts|syntaxfacts|lexrun)$|/corpuscheck$|/roottest/bench$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: grammar-support
            package_filter: '/grammars/(grammar_blobs|internal/[^/]+|lean|python|swift)$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: query
            package_filter: '/roottest/query$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: highlight
            package_filter: '/roottest/highlight$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: parse
            package_filter: '/roottest/parse$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: wasm
            package_filter: '/wasm/runtime$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: recover
            package_filter: '/internal/recover$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: ccore
            package_filter: '/internal/ccore$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: ccore-bind
            package_filter: '/internal/ccore/bind$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: ccore-bindtest
            package_filter: '/internal/ccore/bind/bindtest$'
            test_filter: ''
          - name: ccore-bindall
            package_filter: '/internal/ccore/bind/bindall$'
            test_filter: ''
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Non-root Race Tests (${{ matrix.name }})
        # Keep each lane serialized under -race so timing-sensitive tests do
        # not contend with each other on 2-core hosted runners, but split the
        # former all-non-root sweep into package groups so the wall clock stays
        # near the target 10-minute envelope. The grammars package is split by
        # top-level test name ranges because it is one package with enough
        # parser-regression coverage to dominate the blocking matrix by itself.
        # Keep parser-result and grammargen support out of the grammar registry
        # lane; together they made the aggregate race shard sit near the timeout
        # cap even for data-only PRs.
        # Grammargen has a dedicated stable race subset below. Keep it out of
        # this matrix so its explicit exclusions remain visible.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pkgs="$(go run ./cmd/citestplan -lane "${{ matrix.name }}")"
          if [ -z "$pkgs" ]; then
            echo "No non-root packages to test for lane ${{ matrix.name }}"
            exit 0
          fi
          test_filter="${{ matrix.test_filter }}"
          if [ -n "$test_filter" ]; then
            go test $pkgs -race -count=1 -timeout 12m -p 1 -run "$test_filter"
          else
            go test $pkgs -race -count=1 -timeout 12m -p 1
          fi

  # The old full-package race job timed out at six minutes. The blocking
  # stable subset below skips nine tests with known costs or failures.
  # Keep each reason beside the skip list:
  #   TestLexMinimizeParityAcrossGrammars: its fortran subtest alone does
  #     not finish inside a 10-minute -timeout running by itself; the
  #     goroutine dump at that timeout shows it still actively computing
  #     inside computeLexModesWithContext, not deadlocked. This one test is
  #     the dominant cost behind the permanent 6-minute timeout above.
  #   TestImportedKotlinSwiftGrammarConstructors: SwiftGrammar's rule count
  #     drifted from a pinned 299 to 306 (grammar_source_test.go:218); the
  #     assertion is stale, not the grammar. Deterministic in isolation.
  #   TestMarkdownGrammarCommonMarkParity: 4 asserted pipe-table subtests
  #     (tb_star, tb_dash, tb_under, tb_spaced) diverge from the bundled
  #     reference CST (missing a wrapping pipe_table node).
  #   TestMarkdownFencedCodeBlockContentParity: the generated fenced-code
  #     block CST nests one level deeper than the bundled reference.
  #   TestShippedBlobsNonTerminalAliasMapInventory: 10 shipped grammars
  #     gained a non-empty NonTerminalAliasMap with no dedicated parity
  #     test registered for them yet (a self-reported ratchet failure).
  #   TestKotlinGrammarExtendSmoke, TestSwiftGrammarExtendSmoke,
  #     TestSwiftGrammarBlobParity: full-grammar regenerate/extend smoke
  #     tests for Kotlin and Swift, each costing 140-185s even without
  #     -race (timings on a benchmark host: 182.68s, 142.31s, 142.25s) because
  #     computeLexModesWithContext is the same expensive cost driver as the
  #     Fortran case above, triggered by these grammars' large lex-mode tables.
  #     These tests appear in no other CI job. The old six-minute job timed
  #     out before Fortran finished, so it did not cover them.
  #   TestGrammargenOwnedBlobsAreReproducible: a sequential, non-concurrent
  #     byte-determinism check (regenerate go/regex/swift/yaml and diff);
  #     156.26s non-raced on a benchmark host, with no goroutine interaction for
  #     -race to usefully check. A dedicated non-race job already runs it
  #     (`go test ./grammargen -run '^TestGrammargenOwnedBlobsAreReproducible$'`
  #     below), so skipping it here does not drop coverage.
  # None of the nine failures depend on race timing. Their assertions do not
  # use this package's raceEnabled skip or relax guard. The dedicated-job
  # check in cmd/citestplan now points to this stable subset.
  #
  # timeout-minutes reflects a real measurement, not an estimate: a clean,
  # unshared benchmark-host run of this package (-race, minus the nine skips)
  # finished well inside this budget. The prior 18m/15m budget (minus only
  # the first five skips) did not finish in a clean 30-minute run.
  grammargen_stable:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 18
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      # cgo_harness/go.mod, not go.mod: TestGeneratedCABI14LexModesRuntime
      # and TestGeneratedCABI15SupertypeRuntime shell out to `go -C
      # cgo_harness list -m` to locate a locked dependency, and cgo_harness
      # declares a newer `go` directive than this root module. Installing
      # only the root's older toolchain forces every run of those two
      # tests to either GOTOOLCHAIN=auto-download the newer one (which a
      # cold cache can turn into a corrupted or empty stdout capture, see
      # language_version_stamp_test.go) or hard-fail outright. A newer
      # toolchain builds and tests an older-`go`-directive module (this
      # one) fine, so installing to cgo_harness's floor satisfies both
      # modules and needs no download at all, matching the same fix
      # perf_scan_budget already uses below for the same reason.
      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: cgo_harness/go.mod

      # The locked tree-sitter binding is a local replace
      # (cgo_harness/internal/coracle), so no module download is needed
      # and the cold-cache failure described in language_version_stamp_test.go
      # cannot happen. This step stays as a cheap check that the replace
      # directory resolves before the grammargen tests rely on it.
      - name: Check cgo_harness's locked tree-sitter binding resolves
        working-directory: cgo_harness
        run: go mod download github.com/tree-sitter/go-tree-sitter

      - name: Test grammargen (stable subset, blocking)
        run: |
          go test ./grammargen -race -count=1 -timeout 15m \
            -skip '^(TestLexMinimizeParityAcrossGrammars|TestImportedKotlinSwiftGrammarConstructors|TestMarkdownGrammarCommonMarkParity|TestMarkdownFencedCodeBlockContentParity|TestShippedBlobsNonTerminalAliasMapInventory|TestKotlinGrammarExtendSmoke|TestSwiftGrammarExtendSmoke|TestSwiftGrammarBlobParity|TestGrammargenOwnedBlobsAreReproducible)$'

  draft_focused_tests:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == true
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Draft PR Focused Tests
        run: |
          go test . -run '^(TestLookupActionIndexSmallUsesDenseTokenRows|TestLookupActionIndexSmallUsesFullTokenRowsForOtherLanguages|TestLookupActionIndexSmallUsesFullSymbolRowsForGo|TestRawShapePropagatesThroughNoTreeAndCollapsedUnary|TestParseRuntimeReportsNoTreeNodeVolume|TestParseRuntimeReportsNoTreeCheckpointLeavesRemainNodes|TestParseNoTreeBenchmarkDropsRetainedExternalCheckpointCapacity|TestSetLexerErrorRunLexStateUsesCRecoveryGate|TestErrorCostCompetitionLanguageRequiresCapabilityByDefault)$' -count=1

  parity_report:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Run Parity Report (External Blob Mode)
        # -pgo=pgo/default.pgo: parity_report parses every registered
        # grammar's smoke sample on every PR, the closest thing this repo
        # has to a representative production parsing binary run in its own
        # CI. See pgo/README.md for the profile's provenance, regeneration
        # recipe, and scoped current receipts. PGO is a codegen-only
        # optimization; it does not change parity_report's output.
        run: |
          GOTREESITTER_GRAMMAR_BLOB_DIR=grammars/grammar_blobs \
          go run -pgo=pgo/default.pgo -tags grammar_blobs_external ./cmd/parity_report > parity.log

      - name: Upload Parity Log
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: parity-log
          path: parity.log

  perf_scan_budget:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: cgo_harness/go.mod

      - name: Validate perf scan budget ratchet
        working-directory: cgo_harness
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GOWORK=off go test ./cmd/perf_scan_budget ./cmd/perf_scan_status -count=1
          GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/perf_scan_budget \
            -budget perf_scan/perf_ratio_budgets.json

  # admission_route_performance_sanity is the admission-switch-specific
  # performance gate (spec.campaign perf-route-and-bookkeeping): it compares
  # the compact ("candidate") route against the production route, both pure
  # Go, interleaved in the same process on a fixed multi-language corpus, and
  # fails only on a gross regression (see the wide, documented tolerance in
  # TestAdmissionRoutePerformanceSanity itself).
  #
  # This intentionally does NOT touch the C oracle perf_scan_budget validates
  # above: that harness needs a self-hosted runner with a C toolchain and an
  # external corpus (cgo_harness/perf_scan/CI_PROPOSAL.md), which an ordinary
  # GitHub-hosted runner does not have, and a live oracle sweep is exactly
  # what this gate needs to avoid to stay fast and stable on every PR. A
  # relative, in-process, same-process ratio needs neither: it is what
  # a benchmark host's harness found stable within 5% even at host load
  # average 40, which the wide tolerance here still discounts further for a
  # shared runner's additional noise.
  admission_route_performance_sanity:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Admission route performance sanity (compact vs production, in-process, no C toolchain)
        run: GOWORK=off go test . -run '^TestAdmissionRoutePerformanceSanity$' -count=1 -v

  # glr_gss_demotion_scaling_gate guards the GLR fork/collapse-per-token
  # superlinear regression fixed alongside tryDemoteSingleLinearGSS's
  # demotion hysteresis (parser.go) and gssNodeCanReach's depth-bounded walk
  # (glr.go). It asserts on deterministic operation counts (GSSNodesDemoted,
  # GSSDemotions, and -- under -tags perf -- GSSCanReachVisits) rather than
  # wall-clock time, which is too noisy for a shared CI runner: see
  # glr_gss_demotion_scaling_test.go. This job is intentionally small and
  # fast (well under a minute), so cancellation from concurrency group churn
  # on repeated main pushes is not a practical risk.
  glr_gss_demotion_scaling_gate:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: GLR nested-fork/collapse scaling gate
        run: |
          go test -tags perf . \
            -run '^(TestGSSDemotionHysteresisScaling|TestGSSCanReachVisitScaling)$' \
            -count=1 -v -timeout 3m

  # oedit_latency_gate_full runs the full editor-latency gate sweep
  # (campaign O(edit) workstream W5, spec.campaign.oedit): all five gate
  # languages at the ~20KB, ~137KB, and ~1MB size tiers, crossed with every
  # edit class and position. The normal root suite in race_root_shards covers
  # the ~20KB and ~137KB tiers; GTS_W5_SLOW_TIER adds the ~1MB tier here.
  # This job also runs the JavaScript-family transient-error edit gate at all
  # three sizes. It is manual (workflow_dispatch only) and not part of
  # the required `build` gate so the slow tier remains available on demand
  # without adding its wall time to every PR.
  oedit_latency_gate_full:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Full editor-latency gate sweep (20KB/137KB/1MB)
        run: |
          GTS_W5_SLOW_TIER=1 \
          go test . \
            -run '^(TestW5EditorLatencyGate|TestW5JavaScriptFamilyTransientErrorGate)$' \
            -count=1 -v -timeout 8m

  # W5 times immutable real files against the exact PR base on this runner.
  # It is part of build: cancellation, missing evidence, and a >5% edit-cell
  # regression all block a code PR. The old generated-fixture W5 tests above
  # remain separate correctness/counter gates.
  # One job per language, in parallel, each with the full protocol (correctness,
  # counter gate, 20 paired seeds). The build gate reads needs.editor_latency.result,
  # which is expected to fail when a language job fails or is cancelled. As a
  # precaution it also checks each language job by name (see the build job):
  # GitHub users have reported a job cancelled before it gets a runner leaving
  # the aggregate at success; that was not observed here. The language list must
  # equal the languages of cgo_harness/editor_latency/fixtures.json (a test checks).
  editor_latency:
    name: editor_latency (${{ matrix.language }})
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: [typescript, tsx, javascript, python, java, c_sharp, php, bash, go, powershell]
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_editor_latency == 'true' && (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    # The gate holds a machine-wide lock (/tmp/gotreesitter-editor-latency.lock).
    # On a machine that hosts several runner services the language jobs run one
    # after another and the wait counts against this timeout.
    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: cgo_harness/go.mod

      - name: Test editor-latency evidence and failure paths
        run: python3 scripts/test_editor_latency_gate.py

      - name: Test private C-oracle cache
        run: |
          python3 scripts/test_w5_private_oracle.py
          python3 scripts/test_w5_private_oracle_parent.py

      - name: Paired real-code editor latency
        env:
          GTS_W5_PRIVATE_C_CACHE: "1"
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          W5_LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ "$W5_LANGUAGE" = go ] && [ "${PR_NUMBER:-}" = 1512 ] && [ "$BASE_SHA" = 9d14415d0a8d11632292310c578446b31554217b ]; then

            decision="$RUNNER_TEMP/w5-b7-owner-decision.json"
            printf '%s\n' '{"schema":"gts-w5-owner-decision-v1","owner_approved":true,"exception":"go-one-byte-undo-b7-to-278","base":"b7f1877f72c46ac2992e865ab636edad1d545060","reviewed_source":"2782879c97b4e28e9db7209ae7ddfbd6e9b69574","fixture_sha256":"ff2f811d29a56303bad96c3c7cff1a83814a974503a51cee918a314a96eb476e","tree_sha256":"a675b5e8c8e688c21f45cad8c5217c06802c3fa5061fb2555ba346b4769f4c55","base_admission_sha256":"4af75c271fee19a18a09caca22dba5fc3b0bb56142af480917f41f09ff69ef6a","head_admission_sha256":"4d7ae9309efb29d9a339d179f447aee788caee701d7d4c839ddbbcde53a863f0","oracle_runtime_commit":"10eb5ac119eec9cb4267a8e035066473983f5f3a","oracle_sources_sha256":"242c4f6b72d2d24421f84a505aa20164e43f144eb6401e876e6d24a167f06f51","oracle_go_grammar_commit":"2346a3ab1bb3857b48b29d779a1ef9799a248cd7","row":{"language":"go","workload":"one_byte","step":1,"counter":"reused_subtrees","before":39,"after":35},"context":{"reused_bytes_before":2816,"reused_bytes_after":2853,"nodes_before":109036,"nodes_after":108999},"scope":"This single counter row only; no timing, correctness, RSS, graduation or merge waiver.","owner_response_provenance":{"channel":"direct human owner reply","question_item_id":["request_user_input_async","call_3694a733fae64952bd5b34f85deeb359",0],"response":"Approve this scoped exception and minimal CI record"},"review_evidence":"https://github.com/odvcencio/gotreesitter/actions/runs/40949464539/job/123713570661"}' > "$decision"
            w5_options+=(--approved-b7-undo-receipt "$decision")

      - name: Publish W5 job summary
