  counter_ledger:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Check deterministic parser counters for 206 grammars
        run: |
          GOWORK=off go test ./cmd/perfcounterledger -count=1
          GOMAXPROCS=1 GOWORK=off go run ./cmd/perfcounterledger

  v1_edit_sessions:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - name: Run every v1 edit session in Docker
        env:
          SESSION_IMAGE: golang@sha256:3b4a11519ad929d1e1d261a12cff056f0c85b735253d7d861346b9c6f8b36437
          SESSION_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="${RUNNER_TEMP}/v1-edit-sessions"
          mkdir -p "$evidence" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/v1-go-build" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/v1-go-mod"
          docker pull "$SESSION_IMAGE"
          docker image inspect "$SESSION_IMAGE" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/v1-session-image.json"
          container="gts-v1-sessions-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          cleanup() {
            cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/v1-session-image.json" "$evidence/image.json"
            docker stop --time 10 "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            docker inspect "$container" > "$evidence/container.json" 2>/dev/null || true
            docker rm "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          }
          trap cleanup EXIT
          set +e
          docker run --name "$container" --memory 4g --memory-swap 4g --cpus 2 --pids-limit 512 \
            -e GOMAXPROCS=1 -e GOMEMLIMIT=3GiB -e GTS_V1_SOURCE_SHA="$SESSION_SOURCE_SHA" \
            -v "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE:/workspace:ro" -v "$evidence:/evidence" \
            -v "${RUNNER_TEMP}/v1-go-build:/go-build" -v "${RUNNER_TEMP}/v1-go-mod:/go-mod" \
            -e GOCACHE=/go-build -e GOMODCACHE=/go-mod \
            "$SESSION_IMAGE" bash /workspace/scripts/run_v1_invariant_sessions.sh /evidence
          status=$?
          set -e
          docker inspect "$container" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/v1-session-container.json"
          cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/v1-session-container.json" "$evidence/container.json"
          if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::v1 edit-session container failed with status $status"
            if [ -f "$evidence/summary.json" ]; then cat "$evidence/summary.json"; fi
            for log in root-build.log ledger-build.log counter-build.log; do
              if [ -s "$evidence/$log" ]; then echo "--- $log (last 20 lines)"; tail -n 20 "$evidence/$log"; fi
            done
            if [ -s "$evidence/status.tsv" ]; then
              IFS=$'\t' read -r route language code < <(tail -n 1 "$evidence/status.tsv")
              printf 'Last session: route=%s language=%s exit=%s\n' "$route" "$language" "$code"
              if [[ "$route" =~ ^[01]$ && "$language" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ && -f "$evidence/invariant-$route-$language.log" ]]; then
                awk '/^--- FAIL:|^FAIL$|panic:|fatal error:|_test.go:[0-9]+:/ {print substr($0, 1, 500); if (++n == 20) exit}' "$evidence/invariant-$route-$language.log"
              fi
            fi
            exit "$status"
          fi
          python3 - "$evidence/container.json" <<'PYCODE'
          import json, sys
          state = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))[0]['State']
          assert state['Status'] == 'exited' and state['ExitCode'] == 0 and not state['OOMKilled'], state
          PYCODE

  exhaustive_parity_scope:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      run_code_ci: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.run_code_ci }}
      run_exhaustive: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.run_exhaustive }}
      run_editor_latency: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.run_editor_latency }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - id: scope
        name: Detect CI and exhaustive parity scope
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          run_code_ci=true
          run_exhaustive=false
          run_editor_latency=true
          # The job's own folder: runner services can share /tmp.
          changed_files="$RUNNER_TEMP/changed-files.txt"
          reason_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/editor-latency-reason.txt"
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_dispatch" ] || [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "schedule" ]; then
            run_exhaustive=true
          elif [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            # --no-renames makes a code-to-docs rename expose both paths, so it
            # cannot accidentally take the lightweight docs-only route.
            git diff --name-only --no-renames "${PR_BASE_SHA}...HEAD" > "$changed_files"

            if [ ! -s "$changed_files" ]; then
              echo "::error::Pull request changed-file list is empty; refusing to skip code CI"
              exit 1
            fi

            run_code_ci=false
            while IFS= read -r path; do
              if [ "$path" = "LICENSE" ] ||
                 [[ "$path" =~ ^[^/]+\.md$ ]] ||
                 [[ "$path" =~ ^docs/ ]] ||
                 [[ "$path" =~ ^\.github/[^/]+\.md$ ]]; then
                continue
              fi
              run_code_ci=true
              break
            done < "$changed_files"

            if [ "$run_code_ci" = "false" ]; then
              git diff --check "${PR_BASE_SHA}...HEAD"
              {
                echo "### CI scope"
                echo
                echo "Docs-only PR: full code CI is skipped after the changed-file and whitespace checks pass."
              } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "run_code_ci=${run_code_ci}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "run_exhaustive=${run_exhaustive}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "run_editor_latency=${run_editor_latency}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi

            # The paired editor-latency job (ten language jobs, about 25 minutes)
            # is skipped only when the pull request changes no engine source; see
            # the script. The base's copy of the script decides, so a pull
            # request cannot switch the job off by editing the rule. A base
            # without the script runs the job.
            scope_rule="$RUNNER_TEMP/editor_latency_scope.base.sh"
            if git show "${PR_BASE_SHA}:.github/scripts/editor_latency_scope.sh" > "$scope_rule" 2> /dev/null; then
              run_editor_latency=$(bash "$scope_rule" "$changed_files" "$PWD" 2> "$reason_file") || run_editor_latency=true
            else
              run_editor_latency=true
              echo 'the base has no scope rule' > "$reason_file"
            fi
            if [ "$run_editor_latency" != "false" ]; then
              run_editor_latency=true
            fi
            {
              echo "### Editor-latency scope"
              echo
              echo "run_editor_latency=${run_editor_latency}: $(cat "$reason_file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

            # Every exhaustive test compares against the locked C oracle, so a
            # change to its pin (cgo_harness/go.mod) or its vendored runtime
            # runs the sweep too.
            exhaustive_pattern='^(parser_result_.*\.go|parser_recover_c.*\.go|parser_result_test/.*\.go|cgo_harness/(parity_cgo_test|parity_gate_ratchet_test)\.go|cgo_harness/go\.mod|cgo_harness/internal/coracle/.*)$'
            if grep -Eq "$exhaustive_pattern" "$changed_files"; then
              run_exhaustive=true
              {
                echo "### Exhaustive parity trigger"
                echo
                echo "Running exhaustive CGo parity because this PR touches parser-result, C-recovery, C-oracle, or parity-degradation gate files:"
                echo
                grep -E "$exhaustive_pattern" "$changed_files" | sed 's/^/- `/' | sed 's/$/`/'
              } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            else
              {
                echo "### Exhaustive parity trigger"
                echo
                echo "No parser-result, C-recovery, C-oracle, or parity-degradation gate files changed; exhaustive CGo parity is skipped."
              } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            fi
          fi

          echo "run_code_ci=${run_code_ci}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "run_exhaustive=${run_exhaustive}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "run_editor_latency=${run_editor_latency}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  build:
    needs:
      - compile
      - selected_store_admission
      - compact_admission_ratchet
      - admission_route_equality_fuzz
      - phase0_tagged_suite
      - race_root
      - race_packages
      - grammargen_stable
      - draft_focused_tests
      - parity_report
      - parity-cgo
      - perf_scan_budget
      - admission_route_performance_sanity
      - glr_gss_demotion_scaling_gate
      - apidiff
      - counter_ledger
      - v1_edit_sessions
      - editor_latency
      - exhaustive_parity_scope
      - compact-t3-oracle-cgo
      - merge-event-census-cgo
      - grammar-lock-stamp-receipts-cgo
      - ccore-equality-cgo
      - parity-cgo-exhaustive
      - freshness
      - compact-route-lifecycle-history
      - pr_commit_buildability
      - wasm_cross_build
      - wasm_tinygo_build
    if: always()
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    # Checkout, up to six tries of the job list, then the gate.
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      # The aggregate needs.editor_latency.result is expected to fail when a
      # language job fails or is cancelled. As a precaution against a case that
      # was reported for GitHub but not observed here (a job cancelled before it
      # gets a runner leaving the aggregate at success), list the jobs of this
      # run attempt and check each expected language by name.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          # Folders only: the default (cone) mode does not take file paths.
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/scripts
            cgo_harness/editor_latency
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      # Same condition as the editor_latency job and as the gate's requirement
      # below; when this step does not run, the gate does not read its output.
      - id: legs
        name: Check every editor-latency language job
        if: always() && needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_editor_latency == 'true' && (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          AGGREGATE_RESULT: ${{ needs.editor_latency.result }}
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          jobs_json="$RUNNER_TEMP/editor-latency-jobs.json"
          result=failure
          # Pages of 30: the API answered HTTP 502 to per_page=100 for the job
          # list of a re-run attempt (run 42687308051, 10 November 2026).
          # Six tries, 10 seconds apart: the API can fail for a moment, and the
          # list can lag behind a job that has just finished. A job's conclusion
          # is final within an attempt, so a retry cannot turn a failed or
          # cancelled language job into a pass.
          # When the aggregate is not success the gate fails anyway, so try once.
          tries=6
          if [ "$AGGREGATE_RESULT" != success ]; then
            tries=1
          fi
          for try in $(seq 1 "$tries"); do
            if timeout 60 gh api --paginate "repos/${REPO}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}/attempts/${RUN_ATTEMPT}/jobs?per_page=30" > "$jobs_json" &&
               bash .github/scripts/editor_latency_legs.sh "$jobs_json" cgo_harness/editor_latency/fixtures.json; then
              result=success
              break
            fi
            if [ "$try" != "$tries" ]; then
              sleep 10
            fi
          done
          echo "result=${result}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Check Required Build Gate
        if: always()
        env:
          EDITOR_LATENCY_LEGS_RESULT: ${{ steps.legs.outputs.result }}
          IS_DRAFT: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == true }}
          IS_PULL_REQUEST: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
          RUN_CODE_CI: ${{ needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci }}
          COMPILE_RESULT: ${{ needs.compile.result }}
          SELECTED_STORE_ADMISSION_RESULT: ${{ needs.selected_store_admission.result }}
          COMPACT_ADMISSION_RATCHET_RESULT: ${{ needs.compact_admission_ratchet.result }}
          ADMISSION_ROUTE_EQUALITY_FUZZ_RESULT: ${{ needs.admission_route_equality_fuzz.result }}
          PHASE0_TAGGED_SUITE_RESULT: ${{ needs.phase0_tagged_suite.result }}
          RACE_ROOT_RESULT: ${{ needs.race_root.result }}
          RACE_PACKAGES_RESULT: ${{ needs.race_packages.result }}
          GRAMMARGEN_STABLE_RESULT: ${{ needs.grammargen_stable.result }}
          DRAFT_FOCUSED_RESULT: ${{ needs.draft_focused_tests.result }}
          PARITY_REPORT_RESULT: ${{ needs.parity_report.result }}
          PARITY_CGO_RESULT: ${{ needs.parity-cgo.result }}
          PERF_SCAN_BUDGET_RESULT: ${{ needs.perf_scan_budget.result }}
          ADMISSION_ROUTE_PERFORMANCE_SANITY_RESULT: ${{ needs.admission_route_performance_sanity.result }}
          GLR_GSS_DEMOTION_SCALING_GATE_RESULT: ${{ needs.glr_gss_demotion_scaling_gate.result }}
          APIDIFF_RESULT: ${{ needs.apidiff.result }}
          COUNTER_LEDGER_RESULT: ${{ needs.counter_ledger.result }}
          V1_EDIT_SESSIONS_RESULT: ${{ needs.v1_edit_sessions.result }}
          EDITOR_LATENCY_RESULT: ${{ needs.editor_latency.result }}
          RUN_EDITOR_LATENCY: ${{ needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_editor_latency }}
          IS_MANUAL_RUN: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
          EXHAUSTIVE_PARITY_SCOPE_RESULT: ${{ needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.result }}
          EXHAUSTIVE_PARITY_SCOPE: ${{ needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_exhaustive }}
          COMPACT_T3_ORACLE_CGO_RESULT: ${{ needs.compact-t3-oracle-cgo.result }}
          MERGE_EVENT_CENSUS_CGO_RESULT: ${{ needs.merge-event-census-cgo.result }}
          GRAMMAR_LOCK_STAMP_RECEIPTS_CGO_RESULT: ${{ needs.grammar-lock-stamp-receipts-cgo.result }}
          CCORE_EQUALITY_CGO_RESULT: ${{ needs.ccore-equality-cgo.result }}
          EXHAUSTIVE_PARITY_RESULT: ${{ needs.parity-cgo-exhaustive.result }}
          FRESHNESS_RESULT: ${{ needs.freshness.result }}
          COMPACT_ROUTE_LIFECYCLE_HISTORY_RESULT: ${{ needs.compact-route-lifecycle-history.result }}
          PR_COMMIT_BUILDABILITY_RESULT: ${{ needs.pr_commit_buildability.result }}
          WASM_CROSS_BUILD_RESULT: ${{ needs.wasm_cross_build.result }}
          WASM_TINYGO_BUILD_RESULT: ${{ needs.wasm_tinygo_build.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          failed=0

          require_success() {
            local name="$1"
            local result="$2"
            if [ "$result" != "success" ]; then
              echo "::error::${name} finished with result=${result}"
              failed=1
            fi
          }

          require_success "exhaustive_parity_scope" "$EXHAUSTIVE_PARITY_SCOPE_RESULT"

          if [ "$RUN_CODE_CI" = "false" ]; then
            if [ "$failed" -ne 0 ]; then
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Docs-only required build gate passed"
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ "$RUN_CODE_CI" != "true" ]; then
            echo "::error::exhaustive_parity_scope emitted invalid run_code_ci=${RUN_CODE_CI}"
            exit 1
          fi

          require_success "freshness" "$FRESHNESS_RESULT"
          require_success "compact-route-lifecycle-history" "$COMPACT_ROUTE_LIFECYCLE_HISTORY_RESULT"
          require_success "compile" "$COMPILE_RESULT"
          require_success "selected_store_admission" "$SELECTED_STORE_ADMISSION_RESULT"
          require_success "compact_admission_ratchet" "$COMPACT_ADMISSION_RATCHET_RESULT"
          require_success "admission_route_equality_fuzz" "$ADMISSION_ROUTE_EQUALITY_FUZZ_RESULT"
          require_success "phase0_tagged_suite" "$PHASE0_TAGGED_SUITE_RESULT"
          require_success "parity_report" "$PARITY_REPORT_RESULT"
          require_success "parity-cgo" "$PARITY_CGO_RESULT"
          require_success "perf_scan_budget" "$PERF_SCAN_BUDGET_RESULT"
          require_success "admission_route_performance_sanity" "$ADMISSION_ROUTE_PERFORMANCE_SANITY_RESULT"
          require_success "glr_gss_demotion_scaling_gate" "$GLR_GSS_DEMOTION_SCALING_GATE_RESULT"
          require_success "apidiff" "$APIDIFF_RESULT"
          require_success "counter_ledger" "$COUNTER_LEDGER_RESULT"
          if [ "$IS_MANUAL_RUN" = "true" ]; then
            require_success "v1_edit_sessions" "$V1_EDIT_SESSIONS_RESULT"
          fi
          require_success "compact-t3-oracle-cgo" "$COMPACT_T3_ORACLE_CGO_RESULT"
          require_success "merge-event-census-cgo" "$MERGE_EVENT_CENSUS_CGO_RESULT"
          require_success "grammar-lock-stamp-receipts-cgo" "$GRAMMAR_LOCK_STAMP_RECEIPTS_CGO_RESULT"
          require_success "ccore-equality-cgo" "$CCORE_EQUALITY_CGO_RESULT"
          require_success "wasm_cross_build" "$WASM_CROSS_BUILD_RESULT"
          require_success "wasm_tinygo_build" "$WASM_TINYGO_BUILD_RESULT"

          if [ "$IS_PULL_REQUEST" = "true" ]; then
            require_success "pr_commit_buildability" "$PR_COMMIT_BUILDABILITY_RESULT"
          fi
          if [ "$IS_PULL_REQUEST" = "true" ] || [ "$IS_MANUAL_RUN" = "true" ]; then
            if [ "$RUN_EDITOR_LATENCY" = "true" ]; then
              require_success "editor_latency" "$EDITOR_LATENCY_RESULT"
              require_success "editor_latency language jobs" "${EDITOR_LATENCY_LEGS_RESULT:-missing}"
            elif [ "$RUN_EDITOR_LATENCY" = "false" ]; then
              if [ "$EDITOR_LATENCY_RESULT" != "skipped" ]; then
                echo "::error::editor_latency finished with result=${EDITOR_LATENCY_RESULT} but run_editor_latency=false requires skipped"
                failed=1
              fi
            else
              echo "::error::exhaustive_parity_scope emitted invalid run_editor_latency=${RUN_EDITOR_LATENCY}"
              failed=1
            fi
          fi

          if [ "$IS_DRAFT" = "true" ]; then
            require_success "draft_focused_tests" "$DRAFT_FOCUSED_RESULT"
          else
            require_success "race_root" "$RACE_ROOT_RESULT"
            require_success "race_packages" "$RACE_PACKAGES_RESULT"
            require_success "grammargen_stable" "$GRAMMARGEN_STABLE_RESULT"
          fi

          if [ "$EXHAUSTIVE_PARITY_SCOPE" = "true" ]; then
            require_success "parity-cgo-exhaustive" "$EXHAUSTIVE_PARITY_RESULT"
          fi

          if [ "$failed" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Required build gate passed"

  # Draft PR correctness visibility (NOT a required check).
  #
  # Background: the blocking `race_root` / `race_packages` jobs are
  # intentionally skipped while a PR is a draft, so draft PRs only run the
  # small hand-picked `draft_focused_tests` required-check input instead of
  # the real race suite.
  #
  # That blind spot let a real regression go unseen for weeks: on the
  # codex/glr-parity-buckets campaign PR (#133), root-package RealParser
  # Kotlin parity silently regressed from 40/40 to 22/40 while the PR sat in
  # draft (now fixed) — root-package parity tests never ran on that PR at
  # all, because the focused list didn't cover them and the full suite never
  # ran while draft. The branch also separately accumulated ~25 root-package
  # and ~21 grammars-package pre-existing failures that were never visible
  # in CI for the same reason.
  #
  # This job closes that gap: it runs the root + grammars package suite (no
  # -race, for speed/turnaround) on every draft PR push, so failures are
  # SEEN as they land instead of discovered after the fact.
  #
  # It is intentionally NOT a required check yet (that's a repo
  # branch-protection setting, not this file). With ~46 known pre-existing
  # failures on the campaign branch today, requiring this job would make
  # every draft PR permanently red and block all progress. Once the
  # pre-existing failure count is driven to zero, promote this job to
  # required to turn it into a ratchet.
  draft-correctness:
    # Only meaningful for draft PRs: non-draft PRs already get the blocking
    # race suite through `race_root` and `race_packages`.
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == true
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 30
    continue-on-error: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Draft Correctness Suite (root + grammars, no -race)
        run: |
          # No -race: trades race detection for speed so this is cheap
          # enough to run on every draft push. The full -race suite still
          # runs once the PR leaves draft (`race_root` / `race_packages`).
          #
          # -timeout 25m: the root package alone contains two known
          # C#-boundedness tests (TestCSharpDesignerStyleBlockStaysBounded,
          # TestCSharpCJKPartialClassesStayBounded) that currently run
          # ~130-150s each before hitting their internal parser-level
          # timeout and failing. The non-draft race suite does not
          # special-case them either, so mirror that behavior here and give
          # the whole draft visibility run a generous budget.
          go test . ./grammars ./grammars/runtime -count=1 -timeout 25m

  freshness:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Check linguist_gen.go freshness
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Regenerate using the vendored languages.yml to keep the check
          # deterministic (not affected by upstream linguist changes).
          go run ./cmd/gen_linguist \
            -manifest grammars/languages.manifest \
            -languages-yml grammars/languages.yml \
            -out grammars/linguist_gen.go
          if ! git diff --exit-code grammars/linguist_gen.go; then
            echo "::error::grammars/linguist_gen.go is stale. Regenerate:"
            echo "::error::  go run ./cmd/gen_linguist -manifest grammars/languages.manifest -languages-yml grammars/languages.yml"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Check selective blob embed freshness
        run: go run ./cmd/gen_subset_blob_embeds -check

      - name: Check standalone grammar packages
        run: go run ./cmd/gen_grammar_packages -check

      - name: Check third-party license notices freshness
        # Confirms licenses/grammars.json still covers every grammar in
        # grammars/languages.lock (no missing, no stale entries) and that
        # THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES is regenerated from the current audit. See
        # docs/licensing.md.
        run: go run ./cmd/gen_license_notices -check

      - name: Check grammargen-owned blobs are reproducible
        # Regenerates every grammargen-owned blob (go, regex, swift; see
        # grammars/registry_builtin_gen.go's GrammarSourceGrammargenBlob
        # entries) with its documented recipe and compares SHA-256 against
        # the shipped file. See docs/grammar-ownership.md.
        run: go test ./grammargen -run '^TestGrammargenOwnedBlobsAreReproducible$' -count=1 -v

      - name: Check generated source ownership
        run: bash scripts/check_generated_ownership.sh

      - name: Check grammar blob coverage matches lock
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Extract grammar names from lock (skip comments and blanks).
          lock_names=$(grep -v '^#' grammars/languages.lock | grep -v '^$' | awk '{print $1}' | sort)
          lock_count=$(echo "$lock_names" | wc -l)

          # Extract grammar names from .bin files.
          blob_names=$(ls grammars/grammar_blobs/*.bin 2>/dev/null | xargs -I{} basename {} .bin | sort)
          blob_count=$(echo "$blob_names" | wc -l)

          # Extract grammar names from embedded_grammars_gen.go. Most wrappers
          # call loadEmbeddedLanguage("name.bin"), but a small number use the
          # preferred-language entrypoint (for override-aware blobs) and pass
          # the raw grammar name instead.
          gen_names=$(
            grep -oP '(?:loadEmbeddedLanguage\("\K[^"]+(?=\.bin"\))|(?:loadPreferredLanguage\("\K[^"]+(?="\))))' \
              grammars/embedded_grammars_gen.go | sort
          )
          gen_count=$(echo "$gen_names" | wc -l)

          echo "lock: $lock_count | blobs: $blob_count | gen functions: $gen_count"

          # Three-way consistency: lock ↔ blobs ↔ gen functions.
          missing_blobs=$(comm -23 <(echo "$lock_names") <(echo "$blob_names"))
          if [ -n "$missing_blobs" ]; then
            echo "::error::Grammar blobs missing for lock entries: $missing_blobs"
            echo "Run: go run ./cmd/ts2go -manifest grammars/languages.lock -outdir ./grammars -package grammars"
            exit 1
          fi

          orphan_blobs=$(comm -13 <(echo "$lock_names") <(echo "$blob_names"))
          if [ -n "$orphan_blobs" ]; then
            echo "::warning::Orphan blobs not in lock file: $orphan_blobs"
          fi

          missing_gen=$(comm -23 <(echo "$lock_names") <(echo "$gen_names"))
          if [ -n "$missing_gen" ]; then
            echo "::error::embedded_grammars_gen.go missing functions for: $missing_gen"
            echo "Run: go run ./cmd/ts2go -manifest grammars/languages.lock -outdir ./grammars -package grammars"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "$blob_count" -ne "$lock_count" ] || [ "$gen_count" -ne "$lock_count" ]; then
            echo "::error::Count mismatch — lock: $lock_count, blobs: $blob_count, gen: $gen_count"
            exit 1
          fi

  compact-route-lifecycle-history:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Validate compact route campaign lifecycle history
        env:
          GTS_REQUIRE_HISTORICAL_RECEIPT_PROOF: "1"
        run: go test . -run '^TestCompactRouteCampaignLifecycleRegistry$' -count=1

  # gotreesitter's README and wasm/README both promise cross-compilation to
  # GOOS=js and GOOS=wasip1 with no CGo and no C toolchain, but no CI lane
  # built either target before this job. A manual GOOS=wasip1 build passed
  # before this job existed; this makes that claim a checked gate instead of
  # an unverified README promise.
  wasm_cross_build:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 10
    # Cold cross-builds for both targets exceeded the shared 10-minute budget.
    # Give each target the same limit and require both matrix results.
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        goos: [js, wasip1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Build (GOOS=${{ matrix.goos }} GOARCH=wasm)
        env:
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: wasm
        run: go build ./...

  # TinyGo is a real downstream consumer's toolchain, not a hypothetical
  # target: gosx compiles gotreesitter to WASM with TinyGo. This job builds
  # the same wasm/runtime entry point and go-language subset that
  # cmd/wasmassets produces for a TinyGo asset bundle (see wasm/README.md),
  # proving the module keeps compiling under TinyGo instead of only under
  # the standard Go toolchain's GOOS=js/wasip1 targets above.
  #
  # The release tarball is pinned by exact version and verified by SHA-256
  # before it is extracted, matching this file's existing pinned-tool
  # conventions (staticcheck, apidiff).
  #
  # timeout-minutes is generous: TinyGo's LLVM backend with -opt=z is
  # measurably slower than the native Go compiler. A verified run took
  # ~18m wall time on a heavily shared, oversubscribed build host; an
  # isolated GitHub-hosted runner should do noticeably better, but this
  # budget leaves headroom until real CI history is available.
  wasm_tinygo_build:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      TINYGO_VERSION: "0.41.1"
      TINYGO_SHA256: e156d1d93a376eef639a4143d13be07e8c463fb6cf2d7d447698ed4474d23e91
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Install TinyGo ${{ env.TINYGO_VERSION }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL -o /tmp/tinygo.tar.gz \
            "https://github.com/tinygo-org/tinygo/releases/download/v${TINYGO_VERSION}/tinygo${TINYGO_VERSION}.linux-amd64.tar.gz"
          echo "${TINYGO_SHA256}  /tmp/tinygo.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          sudo tar -C /usr/local -xzf /tmp/tinygo.tar.gz
          echo "/usr/local/tinygo/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: TinyGo build (wasm/runtime, go grammar subset)
        run: |
          tinygo version
          tinygo build -tags grammar_subset,grammar_subset_go -target wasm -no-debug -opt=z -o /tmp/gotreesitter-tinygo.wasm ./wasm/runtime

  # Compare the root package API with the highest stable version tag. This
  # keeps the baseline current without manual updates after each release.
  #
  # golang.org/x/exp has no tagged releases, so APIDIFF_TOOL_VERSION pins an
  # exact pseudo-version of the tool. Bump it independently of the API tag.
  apidiff:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      APIDIFF_TOOL_VERSION: v0.0.0-20260811152304-ee035b5b010f
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Public API diff vs latest stable tag (package gotreesitter)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          git fetch --tags --depth=1 origin
          APIDIFF_BASELINE_TAG="$(git tag --list 'v[0-9]*' --sort=-version:refname | awk '/^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/ && !selected { selected = $0 } END { print selected }')"
          if [ -z "$APIDIFF_BASELINE_TAG" ]; then
            echo "::error::no stable version tag found for the public API baseline"
            exit 1
          fi
          printf 'Using public API baseline %s\n' "$APIDIFF_BASELINE_TAG"

          OLD_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/apidiff-old"
          mkdir -p "${OLD_DIR}"
          git archive "${APIDIFF_BASELINE_TAG}" | tar -x -C "${OLD_DIR}"

          OLD_EXPORT="${RUNNER_TEMP}/apidiff-old.export"
          NEW_EXPORT="${RUNNER_TEMP}/apidiff-new.export"
          apidiff_run() {
            go run "golang.org/x/exp/cmd/apidiff@${APIDIFF_TOOL_VERSION}" "$@"
          }

          ( cd "${OLD_DIR}" && apidiff_run -w "${OLD_EXPORT}" . )
          apidiff_run -w "${NEW_EXPORT}" .

          report="${RUNNER_TEMP}/apidiff-report.txt"
          apidiff_run "${OLD_EXPORT}" "${NEW_EXPORT}" | tee "${report}"
          {
            echo "### Public API diff: ${APIDIFF_BASELINE_TAG} -> HEAD"
            echo
            if [ -s "${report}" ]; then
              echo '```'
              cat "${report}"
              echo '```'
            else
              echo "No public API change in package \`gotreesitter\`."
            fi
          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

          incompatible="${RUNNER_TEMP}/apidiff-incompatible.txt"
          apidiff_run -incompatible "${OLD_EXPORT}" "${NEW_EXPORT}" | tee "${incompatible}"

          # The owner accepts breaks for the next release in
          # .github/apidiff-accepted-breaks.txt: one entry per line, three
          # tab-separated fields (the exact apidiff line, the PR, the upgrade
          # note). Only whole-line matches count. Every other break fails.
          accepted="${RUNNER_TEMP}/apidiff-accepted.txt"
          awk -F'\t' '
            /^[[:space:]]*(#|$)/ { next }
            NF < 3 || $1 == "" || $2 == "" || $3 == "" { printf "::error file=.github/apidiff-accepted-breaks.txt,line=%d::entry needs <apidiff line><TAB><PR><TAB><upgrade note>\n", FNR > "/dev/stderr"; bad = 1; next }
            seen[$1]++ { printf "::error file=.github/apidiff-accepted-breaks.txt,line=%d::duplicate entry: %s\n", FNR, $1 > "/dev/stderr"; bad = 1; next }
            { print $1 }
            END { exit bad }
          ' .github/apidiff-accepted-breaks.txt > "${accepted}"

          unexpected="${RUNNER_TEMP}/apidiff-unexpected.txt"
          stale="${RUNNER_TEMP}/apidiff-stale.txt"
          grep -Fxv -f "${accepted}" "${incompatible}" > "${unexpected}" || true
          grep -Fxv -f "${incompatible}" "${accepted}" > "${stale}" || true
          if [ -s "${stale}" ]; then
            while IFS= read -r line; do
              echo "::warning file=.github/apidiff-accepted-breaks.txt::stale accepted break (no longer reported by apidiff): ${line}"
            done < "${stale}"
          fi
          if [ -s "${unexpected}" ]; then
            echo "::error::incompatible public API change(s) in package gotreesitter against ${APIDIFF_BASELINE_TAG} that .github/apidiff-accepted-breaks.txt does not list; see the job log or step summary above"
            cat "${unexpected}"
            exit 1
          fi

  # PR #133 landed 140 consecutive commits that did not compile
  # ("normalizeReturnedParseTree undefined"), because nothing built each
  # commit on its own. Main's history is a sequence of merge commits, and the
  # individual commits underneath every merge stay reachable and bisectable,
  # so a broken intermediate commit silently breaks `git bisect` for anyone
  # who lands on it later. This job builds every commit the PR adds and fails
  # on the first one that does not compile.
  #
  # PR_COMMIT_BUILD_CAP bounds the added wall time: past the cap this job
  # skips the sweep with a clear, non-blocking message instead of building an
  # unbounded number of commits. A PR with more commits than the cap should
  # squash into fewer commits, or merge with the "Squash and merge" strategy,
  # so a broken intermediate commit never lands on main's history at all.
  pr_commit_buildability:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      PR_COMMIT_BUILD_CAP: 50
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Build every commit in the PR range
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          commit_dir=$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/pr-commits.XXXXXX")
          trap 'rm -rf "$commit_dir"' EXIT
          git rev-list "${BASE_SHA}..${HEAD_SHA}" > "${commit_dir}/commits.txt"
          count=$(wc -l < "${commit_dir}/commits.txt")

          if [ "${count}" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "No commits between base and head; nothing to build."
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ "${count}" -gt "${PR_COMMIT_BUILD_CAP}" ]; then
            {
              echo "### Per-commit buildability sweep skipped"
              echo
              echo "This PR adds ${count} commits, over the ${PR_COMMIT_BUILD_CAP}-commit cap for building every commit individually. Skipping the sweep to bound CI time."
              echo
              echo "Squash this PR into fewer commits before merge, or merge it with the \"Squash and merge\" strategy, so a broken intermediate commit cannot land on main's history."
            } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
            echo "::warning::${count} commits exceed the ${PR_COMMIT_BUILD_CAP}-commit buildability sweep cap; skipped. Squash before merge."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Building ${count} commit(s) between ${BASE_SHA} and ${HEAD_SHA}"

          # git rev-list lists newest first; build oldest first so the
          # reported failure is the first commit that broke the build.
          tac "${commit_dir}/commits.txt" > "${commit_dir}/commits-chrono.txt"

          failed=0
          while IFS= read -r commit; do
            echo "::group::go build ./... @ ${commit}"
            git checkout --quiet --detach "${commit}"
            if ! go build ./...; then
              echo "::endgroup::"
              echo "::error::commit ${commit} does not compile (go build ./...); this breaks git bisect for anyone who lands on it"
              failed=1
              break
            fi
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done < "${commit_dir}/commits-chrono.txt"

          git checkout --quiet "${HEAD_SHA}"

          if [ "${failed}" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All ${count} commit(s) build cleanly."

  compact-t3-oracle-cgo:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'

            --goflags -p=1 \

            --timeout 8m \
            -- "cd /workspace/cgo_harness && go test . -tags gts_parsercorephase0,treesitter_c_parity -run '^TestCompactYAMLDocumentStreamLockedC$' -count=1 -parallel=1 -timeout=8m -v"

      - name: Elm admission contract against locked C
        run: |
          bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
            --no-build \

  # merge-event-census-cgo runs stage M0 of spec.merge-time-election.v1: the
  # census that counts stack-merge events on both sides and breaks production's
  # refusals down by gate. Every cgo parity lane in this file runs a FIXED
  # --run regex, so a new cgo test runs nowhere unless it is named here; see
  # docs/ci-gate-coverage.md. This lane names it.
  #
  # The census needs its own build tags, so it uses the docker runner's custom
  # command form rather than --run: gts_merge_census compiles the production
  # instrument into the library, and the lane is the only place it is compiled
  # at all (merge_event_census_inert_test.go ratchets its absence everywhere
  # else). The reference side compiles the repository's own work-count patch
  # against the pinned runtime source from the module cache, so the lane needs
  # cc and git, which the harness image already carries.
  merge-event-census-cgo:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Merge-event census (stage M0 baseline and Foo[int](a) receipt)
        run: |
          GTS_PARITY_MODE=smoke \
          bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
            --label ci-merge-event-census \
            --memory 8g \
            --cpus 2 \
            --pids 4096 \
            --gomemlimit 6GiB \
            --goflags -p=1 \
            --test-parallel 1 \
            --c-ref-build-jobs 1 \
            --timeout 30m \
            -- "cd /workspace/cgo_harness && GOWORK=off go test \
              -tags 'cgo treesitter_c_parity gts_merge_census' \
              -run '^TestMergeEventCensus' -count=1 -v -timeout 30m ."

  # grammar-lock-stamp-receipts-cgo runs the dispatcher-blocker and live-arm
  # receipts whose grammar-lock evidence check hashes the live
  # grammars/languages.lock file instead of comparing it to a frozen
  # literal (see docs/ci-gate-coverage.md). No lane ran these receipts
  # before, so a stale pinned hash from before the Kotlin grammar bump went
  # unnoticed through three more lock changes. This lane confirms the ten
  # receipts below stay green after every future grammar-lock bump. The
  # Julia, WGSL, Templ, and Go receipts joined after a follow-up
  # adjudication re-pinned each one against its current, intentional

  grammar-lock-stamp-receipts-cgo:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Grammar-lock stamp receipts (Cooklang, Wolfram, Solidity, Doxygen, SQL, Perl, Julia, WGSL, Templ, Go)
        run: |

            --gomemlimit 6GiB \

            --c-ref-build-jobs 1 \

  # ccore-equality-cgo checks internal/ccore against pinned C: the parse log,
  # the visible-tree digest, the subtree records, edit sessions, the lookup
  # tables and the committed goldens (cgo_harness/ccore_*_test.go). One
  # grammar per container: json (no scanner, no keyword lexer), python
  # (external scanner and keyword lexer), c (keyword lexer, no scanner) and
  # typescript (a large table). Nothing parses through internal/ccore outside
  # these tests. The inputs are files under testdata folders, named in the
  # tests, and literals; no private input is read. With a custom command the
  # runner's --timeout and --test-parallel do nothing; the script runs each
  # test with -test.timeout=40m and one process, and --wall-timeout 45m (a
  # kill of the container) bounds the whole run, inside the job's 60 minutes.
  # The script fails when a test it runs has no PASS line or no positive count
  # (its --self-test shows that, and the first step runs it).
  ccore-equality-cgo:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: [json, python, c, typescript]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: The equality script fails on a missing test or a zero count
        run: bash cgo_harness/docker/ccore_equality.sh --self-test

      - name: internal/ccore equals pinned C (${{ matrix.language }})
        run: |
          GTS_PARITY_MODE=smoke \
          bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
            --label ci-ccore-${{ matrix.language }} \
            --memory 8g \
            --cpus 2 \
            --pids 4096 \
            --gomemlimit 6GiB \
            --goflags -p=1 \
            --c-ref-build-jobs 1 \
            --wall-timeout 45m \
            -- "bash /workspace/cgo_harness/docker/ccore_equality.sh ${{ matrix.language }}"

  parity-cgo:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Build cgo harness image
        # This job calls run_parity_in_docker.sh many times below. Building
        # once here and passing --no-build on every later call avoids
        # rebuilding (and re-pulling base images) per step. See
        # docs/ci-gate-coverage.md for the build-once policy and the
        # in-script retry that absorbs transient registry failures.
        run: |
          bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh --build-only

      - name: Verify report Lua predicates
        run: |
          bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
            --no-build \
            --label ci-report-lua-predicates \
            --memory 4g \
            --gomemlimit 3GiB \
            --cpus 2 \
            --wall-timeout 5m \
            -- "cd /workspace/cgo_harness && go test ./cmd/parse_gap_report -tags treesitter_c_parity -race -run '^TestLuaHighlightPredicatesMatchProduction$' -count=1"

      - name: CGo Parity Smoke Gate
        # TestOutlineOracleDifferential (cgo_harness/outline_differential_test.go)
        # joined this regex next to its query/capture-parity sibling
        # TestParityHighlight. The Dart live-arm probe and receipt guard are
        # also named explicitly so their blocker receipt remains executable.
        # Every cgo parity lane in this file runs a FIXED --run regex, so a
        # new cgo test runs nowhere unless it is named here; see
        # docs/ci-gate-coverage.md. Its CoreNine subtest hard-gates the nine
        # core languages; its FleetCensus subtest only logs a census row, so
        # naming the whole test is safe.
        # GTS_PARITY_COMPARE_HAS_ERROR=1 makes compareNodes also compare each
        # node's HasError flag on this ring (cgo_harness/parity_cgo_test.go).
        # Measured at zero divergences across the smoke languages before it
        # was turned on here; the top-50 ring stays flag-off until measured.
        run: |
          GTS_PARITY_MODE=smoke \
          GTS_PARITY_COMPARE_HAS_ERROR=1 \
          bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
            --no-build \
            --label ci-parity-cgo-smoke \
            --memory 8g \
            --cpus 2 \
            --pids 4096 \
            --gomemlimit 6GiB \
            --goflags -p=1 \
            --test-parallel 1 \
            --timeout 20m \
            --run '^TestCOracleVendoredSources$|^TestIncrementalCReuseEOFInvalidatesHTTPSections$|^TestIncrementalCReuseEOFInvalidatesDartLibrary$|^TestIncrementalCReuseLedgerReadDependencies$|^TestParityFreshParse$|^TestParityIncrementalParse$|^TestParityHasNoErrors$|^TestParityIssue3Repros$|^TestParityGLRCanaryGo$|^TestParityGLRCanarySet$|^TestParityGLRCapPressureTopLanguages$|^TestParityGateCoverageRatchet$|^TestParityHighlight$|^TestOutlineOracleDifferential$|^TestOutlineLuaMatchPredicateUsesSharedCompiler$|^TestHighlightLuaMatchPredicateUsesSharedCompiler$|^TestParityJavaScriptAutomaticSemicolonBeforeTrailingComment$|^TestParityJavaScriptAdjacentBlockCommentsDoNotConsumeFollowingToken$|^TestIncludedRangesGoRootParity$|^TestIncludedRangesGoArmGuardsRootSymbol$|^TestIncludedRangesKotlinRootParity$|^TestDartNextLiveArmProbe$|^TestDartNextLiveArmReceiptDocument$|^TestTsxJsxTextEqualsLockedC$|^TestTsxJsxTextAmpersandKnownDivergenceFromLockedC$'

      - name: JavaScript and TypeScript contextual lookahead against locked C
        run: |
          contextual_args=(
            --no-build --memory 4g --gomemlimit 3GiB --cpus 1
            --goflags -p=1 --test-parallel 1 --timeout 10m
          )
          for lang in javascript typescript tsx; do
            if [ "$lang" = javascript ]; then
              pattern='^TestComputedSetterLookaheadCParity/javascript$'
            else
              pattern="^(TestTypeScriptIssue1429CParity|TestTypeScriptContextualFollowupsCParity|TestComputedSetterLookaheadCParity|TestTypeScriptAsyncGenericArrowLockedC|TestTypeScriptGenericTaggedTemplateCParity)/${lang}$"
            fi
            bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
              "${contextual_args[@]}" --label "ci-contextual-lookahead-${lang}" \
              --run "$pattern"
          done
          bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
            "${contextual_args[@]}" --label ci-contextual-lookahead-javascript-original \
            --run '^TestJavaScriptIssue1429CParity$|^TestJavaScriptContextualSuffixCParity$'

      - name: Generated CSS immediate tokens against locked C
        run: |
          bash cgo_harness/seed_parity_repos.sh --dest "${RUNNER_TEMP}/css-immediate-reference" --langs css

            --no-build --label ci-css-immediate-parity \
            --mount "${RUNNER_TEMP}/css-immediate-reference:/tmp/grammar_parity:ro" \
            --memory 4g --gomemlimit 3GiB --cpus 1 --wall-timeout 10m \
            -- "cd /workspace/cgo_harness && GTS_PARITY_REPO_ROOT=/tmp/grammar_parity go test . -tags treesitter_c_parity -run '^TestGeneratedCSSImmediateTokenLockedCParity$' -count=1 -timeout=8m"

      - name: Generated HCL splats against locked C
        run: |
          bash cgo_harness/seed_parity_repos.sh --dest "${RUNNER_TEMP}/hcl-splat-reference" --langs hcl
          GOMAXPROCS=1 bash cgo_harness/docker/run_parity_in_docker.sh \
            --no-build --label ci-hcl-splat-parity \
            --mount "${RUNNER_TEMP}/hcl-splat-reference:/tmp/grammar_parity:ro" \
            --memory 4g --gomemlimit 3GiB --cpus 1 --wall-timeout 10m \
            -- "cd /workspace/cgo_harness && GTS_PARITY_REPO_ROOT=/tmp/grammar_parity go test . -tags treesitter_c_parity -run '^TestGeneratedHCLSplatLockedCParity$' -count=1 -timeout=8m"

      - name: Generated Go supertype aliases against locked C
        run: |

  perf-regression:
    needs: exhaustive_parity_scope
    if: needs.exhaustive_parity_scope.outputs.run_code_ci == 'true' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Prepare job-owned Go cache and scratch
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: bash .github/scripts/prepare_runner.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Benchmark Base vs Head (advisory)
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PERF_LEGACY_BASE_SHA: 7a29f591d7fcc54b3d0639b3e38a1bacd8fcb386
          # Contract rebased after the 2026-07-11 audit proved the old
          # BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA silently enabled no-tree mode. This floor
          # is the first commit where that benchmark calls Parser.Parse and
          # measures a fully materialized tree; parser-core attribution moved
          # to BenchmarkGoParseCoreDFA. Never compare the corrected public
          # full-parse lane with the retired parser-core numbers.
          PERF_BENCH_CONTRACT_BASE_SHA: 1717ce84179a850501ec86684f80a77e24d661a8
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="${BASE_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD^)}"

          BENCH_RE='^(BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA|BenchmarkGoParseIncrementalSingleByteEditDFA|BenchmarkGoParseIncrementalNoEditDFA)$'
          BENCH_REQUIRED='BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA,BenchmarkGoParseIncrementalSingleByteEditDFA,BenchmarkGoParseIncrementalNoEditDFA'
          OUT_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/bench-gate"
          BASE_TREE="${RUNNER_TEMP}/bench-base"
          mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"

          GATE_BASE_SHA="${BASE_SHA}"
          if git fetch --no-tags origin "${PERF_BENCH_CONTRACT_BASE_SHA}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "${PERF_BENCH_CONTRACT_BASE_SHA}" "${BASE_SHA}"; then
              GATE_BASE_SHA="${PERF_BENCH_CONTRACT_BASE_SHA}"
            fi
          fi
          if [ "${GATE_BASE_SHA}" = "${BASE_SHA}" ] && git fetch --no-tags origin "${PERF_LEGACY_BASE_SHA}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "${PERF_LEGACY_BASE_SHA}" "${BASE_SHA}"; then
              GATE_BASE_SHA="${PERF_LEGACY_BASE_SHA}"
            fi
          fi
          echo "perf gate base: ${GATE_BASE_SHA} (pr base: ${BASE_SHA})"

          # The legacy base needs a higher node budget for comparable full-parse
          # results. The benchmark-contract floor already uses current settings.
          BENCH_NODE_SCALE=""
          if [ "${GATE_BASE_SHA}" = "${PERF_LEGACY_BASE_SHA}" ]; then
            BENCH_NODE_SCALE="3"
            echo "perf gate: using GOT_PARSE_NODE_LIMIT_SCALE=${BENCH_NODE_SCALE} for benchmark comparability"
          fi

          git fetch --no-tags origin "${BASE_SHA}" "${GATE_BASE_SHA}"
          git worktree add "${BASE_TREE}" "${GATE_BASE_SHA}"
          PR_BASE_TREE=""
          cleanup_bench_worktrees() {
            if [ -n "${PR_BASE_TREE}" ]; then
              git worktree remove --force "${PR_BASE_TREE}" || true
            fi
            git worktree remove --force "${BASE_TREE}"
          }
          trap cleanup_bench_worktrees EXIT

          export GOMAXPROCS=1
          run_paired_comparison() {
            local baseline_root=$1
            local baseline_output=$2
            local head_output=$3
            local args=(
              --baseline-root "${baseline_root}"
              --baseline-output "${baseline_output}"
              --output "${head_output}"
              --lock-path "/tmp/gotreesitter-ci-bench-${UID}.lock"
              --runs 20 --seed-start 1 --benchtime 750ms
              --primary-go-suite --package . --tags ''
              --require-benchmarks "${BENCH_REQUIRED}"
            )
            if [ -n "${BENCH_NODE_SCALE}" ]; then
              GOT_PARSE_NODE_LIMIT_SCALE="${BENCH_NODE_SCALE}" \
                bash scripts/run_randomized_benchmarks.sh "${args[@]}"
            else
              bash scripts/run_randomized_benchmarks.sh "${args[@]}"
            fi
          }
          run_paired_comparison "${BASE_TREE}" "${OUT_DIR}/base.txt" "${OUT_DIR}/head.txt"
          if [ "${GATE_BASE_SHA}" != "${BASE_SHA}" ]; then
            PR_BASE_TREE="${RUNNER_TEMP}/bench-pr-base"
            git worktree add "${PR_BASE_TREE}" "${BASE_SHA}"
            run_paired_comparison "${PR_BASE_TREE}" "${OUT_DIR}/pr_base.txt" "${OUT_DIR}/pr_head.txt"
            git worktree remove --force "${PR_BASE_TREE}"
            PR_BASE_TREE=""
            echo "informational compare vs PR base (non-blocking):"
            if ! go run ./cmd/benchgate \
              -base "${OUT_DIR}/pr_base.txt" \
              -head "${OUT_DIR}/pr_head.txt" \
              -max-ns-regression 10 \
              -max-bytes-regression 10 \
              -max-allocs-regression 10; then
              echo "informational compare vs PR base unavailable (missing benchmarks/metrics)"
            fi
          fi

          BASE_RSS_BIN="${OUT_DIR}/base_rss.test"
          HEAD_RSS_BIN="${OUT_DIR}/head_rss.test"
          (cd "${BASE_TREE}" && go test -c -o "${BASE_RSS_BIN}" .)
          go test -c -o "${HEAD_RSS_BIN}" .

          if [ -n "${BENCH_NODE_SCALE}" ]; then
            (
              cd "${BASE_TREE}" && \
              GOT_BENCH_FUNC_COUNT=5000 GOT_PARSE_NODE_LIMIT_SCALE="${BENCH_NODE_SCALE}" /usr/bin/time -v \
              "${BASE_RSS_BIN}" -test.run '^$' -test.bench '^BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA$' -test.benchmem -test.count=1 -test.benchtime=3x \
              > "${OUT_DIR}/base_rss_bench.txt" 2> "${OUT_DIR}/base_rss_time.txt"
            )
            GOT_BENCH_FUNC_COUNT=5000 GOT_PARSE_NODE_LIMIT_SCALE="${BENCH_NODE_SCALE}" /usr/bin/time -v \
              "${HEAD_RSS_BIN}" -test.run '^$' -test.bench '^BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA$' -test.benchmem -test.count=1 -test.benchtime=3x \
              > "${OUT_DIR}/head_rss_bench.txt" 2> "${OUT_DIR}/head_rss_time.txt"
          else
            (
              cd "${BASE_TREE}" && \
              GOT_BENCH_FUNC_COUNT=5000 /usr/bin/time -v \
              "${BASE_RSS_BIN}" -test.run '^$' -test.bench '^BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA$' -test.benchmem -test.count=1 -test.benchtime=3x \
              > "${OUT_DIR}/base_rss_bench.txt" 2> "${OUT_DIR}/base_rss_time.txt"
            )
            GOT_BENCH_FUNC_COUNT=5000 /usr/bin/time -v \
              "${HEAD_RSS_BIN}" -test.run '^$' -test.bench '^BenchmarkGoParseFullDFA$' -test.benchmem -test.count=1 -test.benchtime=3x \
              > "${OUT_DIR}/head_rss_bench.txt" 2> "${OUT_DIR}/head_rss_time.txt"
          fi

          # benchgate applies a minimum +1 alloc/op floor for low-allocation
          # benches, so we can keep strict ratio thresholds.
          gate_status=0
          go run ./cmd/benchgate \
            -base "${OUT_DIR}/base.txt" \
            -head "${OUT_DIR}/head.txt" \
            -base-rss "${OUT_DIR}/base_rss_time.txt" \
            -head-rss "${OUT_DIR}/head_rss_time.txt" \
            -max-ns-regression 0.08 \
            -max-bytes-regression 0.05 \
            -max-allocs-regression 0.05 \
            -max-rss-regression 0.10 || gate_status=$?

          if [ "${gate_status}" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::warning::performance thresholds exceeded; keep the result visible as directional evidence"
            {
              echo "### Advisory Performance Result"
              echo ""
              echo "- outcome: \`REGRESSION_RECORDED\`"
              echo "- release effect: non-blocking"
              echo "- required action: document the tradeoff and continue optimization work"
            } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
          fi

          # Keep edit attribution separate from the unchanged timing inputs.
          # Capture the runner CPU because hosted depot-ubuntu-24.04 spans hardware.
          bash scripts/run_go_edit_attribution.sh "${BASE_TREE}" \
            "${OUT_DIR}/edit-attribution" "${BASE_RSS_BIN}" "${HEAD_RSS_BIN}"

      - name: Perf Definitive Outcome Summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUT_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/bench-gate"
          if [ "$(tail -n 1 "${OUT_DIR}/base.txt" 2>/dev/null)" != '# status: complete' ] || \
             [ "$(tail -n 1 "${OUT_DIR}/head.txt" 2>/dev/null)" != '# status: complete' ]; then
            {
              echo "### Perf Definitive Outcome"
              echo ""
              echo "- outcome: \`INCONCLUSIVE\`"
              echo "- reason: randomized benchmark campaign is missing or incomplete"
            } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
            exit 0
          fi

          go run ./cmd/benchgate \
            -base "${OUT_DIR}/base.txt" \
            -head "${OUT_DIR}/head.txt" \
            -max-ns-regression 0.08 \
            -max-bytes-regression 0.05 \
            -max-allocs-regression 0.05 \
            -exit-on-fail=false \
            -post-definitive \
            -definitive-output "${OUT_DIR}/definitive.md" || true

          if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/definitive.md" ]; then
            cat "${OUT_DIR}/definitive.md" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
          else
            {
              echo "### Perf Definitive Outcome"
              echo ""
              echo "- outcome: \`INCONCLUSIVE\`"
              echo "- reason: no definitive win/loss from current thresholds"
            } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
          fi

name: release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Exact vX.Y.Z release version
        required: true
        type: string
      candidate_sha:
        description: Exact lowercase 40-character main commit hash
        required: true
        type: string
      release_kind:
        description: Governed release route
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - planned-minor
          - urgent-patch
      receipt_uri:
        description: "Signed Hyphae receipt ID: hypha-receipt:YYYY-MM-DD:<short-id>"
        required: true
        type: string
      incident:
        description: Urgent patch incident
        required: false
        type: string
      why_waiting_is_worse:
        description: Reason that an urgent patch cannot wait
        required: false
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  ARBITER_VERSION: "1.9.0"
  ARBITER_LINUX_AMD64_SHA256: c6c5c6c069d33cc39b689201f30d4561472d6ed59731e3ba395b44079e53af38

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
      RELEASE_KIND: ${{ inputs.release_kind }}
      RECEIPT_URI: ${{ inputs.receipt_uri }}
      INCIDENT: ${{ inputs.incident }}
      WHY_WAITING_IS_WORSE: ${{ inputs.why_waiting_is_worse }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - name: Require a main workflow revision
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$CANDIDATE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/main"
          test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$CANDIDATE_SHA"

      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Install the pinned Arbiter CLI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/arbiter.tar.gz"
          bin_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/arbiter-bin"
          url="https://github.com/odvcencio/arbiter/releases/download/v$ARBITER_VERSION/arbiter_${ARBITER_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "$url" --output "$archive"
          echo "$ARBITER_LINUX_AMD64_SHA256  $archive" | sha256sum --check -
          mkdir -p "$bin_dir"
          tar --extract --gzip --file "$archive" --directory "$bin_dir" arbiter
          chmod 0755 "$bin_dir/arbiter"
          echo "$bin_dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Test the release policy
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          arbiter check policy/release.arb
          arbiter fmt --check policy/release.arb policy/release.test.arb
          arbiter test policy/release.test.arb

      - id: facts
        name: Collect main and hosted check facts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch --force --tags origin refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
          main_sha="$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)"
          main_exact_candidate=false
          if test "$main_sha" = "$CANDIDATE_SHA"; then
            main_exact_candidate=true
          fi

          latest_tag="$(git tag --list --sort=-version:refname |
            awk '$0 ~ /^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/ && first == "" { first=$0 } END { print first }')"
          test -n "$latest_tag"

          response="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-runs.json"
          url="https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?head_sha=$CANDIDATE_SHA&status=completed&event=workflow_dispatch&per_page=100"
          if ! status="$(curl --silent --show-error --location \
            --output "$response" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
            "$url")"; then
            echo "The hosted check query failed." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if test "$status" != "200"; then
            jq -r '.message // "The hosted check query returned an error."' "$response" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          jq --arg sha "$CANDIDATE_SHA" \
            '[.workflow_runs[] | select(
              .head_sha == $sha
              and .status == "completed"
              and .event == "workflow_dispatch"
            )] | sort_by([.run_number, .run_attempt]) | last' \
            "$response" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json"

          ci_run_id=""
          ci_run_url=""
          ci_event=""
          ci_sha=""
          ci_conclusion=""
          ci_completed_at=""

            ci_run_id="$(jq -r '.id | tostring' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_run_url="$(jq -r '.html_url // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_event="$(jq -r '.event // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_sha="$(jq -r '.head_sha // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_conclusion="$(jq -r '.conclusion // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
            ci_completed_at="$(jq -r '.updated_at // ""' "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.json")"
          fi

          {
            echo "main_exact_candidate=$main_exact_candidate"
            echo "latest_tag=$latest_tag"
            echo "ci_run_id=$ci_run_id"
            echo "ci_run_url=$ci_run_url"
            echo "ci_event=$ci_event"
            echo "ci_sha=$ci_sha"
            echo "ci_conclusion=$ci_conclusion"
            echo "ci_completed_at=$ci_completed_at"

      - id: presence
        name: Collect tag and release facts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          query_absence() {
            local label="$1"
            local url="$2"
            local body="$RUNNER_TEMP/${label}.json"
            local status
            if ! status="$(curl --silent --show-error --location \
              --output "$body" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
              "$url")"; then
              echo "The $label query failed." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            if test "$status" = "404"; then
              echo "true"
              return
            fi
            if test "$status" = "200"; then
              echo "false"
              return
            fi
            jq -r '.message // "The GitHub query returned an error."' "$body" >&2
            exit 1
          }

          api="https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          tag_absent="$(query_absence "tag" "$api/git/ref/tags/$VERSION")"
          release_absent="$(query_absence "release" "$api/releases/tags/$VERSION")"
          {
            echo "tag_absent=$tag_absent"
            echo "release_absent=$release_absent"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Test the release validator
        run: go test ./cmd/releasegate -count=1

      - name: Validate release evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |

          go run ./cmd/releasegate \
            -version "$VERSION" \
            -candidate-sha "$CANDIDATE_SHA" \
            -release-kind "$RELEASE_KIND" \
            -receipt-uri "$RECEIPT_URI" \
            -incident "$INCIDENT" \
            -why-waiting-is-worse "$WHY_WAITING_IS_WORSE" \
            -latest-tag "${{ steps.facts.outputs.latest_tag }}" \
            -ci-run-id "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_run_id }}" \
            -ci-run-url "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_run_url }}" \
            -ci-event "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_event }}" \
            -ci-sha "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_sha }}" \
            -ci-conclusion "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_conclusion }}" \
            -ci-completed-at "${{ steps.facts.outputs.ci_completed_at }}" \
            -main-exact-candidate="${{ steps.facts.outputs.main_exact_candidate }}" \
            -tag-absent="${{ steps.presence.outputs.tag_absent }}" \
            -release-absent="${{ steps.presence.outputs.release_absent }}" \
            -output-directory "$output"

      - name: Decide release publication
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$RUNNER_TEMP/releasegate-verify"
          arbiter strategy policy/release.arb \
            --name ReleasePublication \
            --data "$(jq --compact-output . "$output/policy-facts.json")" \
            > "$output/policy-decision.json"
          jq -r '"- Arbiter decision: `\(.selected)`\n- Arbiter reason: \(.params.reason)"' \
            "$output/policy-decision.json" >> "$output/summary.md"
          jq -e '.selected == "Allow" and .params.action == "allow"' \
            "$output/policy-decision.json" >/dev/null

      - name: Preserve verification evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: release-gate-${{ inputs.version }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/releasegate-verify
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    needs: verify
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    environment: release
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
      RELEASE_KIND: ${{ inputs.release_kind }}
      RECEIPT_URI: ${{ inputs.receipt_uri }}

name: Build and Release

  contents: write

  group: release-${{ github.ref }}

jobs:
  build-linux-amd64:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.25.6'

        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libgtk-3-dev libgdk-pixbuf2.0-dev squashfs-tools binutils-multiarch imagemagick
