        run: |
          ./build_appimage.sh amd64
          mkdir -p payload/assets/icons
          cp -L dist/nozik-amd64.AppImage payload/
          cp -R build/icons/hicolor payload/assets/icons/
          tar -czf nozik-payload-linux-amd64.tar.gz -C payload .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-payload-linux-amd64
          path: nozik-payload-linux-amd64.tar.gz

  build-linux-cross:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: arm64
            cc-target: aarch64-linux-gnu
          - arch: riscv64
            cc-target: riscv64-linux-gnu
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.25.6'
      - name: Install cross dependencies
        run: |
          sudo dpkg --add-architecture ${{ matrix.arch }}
          CODENAME=$(lsb_release -c -s)
          sudo mv /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.bak || true
          if [ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources ]; then
            sudo mv /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources.bak || true
          fi
          cat <<EOF | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list
          deb [arch=amd64] http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ ${CODENAME} main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=amd64] http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ ${CODENAME}-updates main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=amd64] http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ ${CODENAME}-backports main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=amd64] http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ ${CODENAME}-security main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=${{ matrix.arch }}] http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/ ${CODENAME} main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=${{ matrix.arch }}] http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/ ${CODENAME}-updates main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=${{ matrix.arch }}] http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/ ${CODENAME}-backports main restricted universe multiverse
          deb [arch=${{ matrix.arch }}] http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/ ${CODENAME}-security main restricted universe multiverse
          EOF
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gcc-${{ matrix.cc-target }} libgtk-3-dev:${{ matrix.arch }} libgdk-pixbuf2.0-dev:${{ matrix.arch }} squashfs-tools binutils-multiarch imagemagick
      - name: Build Linux ${{ matrix.arch }} payload
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR: /usr/lib/${{ matrix.cc-target }}/pkgconfig:/usr/share/pkgconfig
        run: |
          ./build_appimage.sh ${{ matrix.arch }}
          mkdir -p payload/assets/icons
          cp -L dist/nozik-${{ matrix.arch }}.AppImage payload/
          cp -R build/icons/hicolor payload/assets/icons/
          tar -czf nozik-payload-linux-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz -C payload .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-payload-linux-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: nozik-payload-linux-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz

  build-windows:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runs-on }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: amd64
            runs-on: depot-windows-2025
            msystem: MINGW64
            mingw-prefix: mingw64
            cc: gcc
            packages: >-
              mingw-w64-x86_64-toolchain
              mingw-w64-x86_64-gtk3
              mingw-w64-x86_64-pkg-config
              mingw-w64-x86_64-ntldd
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.25.6'
      - uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        with:
          msystem: ${{ matrix.msystem }}
          update: true
          cache: true
          path-type: inherit
          install: ${{ matrix.packages }}
      - name: Build nozik
        shell: msys2 {0}
        run: |
          export PATH="/${{ matrix.mingw-prefix }}/bin:$PATH"
          export CC="${{ matrix.cc }}"
          export CGO_ENABLED=1
          export CGO_CFLAGS="-Wno-dll-attribute-on-redeclaration"
          go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o nozik.exe ./cmd/nozik
      - name: Bundle GTK runtime
        shell: msys2 {0}
        run: |
          export PATH="/${{ matrix.mingw-prefix }}/bin:$PATH"
          OUTPUT="nozik-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}"
          mkdir -p "$OUTPUT"
          cp nozik.exe "$OUTPUT/"
          cp -R assets "$OUTPUT/"
          ./installer/scripts/collect-windows-dlls.sh "${{ matrix.mingw-prefix }}" "$OUTPUT"
          ./installer/scripts/build-windows-standalone.sh "$OUTPUT" "nozik-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.exe"
          mkdir -p payload
          cp "nozik-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.exe" payload/nozik.exe
          tar -czf "nozik-payload-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz" -C payload .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-payload-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: nozik-payload-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-standalone-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: nozik-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.exe

  build-macos:
    runs-on: depot-macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.25.6'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: brew install gtk+3 pkg-config dylibbundler
      - name: Build nozik
        run: |
          export CGO_ENABLED=1
          export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig:$PKG_CONFIG_PATH"
          go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o nozik ./cmd/nozik
      - name: Assemble app bundle
        run: |
          APP="Nozik.app"
          mkdir -p "$APP/Contents/MacOS" "$APP/Contents/Resources" "$APP/Contents/Frameworks"
          cp nozik "$APP/Contents/MacOS/"
          cp -R assets "$APP/Contents/MacOS/"
          cat > "$APP/Contents/MacOS/nozik-launcher.sh" <<'EOF'
          #!/bin/bash
          DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
          export NOZIK_ASSETS_DIR="$DIR/assets"
          export DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH="$DIR/../Frameworks:${DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
          PIXBUF_ROOT="$DIR/../Resources/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0"
          if [ -d "$PIXBUF_ROOT" ]; then
            PIXBUF_VERSION="$(find "$PIXBUF_ROOT" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '2.*' | head -n1)"
            if [ -n "$PIXBUF_VERSION" ]; then
              export GDK_PIXBUF_MODULEDIR="$PIXBUF_VERSION/loaders"
              CACHE="$PIXBUF_VERSION/loaders.cache"
              if [ -f "$CACHE" ]; then
                ABS_CACHE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/nozik-loaders.XXXXXX")"
                sed "s|\"loaders/|\"$GDK_PIXBUF_MODULEDIR/|g" "$CACHE" > "$ABS_CACHE"
                export GDK_PIXBUF_MODULE_FILE="$ABS_CACHE"
              fi
            fi
          fi
          exec "$DIR/nozik" "$@"
          EOF
          chmod +x "$APP/Contents/MacOS/nozik-launcher.sh"
          cat > "$APP/Contents/Info.plist" <<EOF
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
          <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
          <plist version="1.0">
          <dict>
            <key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>nozik-launcher.sh</string>
            <key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>com.gosuda.nozik.agent</string>
            <key>CFBundleName</key><string>Nozik</string>
            <key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>APPL</string>
            <key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key><string>${{ github.ref_name }}</string>
            <key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>${{ github.run_number }}</string>
            <key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key><string>11.0</string>
            <key>NSHighResolutionCapable</key><true/>
          </dict>
          </plist>
          EOF
          dylibbundler -od -b -x "$APP/Contents/MacOS/nozik" -d "$APP/Contents/Frameworks/"
          for prefix in /opt/homebrew /usr/local; do
            if [ -d "$prefix/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0" ]; then
              VERSION_DIR="$(find "$prefix/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '2.*' | head -n1)"
              if [ -n "$VERSION_DIR" ] && [ -d "${VERSION_DIR}/loaders" ]; then
                RES_DIR="$APP/Contents/Resources/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0/$(basename "$VERSION_DIR")"
                mkdir -p "${RES_DIR}/loaders"
                cp -L "${VERSION_DIR}/loaders/"*.so "${RES_DIR}/loaders/"
                for loader in "${RES_DIR}/loaders/"*.so; do
                  dylibbundler -od -b -x "$loader" -d "$APP/Contents/Frameworks/"
                done
                gdk-pixbuf-query-loaders "${RES_DIR}/loaders/"*.so > "${RES_DIR}/loaders.cache"
                sed -i "" "s|\"${RES_DIR}/|\"|g; s|\"${VERSION_DIR}/loaders/|\"|g" "${RES_DIR}/loaders.cache"
                break
              fi
            fi
          done
          mkdir -p payload
          cp -R Nozik.app payload/
          tar -czf nozik-payload-macos-arm64.tar.gz -C payload .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-payload-macos-arm64
          path: nozik-payload-macos-arm64.tar.gz

  build-installers:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: false
          go-version: '1.25.6'
      - name: Build installers and uninstallers
        run: |
          cd installer
          ./scripts/build.sh dist '${{ github.ref_name }}'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nozik-installers
          path: installer/dist/nozik-*

  release:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    needs: [build-linux-amd64, build-linux-cross, build-windows, build-macos, build-installers]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
          pattern: nozik-*
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          files: artifacts/*
          generate_release_notes: true
          overwrite_files: true

sources.content:
name: Release and Publish

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: 'Build, attest SLSA Level 3 provenance, and run E2E checks without publishing'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""

jobs:
  build:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/slsa-wasm-builder.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write

  verify:
    name: Verify SLSA L3 provenance, ESM SDK, and Chromium E2E
    needs: build
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: read
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GOFLAGS: '-p=2'
      GOMAXPROCS: '2'
      PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD: 'true'
      PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR: /tmp/zeroproxy-puppeteer
      ZP_E2E_PREBUILT: '1'
      ZP_E2E_DIST: dist
      ZP_E2E_ARTIFACTS: artifacts/e2e
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: '26'
          cache: npm

      - uses: actions/setup-go@d8cbb8045d7f43706b9177cceb36c1f91a6644d5 # v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: false

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: release-bundle
          path: artifacts/release

      - name: Verify SLSA Build Level 3 provenance and SHA-256 digests
        env:
          NPM_TARBALL: ${{ needs.build.outputs.npm_tarball }}
          WASM_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.wasm_archive }}
          WEB_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.web_archive }}
          SIGNER_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.repository }}/.github/workflows/slsa-wasm-builder.yml
        run: |
          (cd artifacts/release && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt)
          for artifact in \
            "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" \
            "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" \
            "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" \
            "artifacts/release/wasm-manifest.json"; do
            gh attestation verify "$artifact" \
              --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
              --signer-workflow "$SIGNER_WORKFLOW"
          done

      - name: Unpack prebuilt WASM, ESM, and web assets and build Go server
        env:
          WASM_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.wasm_archive }}
          WEB_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.web_archive }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          tar -xzf "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" -C dist
          tar -xzf "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" -C dist
          npm ci --ignore-scripts
          node scripts/verify-pack.mjs
          node scripts/build.mjs --server-only --no-clean

      - name: Verify every attested WASM binary directly
        env:
          SIGNER_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.repository }}/.github/workflows/slsa-wasm-builder.yml
        run: |
          for wasm in dist/esm/wasm/*.wasm dist/web/Asset/*.wasm; do
            gh attestation verify "$wasm" \
              --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
              --signer-workflow "$SIGNER_WORKFLOW"
          done

      - name: Run JS policy, WASM, and ESM contract suites
        run: |
          npm run test:js
          npm run test:wasm:ci

      - name: Install Chrome and run Chromium E2E suite against prebuilt artifacts
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo env "PATH=$PATH" "PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=$PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR" npx --no-install puppeteer browsers install chrome --install-deps
          npm run test:e2e:ci

  publish-npm:
    name: Publish to npm via OIDC Trusted Publishing
    needs: [build, verify]
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && (github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.dry_run == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment:
      name: npm-publish
      url: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gosuda/zeroproxy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: read
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # Omit registry-url so setup-node does not write an empty _authToken placeholder that blocks npm OIDC exchange.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: '26'
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Verify npm CLI supports OIDC Trusted Publishing (>= 11.5.1)
        run: |
          npm --version
          node -e 'const [maj, min, pat] = process.argv[1].split(".").map(Number); if (maj < 11 || (maj === 11 && (min < 5 || (min === 5 && pat < 1)))) process.exit(1);' "$(npm --version)"

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: release-bundle
          path: artifacts/release

      - name: Re-verify SLSA Level 3 attestation before OIDC publish
        env:
          NPM_TARBALL: ${{ needs.build.outputs.npm_tarball }}
          SIGNER_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.repository }}/.github/workflows/slsa-wasm-builder.yml
        run: |
          gh attestation verify "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" \
            --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --signer-workflow "$SIGNER_WORKFLOW"
          npm publish "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" --access public --provenance

  publish-github-release:
    name: Publish prebuilt WASM and web bundles to GitHub Release
    needs: [build, verify]
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && (github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.dry_run == false)
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: read
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: release-bundle
          path: artifacts/release

      - name: Re-verify SLSA Level 3 attestations and upload GitHub Release assets
        env:
          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          NPM_TARBALL: ${{ needs.build.outputs.npm_tarball }}
          WASM_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.wasm_archive }}
          WEB_ARCHIVE: ${{ needs.build.outputs.web_archive }}
          SIGNER_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.repository }}/.github/workflows/slsa-wasm-builder.yml
        run: |
          for artifact in \
            "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" \
            "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" \
            "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" \
            "artifacts/release/wasm-manifest.json"; do
            gh attestation verify "$artifact" \
              --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
              --signer-workflow "$SIGNER_WORKFLOW"
          done

          if gh release view "$TAG" --repo "${{ github.repository }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" \
              "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" \
              "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" \
              "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" \
              "artifacts/release/wasm-manifest.json" \
              "artifacts/release/SHA256SUMS.txt" \
              --clobber \
              --repo "${{ github.repository }}"
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" \
              "artifacts/release/${WASM_ARCHIVE}" \
              "artifacts/release/${WEB_ARCHIVE}" \
              "artifacts/release/${NPM_TARBALL}" \
              "artifacts/release/wasm-manifest.json" \
              "artifacts/release/SHA256SUMS.txt" \
              --generate-notes \
              --verify-tag \
              --repo "${{ github.repository }}"
          fi

sources.content:
name: Build and Test

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: 'Commit or branch to build and test (default: calling ref)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""
  GO_VERSION: '1.27.4'
  ZIG_VERSION: '0.17.1'
  ZIG_SHA256: '3581863e3cbcfd0fce0efc682ce7e9e93da96668a977791d356a26d2a7e9b17a'

jobs:
  build:
    name: build (${{ matrix.goos }}/${{ matrix.goarch }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - goos: linux
            goarch: amd64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            zig_target: x86_64-linux-musl
          - goos: linux
            goarch: arm64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            zig_target: aarch64-linux-musl
          - goos: darwin
            goarch: arm64
            runner: depot-macos-latest
            zig_target: ''
          - goos: darwin
            goarch: amd64
            runner: depot-macos-latest
            zig_target: ''
          - goos: windows
            goarch: amd64
            runner: depot-windows-2025
            zig_target: ''
          - goos: windows
            goarch: arm64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            zig_target: aarch64-windows-gnu
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}

      - name: Checkout HQQ core
        shell: bash
        run: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/gosuda/HQQ.git ../HQQ

      - name: Ensure build tools (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          if ! command -v ninja >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v xz >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ninja-build xz-utils
          fi

      - name: Select newest Xcode (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          xcode=$(ls -d /Applications/Xcode_*.app | sort -V | tail -1)
          sudo xcode-select -s "$xcode"
          xcodebuild -version
          clang --version

      - name: Set up MSVC developer environment (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -property installationPath
          $vcvars = Join-Path $vsPath "VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat"
          cmd.exe /c "call `"$vcvars`" x64 >nul && set" | ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') {
              if ($matches[1] -ieq 'PATH') {
                $entries = @($matches[2] -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
                [array]::Reverse($entries)
                $entries | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append -Encoding utf8
              } else {
                "$($matches[1])=$($matches[2])" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
              }
            }
          }

      - name: Build zstd_server (${{ matrix.goos }}/${{ matrix.goarch }})
        shell: bash
        env:
          ZIG_TARGET: ${{ matrix.zig_target }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tmp_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP"
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Windows" ]; then
            tmp_dir=$(cygpath -u "$RUNNER_TEMP")
          fi
          zdir=$(scripts/release/fetch-zstd.sh -d "$HOME/.cache/hqq-zstd/zstd-src")
          bdir="$tmp_dir/hqq-zstd-build"

          if [ -n "$ZIG_TARGET" ]; then
            mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/hqq-zstd"
            zig_tar="$HOME/.cache/hqq-zstd/zig.tar.xz"
            if ! echo "${ZIG_SHA256}  ${zig_tar}" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
                -o "$zig_tar" "https://ziglang.org/download/${ZIG_VERSION}/zig-x86_64-linux-${ZIG_VERSION}.tar.xz"
              echo "${ZIG_SHA256}  ${zig_tar}" | sha256sum -c -
            fi
            mkdir -p "$tmp_dir/zig"
            tar -xJ -f "$zig_tar" -C "$tmp_dir/zig" --strip-components=1
            "$tmp_dir/zig/zig" version
            "$tmp_dir/zig/zig" cc --version

            printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "%s/zig/zig" cc -target %s "$@"\n' "$tmp_dir" "$ZIG_TARGET" > "$tmp_dir/zig-cc"
            printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "%s/zig/zig" ar "$@"\n' "$tmp_dir" > "$tmp_dir/zig-ar"
            printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "%s/zig/zig" ranlib "$@"\n' "$tmp_dir" > "$tmp_dir/zig-ranlib"
            chmod +x "$tmp_dir/zig-cc" "$tmp_dir/zig-ar" "$tmp_dir/zig-ranlib"

            sys_name="Linux"
            sys_proc="x86_64"
            if [ "${{ matrix.goos }}" = "windows" ]; then
              sys_name="Windows"
              sys_proc="ARM64"
            elif [ "${{ matrix.goarch }}" = "arm64" ]; then
              sys_proc="aarch64"
            fi

            cmake -S server -B "$bdir" -G Ninja \
              -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME="$sys_name" \
              -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR="$sys_proc" \
              -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
              -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="$tmp_dir/zig-cc" \
              -DCMAKE_AR="$tmp_dir/zig-ar" \
              -DCMAKE_RANLIB="$tmp_dir/zig-ranlib" \
              -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-s" \
              -DHQQ_ZSTD_DIR="$zdir"
          elif [ "${{ matrix.goos }}" = "windows" ]; then
            clang-cl --version
            zdir=$(cygpath -m "$zdir")
            bdir=$(cygpath -m "$bdir")
            cmake -S server -B "$bdir" -G Ninja \
              -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
              -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-cl \
              -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang-cl \
              -DCMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=MultiThreaded \
              -DHQQ_ZSTD_DIR="$zdir"
          else
            osx_arch="arm64"
            if [ "${{ matrix.goarch }}" = "amd64" ]; then osx_arch="x86_64"; fi
            cmake -S server -B "$bdir" -G "Unix Makefiles" \
              -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
              -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES="$osx_arch" \
              -DHQQ_ZSTD_DIR="$zdir"
          fi

          cmake --build "$bdir" --target zstd_server
          mkdir -p dist
          ext=""
          if [ "${{ matrix.goos }}" = "windows" ]; then ext=".exe"; fi
          out="dist/zstd_server_${{ matrix.goos }}_${{ matrix.goarch }}${ext}"
          cp "$bdir/zstd_server${ext}" "$out"
          if [ "${{ matrix.goos }}" = "darwin" ]; then
            strip -x "$out"
            codesign --force --sign - "$out"
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: bin-${{ matrix.goos }}-${{ matrix.goarch }}
          path: dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  test:
    name: test (${{ matrix.name }})
    needs: [build]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: linux/amd64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04
            cc: clang-18
          - name: linux/arm64
            runner: depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm
            cc: clang-18
          - name: darwin/arm64
            runner: depot-macos-latest
            cc: clang
          - name: windows/amd64
            runner: depot-windows-2025
            cc: ''
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          fetch-tags: true

      - name: Checkout HQQ core
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/gosuda/HQQ.git ../HQQ

      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
          cache: false

      - name: Install the Linux test compiler
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends clang-18 cmake ninja-build

      - name: Ensure Ninja is installed (POSIX)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          if ! command -v ninja >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Linux" ]; then
              sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ninja-build
            else
              brew install ninja
            fi
          fi

      - name: Download built server binaries
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: bin-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Pin built binaries locally for testing
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" != "Windows" ]; then
            chmod +x dist/zstd_server_linux_* dist/zstd_server_darwin_*
          fi
          py=python3
          if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! python3 --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            py=python
          fi
          tag=$("$py" scripts/release/zstd-release.py next-tag)
          "$py" scripts/release/zstd-release.py update-hashes --dist dist --tag "$tag"

      - name: Run release script unit tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          py=python3
          if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! python3 --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            py=python
          fi
          "$py" -m unittest scripts/release/test_zstd_release.py -v

      - name: Run Go tests against embedded binary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          go vet ./...
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Windows" ]; then
            go test -short -v -timeout 10m ./...
          else
            go test -short -v -race -timeout 10m ./...
          fi

      - name: Run cgo cross-check tests (POSIX)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        env:
          CC: ${{ matrix.cc }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$(TMPDIR="$HOME/.cache/hqq-zstd/tmp" ./build.sh -b "$RUNNER_TEMP/hqq-zstd-build")"
          go test -short -v -race -timeout 10m -tags zstdcgo ./...

name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Release tag to publish (default: auto-computed next tag)'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""

jobs:
  build_and_test:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build-and-test.yml

  publish:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    needs: [build_and_test]
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.4'
          cache: false

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: bin-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Attest SLSA Build Provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: 'dist/zstd_server_*'

      - name: Compute SHA256SUMS and pin embedded binaries
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin --tags
          if [ -n "$INPUT_TAG" ]; then
            tag="$INPUT_TAG"
          elif [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = "tag" ]; then
            tag="$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          else
            tag=$(python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py next-tag)
          fi
          echo "TAG=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          chmod +x dist/zstd_server_linux_* dist/zstd_server_darwin_*
          python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py update-hashes --dist dist --tag "$tag" --update-docs
          cat dist/SHA256SUMS
          cat hashes.go

          git add hashes.go internal/embedded/bin/ README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
          if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" != "tag" ] && ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git commit -m "chore(release): pin embedded binaries and digests for ${tag}"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi

      - name: Create or update GitHub Release
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          target=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" != "tag" ]; then
            git tag -f "$TAG" "$target"
            git push origin -f "refs/tags/$TAG"
          fi
          if gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" dist/* \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --target "$target" \
              --title "$TAG" \
              --generate-notes
          fi

sources.content:
name: Track Zstandard Releases

# Automatically checks upstream facebook/zstd releases on a schedule, pins new
# releases onto a staging branch, builds and tests all six platforms, and
# promotes passing builds to main with SLSA provenance, tag, and GitHub Release.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Upstream Zstandard version to pin (default: latest release)'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      force_release:
        description: 'Run build, test, and release even if Zstandard version is unchanged'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: track-zstd
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      branch: ${{ steps.pin.outputs.branch }}
      zstd_version: ${{ steps.pin.outputs.zstd_version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - name: Check upstream Zstandard release and stage branch
        id: pin
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          FORCE_RELEASE: ${{ inputs.force_release }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          current=$(sed -n 's/^version=//p' third_party/zstd/VERSION)
          if [ -n "$INPUT_VERSION" ]; then
            target="${INPUT_VERSION#v}"
          else
            target=$(python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py latest)
          fi
          echo "Current pinned Zstandard: ${current}"
          echo "Target upstream Zstandard: ${target}"

          branch="auto-release/zstd-${target}-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          if [ "$target" != "$current" ]; then
            python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py pin --version "$target"
            if git diff --quiet -- third_party/zstd; then
              echo "No changes in third_party/zstd for ${target}"
              exit 0
            fi
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git switch -c "$branch"
            git add third_party/zstd
            git commit -m "third_party/zstd: update to Zstandard ${target}"
            git push origin "$branch"
            echo "branch=${branch}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "zstd_version=${target}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ "$FORCE_RELEASE" = "true" ]; then
            git switch -c "$branch"
            git push origin "$branch"
            echo "branch=${branch}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "zstd_version=${target}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "Zstandard ${target} is already pinned; nothing to release."
          fi

  build_and_test:
    needs: [check]
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: needs.check.outputs.branch != ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build-and-test.yml
    with:
      ref: ${{ needs.check.outputs.branch }}

  promote:
    needs: [check, build_and_test]
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.check.outputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.4'
          cache: false

      - name: Download tested server binaries
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: bin-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Attest SLSA Build Provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: 'dist/zstd_server_*'

      - name: Promote to main, tag, and publish GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ZSTD_VERSION: ${{ needs.check.outputs.zstd_version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main --tags
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD; then
            echo "main moved while build_and_test was running; aborting promote" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          chmod +x dist/zstd_server_linux_* dist/zstd_server_darwin_*
          tag=$(python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py next-tag --zstd-version "$ZSTD_VERSION")
          python3 scripts/release/zstd-release.py update-hashes \
            --dist dist \
            --tag "$tag" \
            --zstd-version "$ZSTD_VERSION" \
            --update-docs
          cat dist/SHA256SUMS
          cat hashes.go

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git reset --soft origin/main
          git add third_party/zstd hashes.go internal/embedded/bin README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore(release): release ${tag} (Zstandard ${ZSTD_VERSION})"
            git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/main"
          fi

          target=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          git tag -f "$tag" "$target"
          git push origin -f "refs/tags/${tag}"
          if gh release view "$tag" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$tag" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$tag" dist/* \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --target "$target" \
              --title "$tag" \
              --generate-notes
          fi

  cleanup:
    needs: [check, build_and_test, promote]
    permissions:
      contents: write
    if: always() && needs.check.outputs.branch != ''
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
      - name: Delete temporary staging branch
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ needs.check.outputs.branch }}
        run: |
          if git ls-remote --exit-code origin "refs/heads/${BRANCH}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            git push origin --delete "$BRANCH"
          fi

name: Track Chromium

# Follows the Chromium Stable channel. When a new stable release appears:
#   1. pin: rewrites third_party/chromium with `engine.py pin` and pushes the commit to
#      chromium/<version>;
#   2. engine: builds and tests all six engines from that branch (engine.yml);
#   3. promote: attests the six engines that step 2 built and tested, computes the next Go
#      semver tag (`engine.py release-tag`), pins them in internal/embedded (binaries, hashes.go)
#      with their license texts, pushes the pins and binaries to main as one commit, tags the
#      commit, and publishes the GitHub release. The bot owns exactly those files in gosuda/0
#      (per-file OWNERS), so the lander lands the push into the monorepo tree.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Chromium version to pin (default: latest stable)'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
  attestations: write

concurrency:
  group: track-chromium
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  GOCACHEPROG: ""

jobs:
  pin:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    outputs:
      branch: ${{ steps.pin.outputs.branch }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
      - name: Pin the Chromium release
        id: pin
        env:
          INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(python3 scripts/engine/engine.py pin --version "${INPUT_VERSION:-latest-stable}")
          branch="chromium/$version"
          if git diff --quiet -- third_party/chromium; then
            echo "Chromium $version is already pinned"
            exit 0
          fi
          if git ls-remote --exit-code origin "refs/heads/$branch" >/dev/null; then
            echo "$branch already exists"
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git switch -c "$branch"
          git add third_party/chromium
          git commit -m "third_party/chromium: update to Chromium $version"
          git push origin "$branch"
          echo "branch=$branch" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  engine:
    needs: [pin]
    if: needs.pin.outputs.branch != ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/engine.yml
    with:
      ref: ${{ needs.pin.outputs.branch }}

  promote:
    needs: [pin, engine]
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.pin.outputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true
      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.3'
          cache: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: engine-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Attest build provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: 'dist/chrome_net_server_*'
      - name: Push pins, tag, and publish GitHub release
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ needs.pin.outputs.branch }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main --tags
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD; then
            echo "main moved since the pin was made; rerun this workflow" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          chromium=$(sed -n 's/^version=//p' third_party/chromium/VERSION)
          tag=$(python3 scripts/engine/engine.py release-tag --chromium "$chromium")
          (cd dist && sha256sum chrome_net_server_* | sort -k2 > SHA256SUMS)
          cat dist/SHA256SUMS
          scripts/engine/pin-embedded.sh dist "$tag" "$chromium"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git reset --soft origin/main
          git add third_party/chromium internal/embedded
          git commit -m "net/chromenet: update to Chromium $chromium ($tag)" \
            -m "Pins the Chromium $chromium source archive and toolchains, and embeds the six chrome_net_server binaries built and tested from them."
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/main"
          git push origin --delete "$BRANCH"
          target=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          git tag "$tag" "$target"
          git push origin "refs/tags/$tag"
          if gh release view "$tag" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$tag" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$tag" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --target "$target" \
              --title "$tag" --generate-notes
          fi

name: ci

on:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: 1.99.1

jobs:
  rukie:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Read the Go toolchain
        id: go_toolchain
        run: |
          go_version=$(sed -n 's/^toolchain go//p' go.mod)
          [[ "$go_version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          printf 'version=%s\n' "$go_version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ steps.go_toolchain.outputs.version }}
          cache: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.sum
            Makefile
      - run: |
          make check
  ruk-integration:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Read the Go toolchain
        id: go_toolchain
        run: |
          go_version=$(sed -n 's/^toolchain go//p' go.mod)
          [[ "$go_version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          printf 'version=%s\n' "$go_version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ steps.go_toolchain.outputs.version }}
          cache: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
      - name: Check out pinned Ruk
        run: |
          ruk_revision=$(<tools/ruk.pin)
          [[ "$ruk_revision" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          git init ruk
          git -C ruk remote add origin https://github.com/gosuda/ruk.git
          git -C ruk fetch --no-tags --depth 1 origin "$ruk_revision"
          git -C ruk checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
      - run: |
          rustup toolchain install "$RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2.9.3
        with:
          workspaces: ruk -> target
          key: ${{ hashFiles('tools/ruk.pin') }}
          env-vars: ImageOS
          cache-workspace-crates: true
          cache-bin: false
          save-if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@893d6ee8d714b6c7dfe2bcd94e5759e9a7958a7e # v2.90.10
        id: nextest
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest@0.9.148
          fallback: none
      - run: |
